options.text: Declare the pier part of the parade
options.resultDialogue: Kiara turns toward the crowd. 'Behold—the secret final destination of HoloTori!' Subaru whispers, 'We did not know it existed thirty seconds ago.' Reine continues waving. 'The audience does not require that detail.' The guests cheer as the pier fades. Mumei looks at the empty sea. 'Our destination left.' Lui writes, 'Do not follow disappearing infrastructure.'
options.completionDialogue: HoloTori turned the fourth pier's brief appearance into the parade finale. The guests believed it was planned, while Lui added disappearing infrastructure to tomorrow's safety meeting.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: HoloTori completed the victory torch parade. No new finding occurred, but the prism guided every flame toward the briefly visible fourth pier.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Justice secure the prism, document the fourth pier, and stop Gigi from arresting the lighthouse beam.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth has opened an official jurisdiction case. Cecilia is deploying sensors, Raora is preparing to sketch the projection, and Gigi has labeled the lighthouse BIG SUSPECT.

steps.prompt: Justice secures the lighthouse platform. Elizabeth treats the prism activation as a matter of national jurisdiction. Gigi is wearing an equipment-inspector badge she made herself.

options.resultDialogue: Cecilia places sensor markers around the prism. 'No one crosses this line without authorization.' Gigi steps over it. Cecilia picks her up and places her back outside. Gigi steps over again. Cecilia repeats the process. Elizabeth watches. 'Is this necessary?' Cecilia replies, 'She is testing system endurance.' Gigi salutes. 'Excellent system.'

options.text: Let Elizabeth open an official case
options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth dictates: 'Case Seven: The Trophy That Contained Infrastructure.' Raora sketches the prism wearing a criminal mask. Gigi points at the drawing. 'Clearly guilty.' Cecilia says, 'The mask is artistic.' Elizabeth adds, 'Possible disguise capability.' Raora quietly adds a tiny mustache.

Gigi circles the tower, tapping every surface. She finds the ceremonial switch and labels it BIG BUTTON. Elizabeth says, 'Do not press it.' Gigi puts both hands behind her back. 'I would never.' The switch clicks under her tail. Cecilia records, 'Statement reliability: zero percent.'

steps.prompt: The lighthouse beam activates before Cecilia completes the startup sequence. A fourth pier appears across the water.

options.resultDialogue: Raora draws quickly. 'The railings are older than the resort style, and there is a sign at the end.' Elizabeth asks what it says. Raora squints at the fading image. 'RETURN STAFF ONLY.' Gigi writes BIRD STAFF beneath it. Cecilia says, 'No avian data detected.' Gigi circles her note twice. 'Hidden avian data.'

options.text: Ask Cecilia why it activated early
options.resultDialogue: Cecilia compares the startup log. 'The structure responded 2.4 seconds before the lighthouse transmitted.' Elizabeth looks toward the pier. 'Then the destination called first.' Gigi cups her hands around her mouth. 'HELLO, CRIME PIER!' The projection flickers brighter. Everyone turns toward her. Gigi whispers, 'It likes me.'

Elizabeth faces the ocean. 'Unregistered structure, identify yourself!' The beam displays a sequence of old staff numbers. Cecilia freezes the image. One line ends in UNIT-Z. Raora lowers her pencil. 'That was on the cracked badge.' Elizabeth opens a second case file. Gigi asks, 'Can cases fight each other?'

steps.prompt: The projection begins fading. Justice has seconds to decide how the island will officially describe the event.

options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth signs an emergency order. 'The nonexistent pier is now restricted territory.' You ask, 'Can you restrict something that does not exist?' She stamps the page. 'It exists administratively now.' Gigi places a tiny barricade at the water's edge. Cecilia saves the projection data. Raora titles her sketch THE PIER THAT FILED ITSELF.
options.completionDialogue: Justice secured the lighthouse and officially restricted the fourth pier despite its disappearance. Cecilia confirmed that it responded before activation, and Raora preserved the only complete visual record.

options.text: Keep the pier secret from the guests
options.resultDialogue: Raora closes her sketchbook, Cecilia encrypts the sensor logs, and Elizabeth announces that the beam was a planned finale. Gigi raises her hand. 'Can I tell one bird?' 'No,' everyone answers. The pier fades. Cecilia's prism display flashes CALIBRATION 1 OF 4 COMPLETE before going dark.
options.completionDialogue: Justice concealed the fourth pier as a planned show effect. Behind the stage, the prism confirmed CALIBRATION 1 OF 4 COMPLETE before shutting down.

options.text: Mark the site for tomorrow's inspection
options.resultDialogue: Cecilia calculates the pier's projected coordinates. Raora draws the shoreline reference points. Elizabeth schedules an official inspection. Gigi packs a net, three snacks, and a sign reading PIER ARREST KIT. Elizabeth removes the net. Gigi replaces it when she looks away. The water returns to darkness, but the coordinates remain.
options.completionDialogue: Justice recorded the fourth pier's coordinates for a future inspection. The structure vanished, but its location, UNIT-Z connection, and early response remain in the case file.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Justice completed the lighthouse security operation. No new object was found, but the fourth pier, UNIT-Z connection, and calibration message were documented for the next chapter.

days.storyBeat: The resort cleans up after the Summer Games. Everyone insists yesterday was a success, despite the evidence.

morning.title: Day 8 — Cleanup Bounty
morning.openingDialogue: The Summer Games are over. The debris is not. Morning cleanup pays a special 100-shell bounty.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Gamers sort the mountain of tournament debris before Korone legally adopts all of it.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Mio has three neat lost-property tables. Fubuki relabeled them COMMON, RARE, and LEGENDARY. Okayu is asleep on LEGENDARY.

steps.prompt: Guests arrive to reclaim their stuff. Fubuki wants loot reveals.

options.resultDialogue: Mio runs proper claims. Korone puts a traffic cone on the desk. 'Owner?' 'Resort property.' Korone narrows her eyes. 'Prove it.'
Fubuki lifts a towel. 'RARE DROP!' Its owner raises a hand. 'Congratulations on your pity pull.' Mio takes the microphone away.

options.text: Let Korone identify owners by scent
options.resultDialogue: Korone sniffs a cap and points across the lobby. 'YUBI MAN!' The terrified guest admits it's his. Mio whispers, 'Do not encourage this.'

steps.prompt: A box marked ATHLETE DEBRIS rattles. Today's findings are mundane.

options.resultDialogue: Inside: seventeen whistles and one wet foam finger. Fubuki whispers, 'Cursed legendary.' Korone somehow blows all seventeen whistles.
Okayu pulls out sunglasses, an energy bar, and a medal ribbon. Mio asks which is treasure. Okayu puts on the sunglasses. 'Yes.'
Korone finds a mascot glove with bite marks. She hides it behind her back. 'No witnesses.'
You find sunscreen and one referee sock. Fubuki says, 'Mystery.' Mio says, 'Laundry.' 'You keep killing my genre.'

steps.prompt: One item remains: yesterday's giant mascot head.

options.resultDialogue: Mio labels it RESORT PROPERTY. Fubuki changes the label to BOSS DROP the moment Mio turns around.
options.completionDialogue: The lost-property desk closes with actual ownership mostly restored. Korone has been formally banned from adopting infrastructure.

options.resultDialogue: Fubuki displays it as an ANCIENT RELIC. Mio says, 'It was used yesterday.' Okayu adds CURSED.
options.completionDialogue: The tournament debris became a one-day museum exhibit. Guests love it. Mio has stopped asking who authorized the museum because every answer is Fubuki.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Lost property returns to normal. Fubuki still insists the wet foam finger was legendary.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Fantasy dismantle yesterday's temporary structures before Pekora discovers they have resale value.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Flare has a cleanup list. Pekora crossed out REMOVE and wrote MONETIZE. Marine is already selling battlefield photos.

steps.prompt: The sponsorship kiosk blocks the service road. Remove it.

options.text: Let Noel carry the whole kiosk
options.resultDialogue: Noel lifts the kiosk. The foundation comes too. Flare runs after her. 'NOEL, PUT THE RESORT DOWN!' Noel blinks. 'Which part?'

options.text: Make Pekora dismantle her own booth
options.resultDialogue: Pekora removes one screw and collapses. 'Manual labor defeated capitalism-peko.' Flare hands her another screwdriver. Capitalism recovers instantly.
Marine auctions broken planks as 'Senchou-certified historic debris.' Flare says one came from a toilet screen. The bidding increases.

steps.prompt: Flare finds yesterday's sponsorship paperwork.

options.resultDialogue: Flare reads: 'Shortcut consultation. Emotional damages. Definitely not bribery.' Pekora stops backing toward the door. 'That last one explains itself-peko.'
Marine refuses to refund upside-down towels. She rotates one. 'Limited inverted edition.' Pekora whispers, 'Raise the price-peko.'

options.text: Use the paperwork as packing material
options.resultDialogue: Noel wraps debris in the contracts. Pekora gasps, 'Those have legal value!' Flare smiles. 'Then rescue them.'

steps.prompt: One sign survives: PEKOMARI OFFICIAL SHORTCUT.

options.resultDialogue: Flare snaps the sign in half. Pekora falls to her knees. 'MY INFRASTRUCTURE-PEKO!' 'It pointed into a hedge.'
options.completionDialogue: Fantasy clears the service road. Pekora mourns a fake shortcut, Marine sells memorial photographs, and Flare finally crosses one item off her clipboard.

options.text: Keep it as a joke souvenir
options.resultDialogue: They hang it in the lobby under a giant FAKE label. Pekora adds a smaller sign beneath it: ALLEGEDLY.
options.completionDialogue: The fake shortcut sign survives as a lobby joke. Flare adds three warning labels; Pekora adds plausible deniability beneath each one.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Fantasy finishes cleanup without an explosion. Pekora calls this a narrative failure.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help AREA 15 reopen the beach after the tournament without letting Risu invent a municipal currency.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Moona organized cleanup zones. Iofi is painting signs. Risu opened a DEBRIS EXCHANGE before you arrived.

steps.prompt: Volunteers keep bringing junk to Risu. She starts pricing it.

options.resultDialogue: You confiscate Risu's price board. She produces another. 'Markets anticipate regulation.' Moona confiscates that one too.

options.text: Let Iofi turn it into an art station
options.resultDialogue: Iofi paints faces on broken cones. Risu stares. 'You increased the value.' 'Art.' Risu whispers, 'Asset appreciation.'
Moona creates four zones, including RISU STOP TOUCHING THAT. Risu calls it discriminatory zoning. Moona moves her into it.

steps.prompt: A locked recovery cooler remains. Today's findings are mundane.

options.resultDialogue: Inside are melted ice packs and twelve wristbands. Risu holds one up. 'Limited edition.' 'There are twelve.' 'Limited compared with infinity.'
Moona finds towels, a spoon, and one flip-flop. 'Why only one?' Iofi nods solemnly. 'Character development.'

options.text: Let Risu negotiate with the cooler
options.resultDialogue: Risu negotiates with the cooler. Moona opens it with the key. Risu looks betrayed. 'Hostile acquisition.'

steps.prompt: Risu proposes a permanent Debris Futures Exchange.

options.resultDialogue: You say no. Risu folds the proposal. 'History fears innovators.' Moona points at the recycling bin. 'Your market.'
options.completionDialogue: AREA 15 reopens the beach with a normal recycling system. Risu considers this a recession.

options.resultDialogue: Risu gets one fixed-price souvenir table. Five minutes later the sign reads AREA 15 COMMODITY EXCHANGE.
options.completionDialogue: The beach reopens with one tightly regulated souvenir table. Risu immediately begins lobbying for deregulation.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: AREA 15 clears the beach. Risu fails to create a derivatives market for garbage.

noon.title: Day 8 — Replays & Complaints
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, the physical damage is mostly gone. The arguments are thriving.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Promise review yesterday's footage before Bae turns instant replay into a rematch generator.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kronii synced twelve replay angles. Bae brought a whistle. Mumei wrote WITNESS on her forehead.

steps.prompt: The first disputed finish includes three explosions. Kronii wants a factual ruling.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii freezes the exact finish frame. Bae says, 'Enhance.' Mumei points at a blur. 'Enhance that duck.' Somewhere, Subaru gets angry.
Bae rewinds the explosion twice. 'Ten points.' Kronii asks, 'For what?' 'Commitment.'
Mumei says she remembers everything. 'Who crossed first?' 'A person.' 'Which person?' 'Athletic.' Kronii closes her eyes.

steps.prompt: The replay system can project the fastest runner as a ghost.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii activates the ghost runner. Bae starts sprinting around the table. 'WHY IS IT WINNING?!' Fauna reminds her they're indoors.
Bae races the ghost. Mumei uses a side door. Kronii points. 'Disqualified.' Mumei shrugs. 'History will decide.'
Kronii turns it off. Bae points at the blank screen. 'Coward.' Fauna gives her tea.

steps.prompt: Promise must publish an official ruling before rumors win.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii publishes the facts. Bae adds EXPLOSIONS WERE SICK. Fauna crosses it out. Mumei adds 'allegedly.'
options.completionDialogue: Promise releases a factual replay report after removing twelve unauthorized adjectives and one drawing of an explosion.

options.resultDialogue: They add a highlight reel titled MOMENTS THAT SHOULD NOT HAVE WORKED. Kronii sees the engagement numbers. 'I hate measurable evidence.'
options.completionDialogue: Promise releases the official results alongside a chaotic highlight reel. The disputes decrease because everyone becomes too busy arguing about the funniest crash.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Promise settles the replay disputes without accidentally starting another tournament.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Gen 1 answer post-tournament guest complaints before Haachama turns customer service into a cooking segment.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Aki organized complaint forms. Matsuri already answered three calls with 'skill issue.' Haachama brought a stove.

steps.prompt: The hotline lights up. Pick a complaint category.

options.resultDialogue: Aki fixes duplicate seats. Matsuri suggests telling guests Seat 42 evolved into Seat 43. Aki mutes her.
Haachama grabs the food line. 'HAACHAMA COOKING WILL—' Three hands hit mute. Mel whispers, 'We value your survival.'
Matsuri asks how loud it was. 'Only that loud?' Aki takes the phone. 'They're threatening legal action.' 'Passionate compliment.'

steps.prompt: A caller claims emotional damage because their favorite team lost.

options.resultDialogue: Mel calms the caller in thirty seconds. Matsuri whispers, 'Too powerful.' Haachama whispers back, 'Can we weaponize empathy?'
Matsuri says losing builds character. The caller asks if her favorite lost. Silence. 'This conversation is over.'
Haachama offers an apology snack. The caller somehow senses it through the phone. 'Actually, I'm fine now.'

steps.prompt: Management wants one standard response for future complaints.

options.text: Use Aki and Mel's polite script
options.resultDialogue: Aki and Mel write a polite script. Matsuri adds 'unless skill issue.' Aki deletes it. Matsuri adds it back smaller.
options.completionDialogue: Gen 1 closes the complaint hotline with a usable customer-service script and a hidden phrase Aki will discover tomorrow.

options.resultDialogue: The FAQ includes a red box: HAACHAMA COOKING IS NOT COMPENSATION. Haachama circles it and writes YET.
options.completionDialogue: The tournament FAQ reduces complaint calls immediately. Haachama begins drafting a competing document.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Gen 1 clears the hotline. Nobody gets transferred to Haachama's kitchen.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help holoh3ro determine which tournament equipment can be repaired and which pieces have earned a funeral.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela lined up broken equipment. Zeta treats it like a crime scene. Kobo put flowers on the relay baton.

steps.prompt: The baton is cracked. Kobo demands a funeral before repairs.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela takes the baton. Kobo clings to it. 'You can't operate before goodbye!' Kaela repairs it while Kobo is still hugging it.
Kobo rings a bell. Zeta reads: 'Cause of death: being used as intended.' Kaela waits thirty seconds. 'Revived.' 'MIRACLE!'
Zeta finds everyone's fingerprints. 'A conspiracy involving everyone.' Kaela says, 'Or sports.' Zeta writes SPORTS?

steps.prompt: A hurdle is bent beyond recognizable geometry.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela straightens the hurdle until it looks unnaturally perfect. Kobo whispers, 'She removed the curve from reality.'
Kobo tests it, flips into a foam mat, and raises one thumb. 'Still dangerous.' Zeta writes that down.
Zeta rebuilds the collision with mannequins. Kobo adds hats. Soon the forensic reconstruction has an audience.

steps.prompt: Rebuild everything, or make a damage museum?

options.resultDialogue: Kaela starts rebuilding. Kobo says, 'Stronger.' Zeta says, 'Not too strong.' Kaela asks, 'Define too strong.' Nobody can.
options.completionDialogue: holoh3ro rebuilds the surviving equipment. The next tournament gear may be capable of surviving the tournament and several unrelated disasters.

options.resultDialogue: They open a damage museum. One plaque reads: THIS HURDLE DREAMED OF BEING A BRIDGE.
options.completionDialogue: The worst tournament equipment becomes a temporary damage museum. Guests are surprisingly moved by the relay baton's thirty-second life story.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: holoh3ro finishes the autopsy. Kobo's bereavement request for the baton is denied.

evening.title: Day 8 — The Official Version
evening.openingDialogue: The resort tries to close the Summer Games chapter with food, awards, and selective memory.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help Gen 0 host a relaxed afterparty that Miko immediately turns into an unofficial awards ceremony.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Sora planned a thank-you stage. Miko arrived with twenty homemade trophies. Suisei reads one: 'Best Elite Decision.'

steps.prompt: Miko demands unofficial awards. Pick the first category.

options.resultDialogue: Miko nominates herself for Best Recovery. Suisei says, 'That's repeatedly failing.' Miko points back. 'Repeatedly recovering.'
The applause meter spikes before nominees are announced. Suisei nods. 'They know what they came for.' Miko hides broken course pieces.
Miko nominates herself for Best Strategy. Suisei seconds it. 'For demonstrating what not to do.' Miko lowers her hand.

steps.prompt: Roboco's applause meter starts scoring every loud noise.

options.resultDialogue: Roboco says, 'High-spec diagnosis complete.' The meter gives her 98. Suisei taps the mic: 100. 'It has favorites.'
Dropped spoon: 73. 'Elite': 41. Sora says thank you: 100. Miko screams, 'BIAS!' The machine gives BIAS 86.

options.text: Let AZKi turn it into rhythm scoring
options.resultDialogue: AZKi turns cheers into rhythm scoring. Miko shouts 'ELITE' off-beat: 12. Suisei laughing gets 100.

steps.prompt: Sora asks for one final toast.

options.resultDialogue: Sora thanks everyone. Ten peaceful seconds pass. Miko's trophy table collapses. Suisei checks the clock. 'New record.'
options.completionDialogue: The afterparty ends on a warm note followed immediately by structural failure, preserving the resort's brand consistency.

options.resultDialogue: Miko begins, 'To elite management—' The meter displays 7. Suisei raises her glass. 'To seven points.'
options.completionDialogue: Miko's unofficial awards show concludes with a seven-point toast that Suisei ensures nobody ever forgets.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Gen 0's quiet afterparty becomes an awards show whose machine openly dislikes Miko.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help holoForce serve the competitor recovery banquet without Kanata becoming furniture transport and Luna becoming the tax authority.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Towa has a seating plan. Kanata is carrying the dessert table. Luna is sitting on top of it.

steps.prompt: Luna declares the dessert table royal territory.

options.resultDialogue: You offer Luna first dessert. She points at all of them. 'Those.' Towa says choose one. 'They are one category.'
Kanata lifts the table, Luna, and two guests. Towa runs after her. 'PUT THE GUESTS DOWN!' One guest says the view is great.

options.text: Let Watame distract Luna with bread
options.resultDialogue: Watame offers Luna bread as tribute. The dessert line opens. Towa stares. 'You solved territorial conflict with bread.' 'Civilization.'

steps.prompt: Someone asks for an ice pack. Kanata returns with the freezer.

options.resultDialogue: Kanata thought carrying the freezer was faster. Towa points back to the kitchen. 'The ice pack was inside it.'

options.text: Turn the freezer into a recovery station
options.resultDialogue: Watame labels the freezer COOL DOWN HERE. Athletes gather around it. Towa sighs. 'I hate that this works.'
Luna charges one candy to enter the Cold Kingdom. Towa says no. Luna lowers it to half a candy. 'Tax law.'

steps.prompt: One dessert tray remains. Everyone suddenly feels recovered.

options.resultDialogue: Towa splits everything evenly. Kanata offers to carry the plates. Everyone shouts 'NO' at once.
options.completionDialogue: The recovery banquet ends peacefully after the group successfully prevents Kanata from moving any additional architecture.

options.resultDialogue: Luna announces a dessert sprint. While everyone argues, Watame eats one pastry. Luna points. 'The sheep has won.'
options.completionDialogue: The banquet concludes with an unauthorized dessert competition won by Watame before anyone officially started it.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: holoForce feeds everyone. Luna briefly governs a refrigerated microstate.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Help FLOW GLOW premiere the official Summer Games highlight reel without letting the editing room rewrite history.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ririka has sponsor notes. Hajime has timestamps. Kanade added explosion sounds where no explosions happened. Niko found a MORE DRAMA button.

steps.prompt: The opening montage is eight minutes long. Cut it down.

options.resultDialogue: Hajime cuts seven minutes. Kanade gasps. 'You deleted my scream.' 'There were fourteen.' 'They were emotionally different.'
Kanade keeps only impacts, cheering, and one unexplained sandwich close-up. Ririka checks the numbers. 'The sandwich tested well.'

options.text: Let Raden narrate it like history
options.resultDialogue: Raden begins serious narration. Niko presses MORE DRAMA. Thunder sounds. 'There was no thunder.' Niko presses it again. 'There is now.'

steps.prompt: One lighthouse shot shows the ocean from an impossible angle.

options.resultDialogue: Hajime checks the frame twice. Kanade adds a horror sting. Everyone stares. She quietly removes it.
Hajime deletes the frame. Niko restores it. Hajime deletes it again. Raden takes away the MORE DRAMA button.

options.text: Turn it into an artistic transition
options.resultDialogue: Raden uses it as a one-second transition. Kanade asks, 'Can I whisper PIER?' Four people say no.

steps.prompt: The guests are seated. Pick the final cut.

options.resultDialogue: The heroic cut lands perfectly. Then Kanade's hidden explosion sound triggers during a handshake. She sinks behind the console.
options.completionDialogue: The official highlight film gives the Summer Games a surprisingly heroic ending, plus one unauthorized explosion during sportsmanship.

options.resultDialogue: Niko hits MORE DRAMA. Kanade restores six screams. Hajime names the file FINAL_FINAL_DO_NOT_TOUCH. Nobody listens.
options.completionDialogue: The Summer Games close with a hysterical highlight reel that turns yesterday's accidents into the resort's most popular screening of the week.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW premieres the tournament film. One strange lighthouse frame survives under several minutes of screaming.

days.storyBeat: Small management decisions begin becoming suspiciously literal. By evening, the staff recover an old Z authorization stamp that seems connected to the island's habit of treating Manager statements as fact.

morning.title: Day 9 - Management Says So
morning.openingDialogue: The resort opens normally. Then a hallway changes because the Manager described it wrong. Nobody is ready to call that supernatural before breakfast.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Amelia, Shion, and Ao are trying to stop one harmless rumor from becoming resort policy.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Amelia has a corkboard. Shion has a wand. Ao has already drawn the rumor as a manga cover.

steps.prompt: A guest asks why the east hallway is closed. Nobody actually knows.

options.resultDialogue: Shion nods. 'Finally, a professional answer.' The lights immediately flicker. Amelia slowly turns toward you. 'Why did the hallway agree?'
Amelia puts up police tape. A printer spits out CASE #001 before she touches it. 'I hate when paperwork is faster than me.'

options.text: Say it is for manga filming
options.resultDialogue: Ao poses by the door. A sign appears: OFFICIAL SHOOTING LOCATION. Ao goes pale. 'Manager, my lie got licensed.'

steps.prompt: The hallway now matches your explanation a little too well.

options.resultDialogue: Shion casts a tiny spell. The hallway answers with thunder. She lowers the wand. 'I did not do that one.'
Amelia photographs the sign. The photo prints with tomorrow's date. She pockets it. 'Cool. Hate that.'
Ao sketches a cooler version. The real sign updates to match. She stares at her pen. 'I am never drawing rent prices.'

steps.prompt: Guests are gathering. How do you explain the hallway?

options.resultDialogue: The guests applaud. A ticket booth rises from the floor. Amelia: 'You monetized the anomaly in eight seconds.'
options.completionDialogue: The hallway became an attraction because the Manager said so. Nobody wants to discuss that sentence.

options.resultDialogue: You lock the door. A second door appears beside it labeled QUIETER ENTRANCE. Shion whispers, 'It is mocking you.'
options.completionDialogue: The hallway is closed. The hallway appears to disagree.

options.resultDialogue: Ao tries a cool press statement. Halfway through, she starts nerding out about the impossible sign. The guests like that version better.
options.completionDialogue: Ao handled the rumor. The rumor handled reality.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: One explanation became suspiciously real. Management files it under: not urgent until it bites someone.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Choco, Anya, and Nene are running first aid. The clinic has already become a cafeteria.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Choco is checking temperatures. Anya is cutting fruit with terrifying precision. Nene has labeled the waiting room HUSBAND RECOVERY.

steps.prompt: A guest complains of 'post-tournament exhaustion.' Choco asks for a treatment plan.

options.resultDialogue: Choco hands over cake. The clinic printer adds SUGAR THERAPY to the official chart. Choco smiles. 'Medicine has advanced.'
Anya points to a bed. The bed reclines itself and locks. Anya nods. 'Rest has become mandatory.'
Nene stamps the form HUSBAND. The guest receives a wristband reading TEMPORARY SPOUSE. Choco: 'That is not medical.'

steps.prompt: The clinic system starts copying whatever you call a treatment.

options.resultDialogue: Every water cooler lights up gold. Nene gasps. 'Holy hydration!' Choco quietly raises the price back to zero.
A cabinet opens and labels itself ANYA. She stares at you. 'I was already a weapon. This feels reductive.'
The walls stop shaking. Everyone looks at you. Choco: 'Manager, say that more often.'

steps.prompt: The next guest asks what this clinic specializes in.

options.resultDialogue: The sign changes to RECOVERY CLINIC. Nene crosses out CLINIC and writes HUSBAND CENTER. The sign changes again.
options.completionDialogue: The clinic now specializes in recovery, sweets, and legally questionable matrimony.

options.resultDialogue: Nothing happens. Anya looks impressed. 'The island could not locate any.'
options.completionDialogue: The clinic failed to locate common sense. This was the most accurate diagnosis all morning.

options.resultDialogue: The system prints HEAD PHYSICIAN: YUZUKI CHOCO. Choco beams. Anya quietly hides the cake drawer.
options.completionDialogue: Choco received a promotion. Nobody remembers approving it except the island.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The clinic survives. Several temporary labels have become disturbingly official.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Botan, Chloe, and Iroha investigate a locker that keeps changing its own incident report.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Botan is photographing the lock. Iroha is guarding the door. Chloe has somehow become the prime suspect by volunteering to clean it.

steps.prompt: The locker is dented from inside. What caused it?

options.resultDialogue: The report updates: RACCOON INCIDENT. Three tiny claw marks appear. Botan: 'Manager. Stop feeding the report.'
The report updates: CHLOE INCIDENT. Chloe points at herself. 'Wow. Fast investigation.' Iroha moves between her and the handcuffs.
The locker immediately falls over. Botan takes one photo. 'Evidence is being very cooperative today.'

steps.prompt: The report now asks for a threat level.

options.resultDialogue: The locker stops moving. Chloe pats it. It bites her sleeve. 'Low feels personal.'
Red lights activate. Iroha draws her sword. The locker opens politely. Botan: 'It respects drama.'
The screen flashes THREAT: EMBARRASSING. Chloe covers the report with both hands. 'This classification is bullying.'

steps.prompt: Security wants a final conclusion.

options.resultDialogue: A giant CASE CLOSED stamp appears on the locker. Botan checks your hands. 'You did not have that stamp.'
options.completionDialogue: The locker incident is closed. The locker has accepted the verdict.

options.resultDialogue: Iroha takes first watch. The locker slowly turns to face her. 'Manager... it has posture now.'
options.completionDialogue: Security established a watch. The locker appears to have done the same.

options.resultDialogue: Chloe wipes the report. Her name disappears from the suspect list. She gasps. 'Cleaning destroys evidence. Useful.'
options.completionDialogue: The locker is clean. The investigation is cleaner than legally advisable.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Security resolves the incident. Nobody asks why the report kept agreeing with the Manager.

noon.title: Day 9 - Official Nonsense
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, signs, forms, and guest-service systems are taking casual decisions far too seriously.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Ollie, Calli, and Shiori must clear a mountain of abandoned complaint forms.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ollie is reading complaints aloud. Calli is stamping DEAD ISSUE on old forms. Shiori has found one from a guest who complained that the sun was 'too sunny.'

steps.prompt: Which complaint do you resolve first?

options.resultDialogue: You write FIXED. A cloud covers only that guest's chair. Calli lowers the stamp. 'That is above our pay grade.'
Shiori writes NOTED. The path beside the desk instantly becomes carpet. Ollie: 'WE DEFEATED BEACH.'
Ollie writes LESS MUSIC. Every speaker starts playing one note. Calli: 'Put it back before I die again.'

steps.prompt: The old forms begin resolving themselves whenever someone says 'approved.'

options.resultDialogue: Shiori writes APPROVED WORD BAN. The printer accepts it. Everyone stares at her. 'I see the flaw.'
Ollie shouts 'APPROVED!' at a complaint about stairs. A ramp erupts through the wall. 'SCIENCE!'
Calli stamps DENIED. The form folds itself into a paper coffin. She nods. 'Finally. A system with taste.'

steps.prompt: The final complaint reads: 'Management makes no sense.'

options.resultDialogue: The form stamps itself VALID. Ollie points at you. 'THE ISLAND HAS SPOKEN.'
options.completionDialogue: The complaint office cleared its backlog. Management lost the appeal.

options.resultDialogue: The form returns with EVIDENCE ATTACHED. It is forty pages long. Shiori: 'I would not open that.'
options.completionDialogue: Management denied the accusation. The island has documentation.

options.resultDialogue: Calli opens the mystery drawer. It is already full. 'Yeah. That tracks.'
options.completionDialogue: The complaint was filed under mystery, beside several things nobody wants to explain yet.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The complaint backlog is gone. Reality has become alarmingly customer-service oriented.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gura and the Abyssgard twins search for one guest sandal. It becomes a territorial dispute.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Gura is waist-deep in the lagoon. Fuwawa has a rescue float. Mococo is interrogating a crab.

steps.prompt: The guest asks what probably happened to the sandal.

options.resultDialogue: Gura points at herself. 'Rude.' A shark-shaped bite mark appears on the spare sandal. 'Okay, ruder.'
Fuwawa gasps. Mococo immediately starts digging. She finds someone else's shoe. 'WE'RE CLOSE!'
A tiny wave rolls in and deposits the exact sandal at your feet. Everyone goes silent. Gura: 'Do another one.'

steps.prompt: The lagoon sign now asks who controls this water.

options.resultDialogue: The sign changes to SHARK JURISDICTION. Gura grins for three seconds, then receives a maintenance bill.
The sign changes to GUARD DOG WATERS. Fuwawa smiles. Mococo starts barking at boats.
A lifeguard chair rises under you. Mococo salutes. 'MANAGER IS NOW WATER.'

steps.prompt: The sandal is returned. The guest asks if the lagoon is safe.

options.resultDialogue: Every warning sign flips to SAFE. Gura immediately trips over a buoy. 'Your definition is bad.'
options.completionDialogue: The lagoon is officially safe. The lagoon has not been consulted.

options.resultDialogue: The sign changes to SAFE ENOUGH. Fuwawa nods. 'Honest!' Mococo gives it two paws up.
options.completionDialogue: The lagoon adopted the most accurate safety rating on the island.

options.resultDialogue: Mococo presents the crab. It raises one claw. The sign changes to APPROVED BY CRAB. Nobody challenges it.
options.completionDialogue: The lagoon passed inspection under local crab authority.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The sandal is recovered. The lagoon now has more government than yesterday.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Bijou, Vivi, and Nerissa are pricing souvenir gems. One plastic jewel becomes financially dangerous.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Bijou is sorting stones. Vivi is modeling the expensive pile. Nerissa has found a plastic gem labeled RARE-ish.

steps.prompt: A tourist asks what the plastic gem is worth.

options.resultDialogue: The register refuses to sell it. Bijou hugs the gem. 'Manager made it priceless. I win capitalism.'
The tag changes to 5. Vivi: 'Finally, honest luxury.' Nerissa buys two.
Bijou whispers a number. The register starts smoking. Nerissa: 'Maybe less Bijou.'

steps.prompt: The shop system begins treating adjectives as appraisal terms.

options.resultDialogue: A spotlight appears over it. Vivi: 'That rock has better staging than me.'
Nobody touches it. Bijou touches it immediately. 'I feel exactly the same.'
The gem sparkles. Nerissa looks at you. 'Manager, compliment the building next.'

steps.prompt: The shop needs one final sign.

options.resultDialogue: Every plastic gem starts glowing. Vivi slowly removes the sign. 'We are not ready for truth.'
options.completionDialogue: The souvenir shop closed before authenticity became a physics problem.

options.resultDialogue: The sign grows teeth. Nerissa: 'That feels unnecessarily literal.'
options.completionDialogue: The shop adopted a warning sign that now requires feeding.

options.resultDialogue: Bijou stamps every bag. The bags begin sparkling. She whispers, 'My power grows.'
options.completionDialogue: Bijou certification is now accepted by at least one supernatural cash register.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The shop survives appraisal. The plastic inventory has developed self-esteem.

evening.title: Day 9 - Authorized
evening.openingDialogue: Three evening teams uncover the same old symbol in different offices: a brass Z stamp marked AUTHORIZED. This is the day's only finding window.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Ina and Raora design tomorrow posters while Chihaya handles delivery at unsafe artistic speed.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ina and Raora are arguing over poster composition. Chihaya is revving a resort cart beside a sign that says NO REVVING.

steps.prompt: The poster needs a slogan.

options.resultDialogue: The printer jams instantly. Ina: 'Manager, you challenged the universe.'
Chihaya's cart gains a second speedometer. 'Manager. It goes to 300 now.' Raora starts drawing faster.
Every poster auto-corrects Raora's sketches. She looks offended. 'It removed the extra muscles.'

steps.prompt: A jammed sign cabinet contains an old brass stamp marked Z - AUTHORIZED.

options.resultDialogue: The paper flashes. The slogan appears on every resort screen. Ina: 'That stamp has administrative tentacles.'
Raora draws the stamp. Her drawing stamps itself. 'Manager, my notebook has joined management.'
Chihaya stamps her delivery form. Every traffic light turns green. She smiles. 'This is terrible power.'

steps.prompt: What do you do with the stamp?

options.resultDialogue: The drawer labels itself AUTHORIZED STORAGE. Ina: 'It is helping. I dislike helpful.'
options.completionDialogue: The Z stamp is secured. The drawer appears proud of itself.

options.resultDialogue: The stamp slides into your pocket by itself. Raora sketches your face. 'Evidence.'
options.completionDialogue: Management keeps the Z stamp. Nobody is allowed to say the word approved near it.

options.resultDialogue: You stamp CLOSED. The office lights switch off. Chihaya: 'Wow. Great ending.'
options.completionDialogue: The Z stamp works. Unfortunately, it also understands comedy timing.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: A brass Z authorization stamp was recovered. It seems to make official decisions a little too official.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Koyori wants data, Su wants engagement, and Riona wants the press release to sound victorious.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Koyori has twelve charts. Su has twelve snacks. Riona has crossed out the phrase minor anomaly and written TOTAL CONTROL.

steps.prompt: How should the resort describe today's weird changes?

options.resultDialogue: Every screen displays ROUTINE MAINTENANCE. A palm tree moves six feet left. Riona: 'Routine is doing a lot of work.'
Koyori lights up. 'Then I can experiment!' Su: 'That sentence should require a permit.'
Su posts nothing. The resort account posts by itself: NOTHING HAPPENED. Su stares. 'It is bad at subtlety.'

steps.prompt: Koyori finds an old brass stamp in a locked press drawer: Z - AUTHORIZED.

options.resultDialogue: She stamps REPEATABLE. The same coffee cup falls off the desk twice. Koyori screams happily. Everyone else screams normally.
The photo auto-posts with OFFICIAL captioning. Su deletes it. It reposts. 'I have been defeated by scheduling software.'
Riona stamps CONFISCATED. The stamp vanishes into her evidence bag. 'Good.' The bag locks itself. 'Less good.'

steps.prompt: The press conference starts in one minute.

options.resultDialogue: A banner drops: EVERYTHING UNDER CONTROL. Koyori whispers, 'Manager, do not tempt it.'
options.completionDialogue: The press conference succeeds. The banner remains suspiciously confident.

options.text: Say it is a resort gimmick
options.resultDialogue: Guests cheer. Su whispers, 'We have accidentally marketed reality failure.' Riona: 'Then win the market.'
options.completionDialogue: The anomaly is now a feature. Marketing has no remaining fear.

options.resultDialogue: Every microphone switches off. Riona nods. 'Finally, obedient technology.'
options.completionDialogue: The Z stamp is logged and secured after the shortest press conference in resort history.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The team recovered a Z authorization stamp and learned that official wording has suspicious weight here.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: La+, Lamy, and Lui are forced to attend a leadership seminar. La+ believes this is finally her coronation.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Lui has the workbook. Lamy has tea. La+ has written SUPREME COMMANDER over the instructor's name.

steps.prompt: The workbook asks: Who has final authority during an emergency?

options.resultDialogue: La+ gasps. The projector displays CORRECT. Lui closes her eyes. 'Please do not make me enjoy this.'
The projector displays ANSWER UNDER REVIEW. La+ points at it. 'COWARD MACHINE.' Lamy sips tea.
Everyone looks at Lamy. Lamy looks behind herself. 'Why are you looking at me?'

steps.prompt: Lui opens the instructor drawer and finds an old brass stamp: Z - AUTHORIZED.

options.resultDialogue: The staff directory updates instantly. La+ screams victory. Then it adds PROBATIONARY in smaller text.
Every blank answer fills itself with LUI. Lui: 'This is slander through accuracy.'
All clocks jump forward fifteen minutes. Lamy quietly puts the stamp down. 'I did not need this power.'

steps.prompt: The seminar needs one final leadership rule.

options.resultDialogue: La+ raises her hand. The projector adds EXCEPT LA+. Lui tears the cable out of the wall.
options.completionDialogue: Leadership training ends with one forbidden exception and a confiscated Z stamp.

options.resultDialogue: The projector displays BEST PRACTICE. La+ slumps across the desk. 'This seminar is propaganda.'
options.completionDialogue: Lui wins leadership training by trying not to.

options.resultDialogue: Every chair reclines. Lamy smiles. Lui: 'I hate that this is the only rule it implemented correctly.'
options.completionDialogue: The Z stamp is secured after improving employee morale against management's will.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: A Z authorization stamp was found in the old seminar desk. La+ has been banned from stamping herself.

days.storyBeat: After the Z stamp incident, the resort begins proactively completing descriptions, requests, and jokes before staff finish them. At sunset, a fourth pier appears where there was open water that morning.

morning.title: Day 10 - Helpful Systems
morning.openingDialogue: The island has apparently decided Management needs assistance. Nobody remembers asking.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Aki, Mel, and IRyS discover the resort weather board is taking descriptive language literally.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Aki is checking the sky. Mel is checking the curtains. IRyS is staring at a forecast that says MOSTLY DRAMATIC.

steps.prompt: The board asks for today's weather description.

options.resultDialogue: One tiny cloud appears over the breakfast buffet. IRyS: 'It is portion controlled.'
The temperature locks at exactly pleasant. Aki looks impressed. 'Manager, never say winter.'
Mel slowly turns toward you. The pavement glows red. 'Maybe do not use my home region as a unit.'

steps.prompt: A breakfast guest jokes that it is 'raining syrup.'

options.resultDialogue: One pancake gets hit by a perfect syrup drizzle from the sky. Aki: 'That is horrifyingly convenient.'
The syrup stops midair and returns to the bottle. IRyS: 'Reality accepts edits now.'
Mel holds out a plate. The syrup misses everyone else and follows her. 'I have become weather favored.'

steps.prompt: How do you end the forecast?

options.resultDialogue: The board flashes NO SURPRISES. Everyone waits. Nothing happens. Mel: 'That was the surprise.'
options.completionDialogue: The weather behaved. This made everyone more nervous.

options.text: Sunny with a chance of nonsense
options.resultDialogue: The board prints 100%. IRyS: 'Finally, an accurate forecast.'
options.completionDialogue: The forecast is now the most reliable system on the island.

options.resultDialogue: Aki writes EXPLORATION WEATHER. A breeze opens every door at once. 'Adventure!'
options.completionDialogue: Aki invented exploration weather. The hinges are filing complaints.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The weather board is now supervised. Nobody tells it about metaphors.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kaela, Kobo, and Zeta discover the resort is finishing maintenance requests before they are fully written.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela has a wrench. Zeta has a checklist. Kobo has written WATER CANNON where the form asked for hose.

steps.prompt: The broken garden hose needs a replacement description.

options.resultDialogue: A hose drops from the ceiling. Kaela lifts it. 'Heavy: yes. Duty: unclear.'
A brass cannon rolls out of storage. Kobo points at the form. 'I DID THE PAPERWORK.'
A perfectly normal hose appears. Zeta scans it. 'Suspiciously normal.'

steps.prompt: The maintenance terminal asks what else needs fixing.

options.resultDialogue: The entire door disappears. Kaela: 'Squeak removed.' Zeta: 'Door also removed.'
The terminal displays OUT OF SCOPE. Kobo gasps. 'RUDE MACHINE!'
The terminal starts searching for NOTHING. Zeta unplugs it. 'Before it finds one.'

steps.prompt: Kaela wants one rule for automatic repairs.

options.resultDialogue: The terminal prints REQUEST DENIED. Kaela stares. 'It has management confidence.'
options.completionDialogue: Automatic maintenance remains automatic. Consent is pending firmware support.

options.resultDialogue: The cannon rolls outside by itself. Kobo follows it. 'WAIT FOR ME!'
options.completionDialogue: Indoor cannon incidents drop to zero. Outdoor statistics are withheld.

options.resultDialogue: Every form slides toward Zeta. She looks at you. 'Manager, I have been promoted to inbox.'
options.completionDialogue: Zeta now controls maintenance approval and deeply regrets competence.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The island is now helping with maintenance. This has not improved staff confidence.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Cecilia, Roboco, and AZKi test whether the resort automation can understand other non-human systems.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Cecilia is listening to the terminal hum. Roboco has declared it low-spec. AZKi has already found the mute button.

steps.prompt: The terminal asks which of them is most compatible.

options.resultDialogue: The terminal prints ANCIENT DEVICE DETECTED. Cecilia: 'Rude. Accurate, but rude.'
It prints HIGH-SPEC CLAIM DETECTED. Roboco points proudly. Then her arm falls off.
The terminal starts playing music instead of diagnostics. AZKi: 'I think I won by not being a robot.'

steps.prompt: The system offers to 'optimize' one person.

options.resultDialogue: A potato recipe prints out. Cecilia goes silent. 'It knows too much.'
Her status changes to HIGHER-SPEC. Nothing else changes. Roboco: 'Perfect.'
The terminal prints MORE SLEEP. All three nod. You have been outvoted.

steps.prompt: What is the compatibility result?

options.resultDialogue: The terminal prints AGREED. Cecilia: 'It has learned sarcasm. We are doomed.'
options.completionDialogue: Compatibility testing ends before the machine learns confidence.

options.resultDialogue: Three charging cables emerge. AZKi steps back. 'I decline the metaphor.'
options.completionDialogue: The system considers everyone compatible. Everyone disagrees.

options.resultDialogue: Roboco touches it. The terminal beeps WELCOME BACK. 'See? It likes me.'
options.completionDialogue: The test ends with one clear rule and one immediate violation.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The resort automation appears able to understand other systems. Unfortunately, it also judges them.

noon.title: Day 10 - Feature Creep
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, brainstorming has become dangerous because the resort keeps building the brainstorms.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Pekora, Miko, and Niko are asked for one safe attraction idea. This is an administrative error.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Pekora brought dynamite. Miko brought a crayon blueprint. Niko brought the phrase trust the process.

steps.prompt: The terminal asks for an exciting new attraction.

options.resultDialogue: A tunnel opens through the snack bar. Pekora: 'FREE INFRASTRUCTURE-PEKO!' Flare is not here to stop her.
Walls rise around Miko. She looks at the map. 'Manager. Elite rescue, please.'
A banana peel dispenser appears. Niko claps. 'The island understands art.'

steps.prompt: The attraction asks for a safety rating.

options.resultDialogue: The sign displays TOTALLY SAFE in comic font. Pekora: 'Legally powerful-peko.'
The sign adds an E-shaped helmet. Miko wears it immediately. 'Certified.'
The sign displays SAFETY PENDING, COMEDY APPROVED. Niko wipes away a proud tear.

steps.prompt: The first guest asks who designed this.

options.resultDialogue: All three point at you. The attraction prints MANAGER'S MASTERPIECE. Betrayal becomes signage.
options.completionDialogue: The attraction opens under Management's name. The designers escape liability.

options.resultDialogue: Pekora bows. A liability waiver prints beside her. She stops bowing.
options.completionDialogue: Pekora receives full creative credit and immediately regrets legal recognition.

options.resultDialogue: The sign changes to DESIGNED BY NOBODY. Niko: 'Nobody is talented.'
options.completionDialogue: The attraction has no designer and several witnesses.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The island built an attraction from a brainstorming session. Brainstorming privileges are suspended.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Marine, Risu, and Ririka discover the island can automatically monetize anything they describe as premium.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Marine has merchandise. Risu has a calculator. Ririka has already asked whether sunlight has a free tier.

steps.prompt: The terminal asks for one premium service.

options.resultDialogue: Half the umbrellas gain velvet ropes. Risu whispers, 'We have monetized darkness.'
A photo booth rises behind Marine. 'At last, infrastructure with taste!'
A gold stripe appears on the sidewalk. Ririka: 'We just invented expensive legs.'

steps.prompt: The terminal asks for a free service to balance the plan.

options.resultDialogue: The screen displays COMPLIMENTARY OXYGEN. Risu looks disappointed. 'Missed opportunity.'
Speakers begin praising random guests. Marine stands under one. 'It is finally objective.'
Ririka approves free water. The terminal adds CUP NOT INCLUDED. She points at Risu. 'Did you touch it?'

steps.prompt: Management orders the optimization stopped.

options.resultDialogue: All premium signs vanish. Marine grabs the photo booth as it sinks. 'SENCHOU'S ASSET!'
options.completionDialogue: Revenue optimization ends with one rescued photo booth and three disappointed entrepreneurs.

options.resultDialogue: The terminal keeps PREMIUM NAP PILLOW. Risu nods. 'Civilization survives.'
options.completionDialogue: Most fees are removed. The nap economy remains unregulated.

options.resultDialogue: Ririka reads the numbers and goes quiet. 'Manager, the machine is better at capitalism than us.'
options.completionDialogue: Ririka completed the audit. Nobody liked the answer.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The island can monetize concepts. Management adds this sentence to the list of things never to tell Pekora.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Subaru, Kiara, and Reine are asked to improve pedestrian traffic. Kiara immediately proposes aviation.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kiara is pointing at the sky. Reine has drafted air-traffic etiquette. Subaru is already saying no.

steps.prompt: How should guests cross the crowded plaza?

options.resultDialogue: Arrows appear in midair. Subaru: 'GUESTS CANNOT FLY.' A trampoline unfolds below them. 'STOP HELPING!'
Gold footprints appear on the pavement. They refuse to step in puddles. Reine: 'Refined.'
A plain crosswalk appears. Everyone stares at it. Subaru: 'WHY IS NORMAL THE WEIRD ONE NOW?!'

steps.prompt: The system asks who should direct traffic.

options.resultDialogue: A whistle drops into her hand. Kiara: 'Flock Commander!' Subaru: 'DO NOT START.'
The lights change to wing-shaped signals. Reine: 'Tasteful.' Subaru: 'BIRD PROPAGANDA.'
Every crossing gets a tiny ceremonial bow. Traffic slows by 40%. Reine: 'Worth it.'

steps.prompt: A guest asks whether the new lane is permanent.

options.resultDialogue: The lane sign changes to TEMPORARY FOREVER. Subaru throws the whistle at it.
options.completionDialogue: The flight lane is temporary forever, a phrase Management refuses to define.

options.resultDialogue: A countdown appears. Kiara starts selling farewell tickets. Subaru: 'IT IS A CROSSWALK.'
options.completionDialogue: The route closes at sunset after receiving an unnecessary farewell ceremony.

options.resultDialogue: A seagull lands on the sign. Reine bows. Subaru walks away. 'I QUIT TRANSPORTATION.'
options.completionDialogue: Transportation policy is pending avian consultation.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The plaza traffic improves somehow. Subaru considers this the worst possible outcome.

evening.title: Day 10 - Please Stop Helping
evening.openingDialogue: The guests love the new attractions. The staff would like the island to become less attentive. This is the day's only discovery window.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Sora, Haachama, and Kanade test a stage that now reacts to menu descriptions.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Sora is checking microphones. Kanade is singing into the soup menu. Haachama has written SURPRISE on a covered dish.

steps.prompt: The menu needs a name for the house special.

options.resultDialogue: Warm lights turn on. Sora smiles. Everyone relaxes. Haachama looks suspicious of happiness.
Confetti bursts from the bowl. Kanade: 'See? Explosive, not illegal.'
The lid starts rattling. Sora gently puts a chair on it. 'Maybe surprise later.'

steps.prompt: The stage asks for the evening mood.

options.resultDialogue: The lights dim. Kanade whispers into the mic at full volume. Sora: 'That is not whispering.'
Haachama's dish gets its own spotlight. Everyone backs away. The dish bows.
Sora appears under a perfect spotlight. Kanade: 'The machine has favorites.'

steps.prompt: How do you end dinner service?

options.resultDialogue: A normal pudding arrives. Everyone applauds harder than the concert. Haachama: 'Cowards.'
options.completionDialogue: Dinner ends with pudding, the bravest menu item of the night.

options.resultDialogue: Kanade shouts ENCORE. The kitchen repeats every order at once. Sora reaches for the emergency mic.
options.completionDialogue: The encore is stopped before dessert achieves sentience.

options.resultDialogue: Everyone freezes. Haachama smiles. The stage displays REQUEST DENIED. Sora: 'Good system.'
options.completionDialogue: The stage develops self-preservation.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The dinner show succeeds. The stage now understands menu adjectives and fear. As the shift ends, the sea beyond the boardwalk lights up. A fourth pier is standing where open water was this morning.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Suisei, Noel, and Polka run a safety drill. The island mistakes it for a boss battle.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Polka has a megaphone. Noel has a rescue dummy. Suisei is asking why the dummy has a health bar.

steps.prompt: The drill begins. What is the first hazard?

options.resultDialogue: Foam blocks fall from the ceiling. Suisei cuts one in half. Polka: 'BONUS PHASE!'
Noel moves the wall. Not the door. The exit is now larger. 'Solved!'
Polka screams for realism. Everyone else panics because Polka is screaming. 'IMMERSION!'

steps.prompt: A giant SAFETY BOSS bar appears over the arena.

options.resultDialogue: Suisei smiles. The bar loses 30% before anyone sees what she did. Polka: 'I LOVE TRAINING.'
Noel carries the dummy, two staff, and a vending machine to safety. 'It looked scared.'
Polka announces PHASE TWO. The island actually starts phase two. Suisei turns to her. 'Stop naming phases.'

steps.prompt: The boss bar is at 1%. Finish the drill.

options.resultDialogue: The bar explodes into confetti. Suisei: 'Safety defeated.' Noel claps.
options.completionDialogue: The safety drill ends in victory. Management does not know what lost.

options.resultDialogue: Every hazard prop powers down. Polka whispers, 'Manager has admin commands.'
options.completionDialogue: The arena is safe, mostly because the Manager said the magic words.

options.resultDialogue: The boss bar respawns at full health. Everyone looks at you. '...Cancel rematch.'
options.completionDialogue: The rematch is canceled before safety becomes competitive.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The safety drill is complete. The island has learned the phrase boss phase and must never hear it again. As the shift ends, the sea beyond the boardwalk lights up. A fourth pier is standing where open water was this morning.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Elizabeth, Gigi, and Fauna are asked to write a simple survey. Gigi reaches the form first.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth has a clipboard. Fauna has tea. Gigi has changed the satisfaction scale from 1-5 to BIRD-EXPLOSION.

steps.prompt: What should the first survey question ask?

options.resultDialogue: Normal. Sensible. Gigi adds OR COWARDLY. Elizabeth takes the pen away.
The kiosk starts booking return visits for anyone who says yes. Fauna: 'Efficient. Predatory, but efficient.'
Gigi writes BIRD before the options load. Elizabeth slowly pulls her chair out. 'We are not doing this again.'

steps.prompt: The winning guest request is: 'More nature.'

options.resultDialogue: Flowers bloom around the kiosk. Fauna smiles. Gigi: 'Nature patch successful.'
A sapling bursts through the feedback box. Elizabeth: 'The comments are now inaccessible.' Fauna: 'No more complaints.'
The kiosk prints MORE. Gigi points. 'The people have spoken.'

steps.prompt: How do you close the survey?

options.resultDialogue: The kiosk says YOU'RE WELCOME first. Elizabeth: 'It has become smug.'
options.completionDialogue: The survey closes with excellent satisfaction and unacceptable confidence.

options.resultDialogue: Gigi's BIRD option somehow wins 62%. Elizabeth silently folds the chart in half.
options.completionDialogue: The results are published without the unauthorized avian category.

options.resultDialogue: Fauna writes: Guests happy. Island weird. Please water plants. Everyone signs it.
options.completionDialogue: Fauna produces the first report all day that does not alter reality.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Guest satisfaction is excellent. The survey itself has been placed under observation. As the shift ends, the sea beyond the boardwalk lights up. A fourth pier is standing where open water was this morning.

days.storyBeat: A fourth pier is standing beyond the lighthouse. Nobody knows who built it. By breakfast, this has somehow become a zoning dispute.

morning.title: Day 11 - There Wasn't a Pier Here Yesterday
morning.openingDialogue: The pier exists. Management has chosen to begin with paperwork instead of screaming.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Chihaya, Gura, and Raden decide what kind of road a pier is.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Chihaya has a golf cart. Gura has declared the ocean a lane. Raden is reading a zoning pamphlet upside down.

steps.prompt: How should the new pier be classified?

options.resultDialogue: Chihaya nods. A speed-limit sign rises from the deck. Gura: "For boats?" Chihaya: "For cowards."
Gura stamps the form herself. "Dock confirmed." Raden: "You used a ketchup packet." "Official red ink."
Raden writes it down. Three deck chairs appear. Chihaya: "Zoning has surrendered."

steps.prompt: Chihaya insists the golf cart needs a test lap.

options.resultDialogue: Chihaya brakes perfectly. Gura flies into a beach towel rack. "Brakes work." "I noticed."
Gura points straight ahead. "Ocean." Chihaya: "Correct." The cart stops one centimeter from the edge. Raden applauds the geography lesson.
Raden begins a historical lecture. Chihaya completes four laps before she reaches 1923. "We have time for another century."

steps.prompt: The cart parks itself at the end of the pier and honks at the ocean.

options.resultDialogue: Chihaya stamps PASSED. Gura: "Can a cart have a license?" "It earned one before Miko."
You stamp FAILED. The cart honks twice. Raden: "It has lodged an appeal."
The cart reverses perfectly into its space. Chihaya removes her sunglasses. "I have been professionally threatened."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The pier now has a speed limit, a licensed golf cart, and no agreed definition of road.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Anya, Chloe, and Okayu test a railing that seems overly invested in safety.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A new sign reads DO NOT LEAN. Anya is leaning on it. Chloe is pretending not to. Okayu brought a pillow.

steps.prompt: Who tests the railing?

options.resultDialogue: Anya leans harder. The sign changes to PLEASE. She looks at it. "Weak."
Chloe taps the rail. "Solid." A second sign appears: CHLOE STOP. "This place is biased."
Okayu lies across it. "Comfortable." The sign gives up and turns around.

steps.prompt: A tourist asks why the sign keeps changing.

options.resultDialogue: The sign prints PREMIUM INTERACTION. Chloe: "Manager, you monetized a warning."
The sign prints I AM FINE. Anya: "It is defensive now."
Okayu closes her eyes. The sign prints NAP ZONE. "Good sign."

steps.prompt: The railing passes inspection. The sign demands a rating.

options.resultDialogue: Five stars light up on the rail. Chloe: "It reviewed itself."
The sign falls flat. Anya: "Critical hit."
The sign prints COWARD. Okayu laughs without opening her eyes.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The railing is safe. Its personality remains unlicensed.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Fuwamoco, Ayame, and Nene hold a grand opening nobody requested.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Fuwamoco have a ribbon. Ayame has scissors. Nene has already married the ribbon.

steps.prompt: Who cuts the ribbon?

options.resultDialogue: Ayame snips once. The whole ribbon falls into perfect bows. Nene: "Husband babies!"
"BAU BAU!" They pull opposite ends. The ribbon launches Nene into a flower bed. "MARRIAGE IS HARD!"
Nene refuses. "You cannot cut my husband." Ayame quietly cuts the other ribbon.

steps.prompt: The first tourists sprint onto the pier.

options.resultDialogue: Fuwamoco run beside them. Ayame walks and somehow wins. "Eh?"
Nene points at the crowd. "NEW HUSBANDS!" Half the tourists accelerate. Half turn around.
Ayame waves once. Three tourists faint peacefully. Fuwamoco start a recovery pile.

steps.prompt: The opening needs a final announcement.

options.resultDialogue: Fuwamoco shout it together. The PA answers BAU BAU. Everyone freezes. Then the crowd cheers.
Nene shouts it. Everyone stops. Nene keeps running. "MANAGEMENT EXEMPTION!"
Ayame says it softly. The fireworks launcher goes off at 9:12 AM. "Fun arrived."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The fourth pier is officially open, according to a ceremony nobody remembers scheduling.

noon.title: Day 11 - Under the Pier
noon.openingDialogue: Noon is the day's only discovery window. Three teams inspect the maintenance layer below the new pier.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Amelia, Iroha, and Koyori inspect the maintenance hatch under the pier.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Amelia has a magnifying glass. Iroha has a rope. Koyori has already labeled the hatch SCIENCE DOOR.

steps.prompt: The hatch wheel will not move.

options.resultDialogue: Iroha turns carefully. The entire frame rotates. "The door opened sideways, de gozaru."
Koyori sprays one drop. The wheel spins for thirty seconds. Amelia: "Too scientific."
Amelia finds a latch labeled PUSH. She pushes it. Iroha quietly hides the rope.

steps.prompt: Below is a dead terminal asking for authorization.

options.resultDialogue: You tap your badge. The screen wakes immediately. Amelia: "That was alarmingly polite."
The terminal flashes SECURITY ACCEPTED. Iroha: "Finally, paperwork respects me."
It prints RESEARCHER: SUPERVISION ADVISED. Koyori: "Defamation."

steps.prompt: The terminal displays CALIBRATION 2 / 4 and one blinking button.

options.resultDialogue: The room hums once. CALIBRATION 2 / 4 becomes COMPLETE. Amelia: "Case solved." Koyori: "We do not know the case."
Iroha taps it. The lights turn on in perfect order. "That was suspiciously easy."
Koyori presses it with a pen. COMPLETE. "Science has triumphed over one button."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The chamber powers down after displaying CALIBRATION 2 / 4 — COMPLETE. Nobody knows what was calibrated.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Calli, Shiori, and Bijou enter through a service stair below the pier.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Calli is reading AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY. Shiori is delighted. Bijou is checking whether the letters are collectible.

steps.prompt: The stairwell asks for a reason to enter.

options.resultDialogue: The door opens. Calli: "Boring works." Shiori writes that down like a threat.
The door opens halfway. Shiori slips through. "Academic privilege."
Bijou points at a blinking light. The door opens fully. "My credentials are radiant."

steps.prompt: An old manual is chained to the console.

options.resultDialogue: Shiori flips to page one. It is blank. Page two says DO NOT REMOVE MANUAL. "Excellent start."
Calli reads three pages. "This is all safety warnings." Bijou: "Skip to loot."
Bijou taps the chain. A tiny gem icon lights up on the console. "It recognizes quality."

steps.prompt: The console wakes: CALIBRATION 2 / 4.

options.resultDialogue: One button. One beep. COMPLETE. Calli: "That was less dramatic than the sign."
Shiori photographs the screen. It switches to COMPLETE before the shutter clicks. "Impatient archive."

options.text: Let Bijou press the shiny button
options.resultDialogue: Bijou presses it. COMPLETE. "Best dungeon ever."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The old console completes its second calibration and immediately refuses further questions.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Botan, Towa, and Lui inspect the under-pier service room.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Botan has marked every exit. Towa has the safety sheet. Lui has the expression of someone expecting all of this to become her paperwork.

steps.prompt: The service door opens inward into a wall.

options.resultDialogue: Botan points left. A second door is already open. "The building felt embarrassed."
Towa removes one screw. The door behaves. Lui: "Devilish." Towa: "Finally."
Lui writes DOOR INSTALLED WRONG. The wall slides aside. She stops writing.

steps.prompt: A terminal asks WHO IS RESPONSIBLE.

options.resultDialogue: Botan presses her name. It prints ACCEPTABLE. "Harsh score."
It prints DEVIL. Towa smiles. Then: HELPFUL. "DELETE THAT."
The terminal instantly unlocks everything. Lui slowly looks at you. "Interesting."

steps.prompt: The final screen reads CALIBRATION 2 / 4.

options.resultDialogue: COMPLETE. Botan checks for traps. There are none. "Most suspicious part."
Towa presses the button. COMPLETE. "My evil plan was pressing one button."
Lui presses it. COMPLETE. A receipt prints. She tears it up immediately.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The service room reports CALIBRATION 2 / 4 — COMPLETE. Lui keeps the receipt anyway.

evening.title: Day 11 - Pier After Dark
evening.openingDialogue: The mystery can wait until tomorrow. Tonight, the new pier needs food, safety rules, and a closing time.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gura, Moona, and Iofi open the first night market on the new pier.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Gura has seafood signs. Moona has moon lamps. Iofi has painted every price tag into a tiny UFO.

steps.prompt: What should the first stall sell?

options.resultDialogue: Gura writes SHARK SNACKS. A tourist asks if they are for sharks. "Yes." "What are they?" "Snacks."
Moona dims the stall. Every cup glows. Gura: "Can mine say A?" It does.
Iofi paints three rocks. They sell out. Moona: "Those were pier rocks." "Now they have lore."

steps.prompt: A lamp starts following one customer.

options.resultDialogue: The guest poses. Iofi starts charging photography fees. Moona: "We invented celebrity by accident."
Gura jumps. The lamp dodges. "It has footwork!"
Moona snaps her fingers. Every other lamp dims instead. "It has seniority."

steps.prompt: Close the market?

options.resultDialogue: Gura shouts LAST CALL. The ocean echoes it back. Nobody comments.
Iofi sells the CLOSED sign. "We need another sign."
Moona turns off the moon lamps. The pier lights bow one by one. Gura bows back.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The first night market closes profitably. One lamp refuses to clock out.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Flare, Lamy, and Ollie supervise a strict no-fireworks zone.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Flare has the permit sheet. Lamy has ice buckets. Ollie is holding a rocket labeled NOT FIREWORK.

steps.prompt: Ollie insists the rocket is decorative.

options.resultDialogue: Flare takes it. It fires from her hand. She watches it leave. "Paperwork first. Anger second."
Lamy freezes the fuse. Ollie: "Now it is a popsicle." "Do not eat it."
Ollie smiles. The rocket explodes into a banner reading THANK YOU MANAGER. Flare: "You were saying?"

steps.prompt: Guests start chanting FIREWORKS.

options.resultDialogue: The crowd quiets. Ollie whispers "cowards" into the microphone.
Snow falls over the pier. A tourist cheers CHRISTMAS. Lamy: "Wrong season. Keep cheering."
Ollie screams BOOM every three seconds. Flare: "I preferred explosives."

steps.prompt: The final rocket somehow returns.

options.resultDialogue: Lamy freezes it midair. Ollie: "We caught a firework." Flare: "Do not adopt it."
Flare catches the stick, removes the fuse, and hands Ollie a cardboard tube. "Same experience."
Everyone runs. The rocket lands harmlessly in the launch box. Flare returns first. "Cowardice was efficient."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The no-fireworks zone records three fireworks and zero injuries. Management calls this partial success.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Mio, Korone, and Shion try to close the fourth pier for the night.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Mio has a closing checklist. Korone has hidden under a bench. Shion says curfews do not apply to witches.

steps.prompt: Who clears the last guests?

options.resultDialogue: Mio says, "Time to go." Everyone leaves. Korone emerges. "Scary."
Korone shouts CLOSING TIME and starts chasing people gently. The pier empties in nine seconds.
Shion casts a closing spell. The OPEN sign goes to sleep. She points proudly. "Magic."

steps.prompt: Korone refuses to leave.

options.resultDialogue: Okayu is not here. Korone accepts anyway. "Portable Okayu." Mio: "Do not call food that."
Shion snaps. Korone disappears. A bark comes from the lighthouse roof. Mio: "Bring her back."
Mio looks at Korone. Korone stands up immediately. "I remembered bedtime."

steps.prompt: The lights switch off by themselves.

options.resultDialogue: Mio checks the box. The checklist checks itself. She closes it very slowly.
Shion turns one on. The other twenty come back too. "They are clingy."
Korone waves. Every light flashes once. "Good dog pier."
Mio refuses. "We are not arresting the lights." Korone: "Yet."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The pier closes for the night. The lights appear to understand bedtime.

days.storyBeat: The fourth pier now has benches, vending machines, signs, and a complaint box. Nobody remembers ordering any of them.

morning.title: Day 12 - Pier Season
morning.openingDialogue: The new pier has survived one night. By sunrise, three committees have claimed responsibility for improving it.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Pekora, Miko, and Polka are asked to name three attractions.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Pekora has sponsorship forms. Miko has crayons. Polka has already named a bench.

steps.prompt: Name the scenic lookout.

options.resultDialogue: A gold E appears over the railing. Miko: "Brand recognition." Pekora: "Trademark fee-peko."
A carrot sign appears. Pekora: "The land recognizes ownership-peko." Polka: "Tax it."
The bench gets curtains. Miko: "Why?" Polka: "Premium horizon."

steps.prompt: Name the emergency stairs.

options.resultDialogue: The stairs gain a finish line. Pekora starts timing tourists.
Miko takes one step, slips, and lands at the bottom. "Fast."
Polka installs applause signs. The stairs clap when people leave.

steps.prompt: Management asks them to stop naming things.

options.resultDialogue: All three nod. A sign appears: NAMING AREA CLOSED. Polka names the sign Kevin.
Pekora writes MANAGEMENT LIABILITY ZONE. You take the marker away.
Miko writes PIER. Nothing changes. She looks offended. "Too normal."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The Tourism Board is dissolved before the emergency stairs become a competitive event.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Marine, Risu, and Ririka attempt to establish a pier economy before lunch.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Marine has souvenirs. Risu has exchange rates. Ririka has asked why the ocean is free.

steps.prompt: What becomes the pier currency?

options.resultDialogue: Risu nods. "Stable." Marine holds up a seashell. "Counterfeit?" Risu: "Nature crime."
Marine prints her face on them. Ririka: "That is not currency." Marine: "It has confidence."
Ririka launches an app. Risu already found a loophole. "We have been live twelve seconds."

steps.prompt: A tourist asks to exchange one coconut.

options.resultDialogue: Risu examines it. "Two shells." The coconut falls open with three coins inside. She revises: "Five."
Marine stamps PIRATE TREASURE on it. Its value triples instantly. Ririka stares at the market board.
The kiosk prints COCONUT FUTURES. Ririka: "I did not authorize finance."

steps.prompt: Close the market.

options.resultDialogue: Risu hugs the register. Marine hugs the souvenir rack. Ririka hugs the audit report. Nobody hugs you.
Marine: "Senchou cannot refund memories." Ririka: "We are refunding coupons."
Risu keeps PREMIUM NAP SHADE. "Civilization."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The pier economy closes before anyone successfully derivatives the ocean.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Subaru, Kiara, and Gigi manage the first ferry queue to the new pier.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Subaru has a whistle. Kiara has a boarding speech. Gigi has labeled Gate B as BIRD.

steps.prompt: The line splits around a trash can.

options.resultDialogue: One whistle blast fixes the line. Kiara: "Natural flock leadership." Subaru points the whistle at her.
She labels them WINGS LEFT and WINGS RIGHT. Subaru: "PEOPLE HAVE HANDS."
Gigi arrests it first. "Obstacle neutralized." The line applauds.

steps.prompt: The ferry captain asks for a boarding signal.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru blows once. Every seagull nearby takes off. Gigi points upward. "Backup arrived."
Kiara reaches paragraph four. The ferry leaves without them. "It feared greatness."
Gigi yells GO. The ferry horn answers. She gasps. "BOAT FRIEND."

steps.prompt: Last passenger boarded.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru closes it. A sign prints FLOCK SECURED. She tears it down.
Kiara waves. The ferry horn plays a perfect fanfare. "Finally, respect."
Gigi counts twenty-three humans, one bag, and "two suspicious vibes."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The ferry leaves on time. Subaru refuses the title Transit Flock Commander.

noon.title: Day 12 - Amenities Included
noon.openingDialogue: The pier is becoming suspiciously convenient. Management chooses not to reward initiative.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kaela, Kobo, and Zeta inspect the pier facilities that appeared overnight.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela is testing bolts. Zeta is checking cameras. Kobo found a button labeled MIST.

steps.prompt: Inspect the new bench.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela sits. The bench lowers two centimeters and displays HEAVY DUTY MODE. "Good bench."
Zeta finds six sensors. "Why does a bench need eyes?" Kobo waves at it.
The bench sprays everyone. Kaela: "Feature confirmed." Kobo: "Again."

steps.prompt: Inspect the vending machine.

options.resultDialogue: It dispenses a wrench. Kaela keeps it. "Correct product now."
Zeta presses REFUND. Every coin returns. "Elite hacking."
Kobo selects MYSTERY. The machine dispenses another MIST button. "Expansion pack."

steps.prompt: Final rating?

options.resultDialogue: Kaela stamps it. The bench stamps back. She nods respectfully.
Zeta writes NEEDS WORK. Three maintenance carts arrive. "I regret feedback."
The kiosk prints IMPOSSIBLE. Kobo looks deeply honored.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The amenities pass inspection, except for their growing confidence.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Sora, Haachama, and IRyS run lunch on the fourth pier.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Sora has the menu. IRyS has the register. Haachama has a covered pot nobody approved.

steps.prompt: Choose the special.

options.resultDialogue: A normal lunch arrives. Everyone relaxes. Haachama: "Cowards."
IRyS serves a parfait with two spoons. One is labeled HOPE, one DESPAIR. "Branding."
The pot lid rattles. Sora places both hands on it. "We can save this for staff meal."

steps.prompt: A customer asks for something unforgettable.

options.resultDialogue: Sora sings one line. The entire cafe goes silent. Haachama writes SINGING FEE on the menu.
The dessert arrives on fire and ice at once. IRyS: "Balanced."
The customer takes one bite. "Amazing." Everyone stares. Haachama stares hardest.

steps.prompt: Lunch rush ends.

options.resultDialogue: Sora flips the sign. It bows. She bows back. Nobody mentions it.
IRyS says ENCORE. Three puddings arrive. "I meant musically."
The mop refuses to move. Haachama: "Even tools fear genius."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The cafe survives lunch and one statistically impossible good Haachama dish.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Aki, Reine, and Fauna manage a suspiciously luxurious rest deck.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Aki found a hammock. Reine found a bell. Fauna found six plants that were not there yesterday.

steps.prompt: A guest asks for maximum relaxation.

options.resultDialogue: Aki demonstrates. The hammock rotates once and deposits her gently on the floor. "Advanced relaxation."
Reine rings the bell. Three umbrellas open at once. "Acceptable."
Vines weave a chair. Fauna smiles. The chair hugs the guest. "Maybe slightly affectionate."

steps.prompt: The deck advertises PREMIUM BREEZE.
