options.resultDialogue: One perfect breeze hits Reine only. Aki: "Royal subscription."
The breeze hits everyone at once. Fauna: "Communism, but for air."
The sign changes to NATURAL BREEZE. Nothing changes. Reine: "Rebranding."

steps.prompt: Close the rest area.

options.resultDialogue: Aki rings the bell. Reine: "That was my bell."
Fauna posts QUIET. The waves lower themselves. Everyone stares. Fauna whispers, "Nice."
Aki grabs it. The hammock retracts into the floor. "It has tenure."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The rest area closes quietly. The premium breeze remains under investigation.

evening.title: Day 12 - Official Enough
evening.openingDialogue: The pier settles into normal resort life. The word normal is doing dangerous work.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Suisei, Noel, and Cecilia test a new mini-golf course.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Noel has a putter. Cecilia has a scanner. Suisei is asking why the windmill has a boss bar.

steps.prompt: Hole one is blocked by a tiny castle.

options.resultDialogue: The ball passes through the castle wall. Noel: "Gentle." Cecilia scans the wall. "Former wall."
The boss bar drops to 40%. Suisei: "Par."
Cecilia gives a perfect angle. The ball stops one millimeter short. "Physics is petty."

steps.prompt: The windmill starts chasing the ball.

options.resultDialogue: Suisei turns around. The windmill stops. Noel: "Did you threaten architecture?"
Noel grabs one blade. The entire building rotates instead. "Oops."
The windmill becomes a score judge. It gives Cecilia 11/10. "Objective machine."

steps.prompt: Final hole?

options.resultDialogue: Everyone does. The course looks disappointed. Suisei: "Good."
Confetti fires. Noel: "We did not finish." Cecilia: "The system values confidence."
Suisei smiles. Cecilia immediately powers the course down. "Preventive maintenance."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Mini-golf is safe, provided nobody calls the windmill a boss.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kanade, Niko, and AZKi turn the complaint desk into karaoke by accident.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kanade has the microphone. Niko has cue cards. AZKi has discovered the complaint terminal accepts songs.

steps.prompt: A guest complains the pier is too loud.

options.resultDialogue: Kanade sings SORRY at full volume. The complaint meter rises. AZKi: "Technically worse."
Niko whispers an apology. The terminal adds LAUGH TRACK. "I have a producer."
The meter drops to zero. Kanade: "Pay-to-win vocals."

steps.prompt: Next complaint: not enough music.

options.resultDialogue: Kanade screams "I KNEW IT!" The meter breaks.
Niko makes a three-second jingle. It plays every time someone complains. Instant regret.
AZKi picks one calm track. The terminal requests encore before it ends. "Needy."

steps.prompt: Close the desk.

options.resultDialogue: AZKi presses mute. Kanade keeps singing. Niko: "Analog threat."
All three sing. The complaint printer produces THANK YOU. Niko frames it.
The microphone retracts. Kanade grabs it midair. "CENSORSHIP!"

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The complaint desk closes with fewer complaints and significantly more music.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Mel, Roboco, and Elizabeth patrol the fourth pier after closing.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth has a lantern. Roboco has motion sensors. Mel has somehow been issued a garlic-shaped flashlight.

steps.prompt: A shadow moves under the benches.

options.resultDialogue: "Reveal yourself!" A cleaning robot emerges. Elizabeth lowers the lantern. "Carry on."
Roboco: "Small, round, armed with brushes." Mel: "Deadly."
The robot reverses. Mel: "Even machines respect folklore."

steps.prompt: The official resort map updates while they watch.

options.resultDialogue: The map says AUGUST 12. Elizabeth: "At least the map knows when it is."
Roboco saves BEFORE and AFTER. Both files now show the pier. "Rude."
Mel adds a heart. The printed maps gain the same heart. She slowly puts the pen down.

steps.prompt: Patrol report?

options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth signs it. The form adds MOSTLY. She crosses it out.
Roboco writes MAP WEIRD. The printer replies NOTED. "I dislike customer service now."
Mel writes it. Elizabeth: "We are not putting that in the official report."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Night patrol ends. Every official map now includes the fourth pier as if it always did.

days.storyBeat: Guests begin making oddly specific requests. The resort has become disturbingly good at customer service.

morning.title: Day 13 - Guest Requests
morning.openingDialogue: Every request desk is busy. The island seems determined to receive five stars.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Chihaya, Aqua, and Luna operate a hotel cart for one impossible reservation.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Chihaya has the keys. Aqua has the luggage. Luna has declared the back seat a throne.

steps.prompt: The guest asks for Room 204.

options.resultDialogue: The sign points left, then right, then left again. Aqua: "It is comboing us."
Chihaya takes one turn. The cart arrives at Room 204. Luna: "Again."
Luna points forward. "There." A door labeled 204 slides into view. Aqua drops the luggage.

steps.prompt: The guest says Room 204 should have an ocean view.

options.resultDialogue: The ocean is outside. Aqua: "We are on the third floor." Chihaya: "Strong ocean."
Luna says "closer." The bed slides ten centimeters toward the window. Everyone stops talking.
Aqua hands over a postcard. The window displays the same picture. "Budget solution."

steps.prompt: Checkout asks how the taxi service was.

options.resultDialogue: The receipt prints 300 HORSEPOWER. Chihaya frames it.
Luna receives a tiny crown icon. Aqua: "Why does the cart have achievements?"
The receipt prints AGREED. Aqua: "Finally, honest software."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The guest reaches Room 204. Management declines to verify where Room 204 currently is.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Anya, Okayu, and Chloe deliver breakfast to a guest with extremely literal requests.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Anya has the tray. Okayu has eaten one rice ball. Chloe insists the missing rice ball is an accounting issue.

steps.prompt: The guest asks for breakfast in bed.

options.resultDialogue: Anya sets the tray down. The bed rolls into the hallway. "Breakfast has taken the bed."
Okayu lies beside the tray. "Breakfast. Bed." Chloe: "Technically compliant."
Chloe: "One breakfast. One bed." A second bed arrives. "I hate exact wording."

steps.prompt: The guest asks for a little more coffee.

options.resultDialogue: One drop lands in the cup. The guest stares. Anya: "You specified."
The cup becomes ninety percent milk. "More gentle."
A tiny coffee cup arrives inside the normal cup. Chloe: "The hotel is mocking me."

steps.prompt: The guest asks for the bill.

options.resultDialogue: A duck walks in. Everyone looks at Chloe. "Not my department."
The printer behaves. Anya: "We found the safe word."
Okayu is already asleep. The printer adds NAP CHARGE. Chloe tears it up.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Room service succeeds after Management bans the word bill from hotel requests.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Ao, Raden, and Hajime turn a complaint seminar into accidental entertainment.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ao is trying to look professional. Raden has a microphone. Hajime has written COMPLAINT BATTLE on the whiteboard.

steps.prompt: First complaint: the resort is too confusing.

options.resultDialogue: Ao leans coolly on the desk. The desk rolls away. She keeps leaning for two full seconds.
Raden begins with ancient hospitality. The guest forgets the complaint and asks for citations.
Hajime points at the map. "I will defeat it." She gets lost behind the curtain.

steps.prompt: Second complaint: staff are too loud.

options.resultDialogue: Hajime whispers aggressively. It is somehow louder. Raden: "Technique."
Ao poses silently. A fan screams from the audience. "Not my fault."
Raden performs the complaint itself. The complainant applauds. Case closed by adaptation.

steps.prompt: Final complaint: this feels like a show.

options.resultDialogue: A spotlight turns on. Ao: "Bad timing."
Raden checks the crowd. Hajime already made wristbands. "Business battle!"
Hajime bows. The applause meter appears. "We had a meter?!"

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The complaint seminar receives five-star reviews from the people who came to complain.

noon.title: Day 13 - Exact Wording
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, staff have learned that vague requests are a workplace hazard.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Shion, Bijou, and Koyori investigate a reservation that exists only when nobody looks at it.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Shion calls it magic. Koyori calls it quantum paperwork. Bijou calls the confirmation number shiny.

steps.prompt: The reservation vanishes from the screen.

options.resultDialogue: The booking returns with PURPLE ROOM selected. "Magic." Koyori: "You clicked undo."
Koyori starts recording. The reservation behaves perfectly. "Stage fright."
The confirmation number turns into a gem icon. Bijou: "It likes me."

steps.prompt: The booking now says PARTY SIZE: MANY.

options.resultDialogue: Two chairs appear beside the desk. Shion: "Convenient spell."
The screen prints MANY. Koyori: "Peer review failed."
Bijou enters 4.2. Four chairs and one cushion appear. "Precision."

steps.prompt: Confirm the reservation?

options.resultDialogue: The printer says SEE YOU YESTERDAY. Shion: "Finally, my kind of booking."
The screen says ALREADY ATTENDED. Koyori stops smiling. "Rude."
The screen marks YOU unresolved. Bijou: "Manager debuff."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The reservation remains valid, somehow. Nobody agrees on which tense it occupies.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Watame, Lamy, and Nene manage picnic reservations on the beach.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Watame has baskets. Lamy has cold drinks. Nene has booked Table Husband for twelve.

steps.prompt: A family requests a shady table.

options.resultDialogue: Watame leads them under a tree. The tree lowers one branch politely. Lamy: "Well trained."
Lamy builds a tiny ice roof. Watame: "Luxury freezer."
A picnic table rolls over by itself. Nene opens her arms. "HE CAME!"

steps.prompt: The basket list says one item is missing.

options.resultDialogue: Watame has it in her mouth. Silence. "Quality control."
Lamy counts twice. "All present." Nene: "One became husband." "That is still present."
The label prints APPLE. Nene pulls out an apple. "Smart basket husband."

steps.prompt: Picnic service closes.

options.resultDialogue: Every table rolls back except Husband Table. Nene: "He chose me."
Watame packs everything except the bread. Lamy writes EXPECTED LOSS.
Lamy melts it. One guest applauds. "Thank you for respecting basic physics."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Picnic service ends with all guests accounted for and one table in a committed relationship.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Iroha, Lui, and Choco escort a VIP who keeps requesting impossible privacy.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Iroha is on security. Lui has the schedule. Choco is carrying enough sunscreen to sedate a horse.

steps.prompt: The VIP asks for nobody to look at them.

options.resultDialogue: Iroha turns the corner. Every tourist politely faces the wall. "Too effective, de gozaru."
Three privacy screens unfold. One follows the VIP. Lui: "Helpful. Creepy."
The VIP puts them on. Choco: "Now you cannot see them looking."

steps.prompt: The VIP asks for a private beach.

options.resultDialogue: A sign appears: PRIVATE BEACH - 3 MINUTES. Lui: "We have a time-share coastline."
A perfect cove is behind the next gate. Iroha checks the map. "It was not yesterday."
Choco sends them to bed instead. The private beach request disappears. "Medical override."

steps.prompt: Escort complete.

options.resultDialogue: Lui writes NORMAL. The form underlines it twice.
Iroha bows. The security gate bows too. "Please stop copying me."
Choco checks your pulse. "Manager stress: resort-shaped."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The VIP leaves satisfied. Management quietly deletes private coastline from the request menu.

evening.title: Day 13 - Last Service
evening.openingDialogue: Evening is the day's only finding window. Three unrelated cleanup jobs uncover the same forgotten piece of resort transit hardware.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Shiori, Nerissa, and Ina inspect a break room behind a door that appeared after closing.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Shiori found an old staff door. Nerissa found a dusty intercom. Ina found a chair and has already sat down.

steps.prompt: The door has no handle.

options.resultDialogue: The door opens. Shiori: "Etiquette survives."
The lock harmonizes and opens. Ina: "Musical security-wah."
She draws one. It becomes usable. Shiori: "Do not show Maintenance."

steps.prompt: Inside is an old employee locker labeled Z.

options.resultDialogue: Inside is one brass route token. Shiori: "A very dramatic bus coin."
Ina taps the lock. A tentacle turns the dial. "Teamwork."
Nerissa says "locker." It clicks open. "Voice assistant from hell."

steps.prompt: The token is stamped ROUTE Z.

options.resultDialogue: The nearby wall map lights one thin line toward the central hill. Then it goes dark.
The door opens to the hallway you just left. Nerissa: "Excellent transportation."
The token hums once near Ina. She hands it back. "It is thinking too loudly-wah."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: An old brass ROUTE Z token is recovered. For one second, a forgotten transit line appears on the wall map.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Moona, Iofi, and Ollie investigate a dead tram sign near the pier.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Moona is reading the timetable. Iofi is repainting it. Ollie is waiting for a tram that has not run in years.

steps.prompt: The sign says LAST SERVICE: --/--/----.

options.resultDialogue: It displays TONIGHT. Ollie: "WE HAVE A DATE WITH PUBLIC TRANSPORT!"
The drawing lights up. Moona: "That is not reassuring."
Something dings underground. Ollie screams louder in victory.

steps.prompt: A ticket slot opens in the wall.

options.resultDialogue: Inside is a brass token stamped ROUTE Z. Ollie: "LOOT TRAIN!"
Iofi pulls out the ROUTE Z token and sketches it. The sketch points inland. "That was not me."
The slot glows. A ROUTE Z token slides out like exact change.

steps.prompt: The old timetable flickers.

options.resultDialogue: One line appears from the pier to the central hill. Then blank. Moona: "Short schedule."
The wall says NOT YET. Ollie: "Rude train."
Iofi takes a photo. The route line is visible in the photo even after the sign goes dark.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The dead tram stop produces a ROUTE Z token and one impossible inland route before shutting down.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Riona, Su, and Vivi clear old stage storage after a door opens behind the amphitheater.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Riona is carrying boxes. Su is scanning labels. Vivi found a crate marked TRANSIT and wants to make it content.

steps.prompt: The TRANSIT crate is locked.

options.resultDialogue: Riona pulls once. The lid opens. "I was being gentle." Vivi: "Clip that."
Su reads the barcode. "Item: one token. Why did it spoil the loot?"
Vivi starts a countdown. The lock pops at zero. Riona: "It has stage instincts."

steps.prompt: Inside is a brass token stamped ROUTE Z.

options.resultDialogue: Su gets one result: TRANSIT AUTHORIZATION. "Very specific coin."
Riona taps it on a stage door. The door shows an arrow toward the central hill.
Vivi holds it up. The floor lights a route line under her feet. "Best unboxing."

steps.prompt: The route line vanishes after ten seconds.

options.resultDialogue: Su bags it. "No more content with infrastructure." Vivi: "Coward."
Riona tapes an arrow to the floor. The arrow rotates after they leave. "Great."
Vivi says bye. A hidden speaker says BYE back. She restarts the stream.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW recovers a ROUTE Z token and briefly lights an old path beneath the resort.

days.storyBeat: A banner appears overnight announcing a summer festival for today. Nobody scheduled it. Canceling would disappoint the guests, so Management makes the worst reasonable decision.

morning.title: Day 14 - Festival Somehow
morning.openingDialogue: The resort wakes up decorated. The committees form faster than the investigation.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Pekora, Miko, and Marine discover a SUMMER FESTIVAL TODAY banner nobody ordered.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Pekora is selling stall permits. Miko says she organized everything. Marine says Senchou has been booked as guest of honor.

steps.prompt: Who actually scheduled the festival?

options.resultDialogue: Miko nods confidently. "Exactly." Pekora: "When-peko?" Miko: "Spiritually."
Pekora produces a contract signed RABBIT. Marine: "That is a drawing." "Legally fluffy-peko."
Marine gasps. "At last, recognition!" The banner adds HOSTED BY SENCHOU. She cries.

steps.prompt: Choose the festival centerpiece.

options.resultDialogue: Flare is not here. Pekora notices. Her smile becomes a workplace hazard.
Miko points at an empty lot. A tiny shrine booth unfolds. "See? Planning."
A pirate stage rises. Marine: "The island has taste." Pekora starts charging backstage access.

steps.prompt: Management asks for a safety plan.

options.resultDialogue: Pekora writes NO INCIDENTS PLANNED. You take the pen.
Miko draws a helmet on the map. "Protected."
Marine writes SENCHOU SURVIVES. "The key metric."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The festival committee approves an event nobody can prove was proposed.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Risu, Ririka, and Polka run festival admission.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Risu has a cash box. Ririka has pricing tiers. Polka has printed a VIP ticket shaped like her face.

steps.prompt: Set the entry price.

options.resultDialogue: Risu goes pale. Ririka steadies her. Polka: "We can charge for exiting." Both stare at her.
The ticket machine prints ELEVEN. Ririka: "Negotiating upward by itself."
Polka opens a velvet rope around the entire beach. Risu: "Artificial scarcity. Beautiful."

steps.prompt: A child offers a shiny rock instead.

options.resultDialogue: Risu inspects it. "Premium mineral currency." Ririka: "Do not start a second economy."
The machine prints CHARITY DETECTED and plays applause. Ririka: "Do not make this weird."
Polka receives the rock and declares herself richer. The child gets backstage access. Management loses twice.

steps.prompt: Ticket booth closes.

options.resultDialogue: Risu counts twice. "We made money." Ririka: "How?" Polka: "Art."
Polka dives onto the pile. "MY CHILDREN!"
Risu pockets one rock. Ririka sees her. Nothing is said.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Festival admission somehow turns a profit despite three incompatible accounting systems.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Subaru, Kiara, and Gigi manage the festival parade without a float.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Subaru has the route. Kiara has feathers. Gigi has stolen a traffic cone and promoted it.

steps.prompt: What leads the parade?

options.resultDialogue: Subaru blows the whistle. The crowd follows. Kiara: "Natural flock behavior." "I WILL END THIS PARADE."
Kiara spreads her arms. A fan turns on behind her. "Wind machine acquired." Subaru: "That is a leaf blower."
Gigi marches with the cone on her head. The crowd copies her. "UNIFORM ACHIEVED."

steps.prompt: The route ends at the wrong stage.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru turns everyone around. The parade now has an encore. She hates efficiency.
Kiara bows. The scheduled act arrives behind her. "Collab!"
Gigi points left. Everyone goes right. She nods. "They understand freedom."

steps.prompt: Parade finale?

options.resultDialogue: Subaru fires confetti. It spells DUCK. She throws the launcher into a bin.
Kiara poses. The sunset turns dramatically orange. "Production value."
Gigi salutes the traffic cone. Half the crowd salutes too. Subaru goes home.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The parade finishes at the correct stage eventually, which is enough for festival accounting.

noon.title: Day 14 - Absolutely Planned
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, the festival is too successful to admit nobody planned it.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Sora, Haachama, and IRyS run the safest possible festival food stall.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Sora has shaved ice. IRyS has skewers. Haachama has been assigned napkins only.

steps.prompt: Haachama wants a promotion.

options.resultDialogue: Sora hands her ketchup. Haachama smiles too widely. IRyS: "We have made a tactical error."
Haachama folds one into a spider. Sora quietly unfolds it.
IRyS gives Haachama one cucumber. "Hope." Haachama: "Challenge accepted."

steps.prompt: A customer asks for the most exciting item.

options.resultDialogue: Sora serves rainbow ice. Everyone cheers. Haachama looks personally insulted by competence.
IRyS serves sweet-and-spicy skewers. "Hope first. Consequences second."
The cucumber is wearing a tiny hat. The customer buys it without eating it. "Marketing!"

steps.prompt: Close the stall.

options.resultDialogue: Sora smiles. The sink claps once. Everyone ignores it.
Haachama auctions it. IRyS: "We have lost the plot."
IRyS hands out skewers. The stall prints HOPE DISTRIBUTED. "Acceptable."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The food stall closes with zero poisonings and one celebrity cucumber.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kaela, Kobo, and Zeta build festival games from spare equipment.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela has lumber. Zeta has sensors. Kobo has designed a game called HIT MANAGER.

steps.prompt: Choose the first booth.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela builds it perfectly. Kobo throws one ring. It lands on Zeta. "Prize acquired."
Kobo installs industrial pressure. Kaela turns it down from mining to human.
Zeta builds a stealth maze. Kobo immediately shouts ZETA IS HERE. "Security test failed."

steps.prompt: A booth starts awarding prizes by itself.

options.resultDialogue: Everyone wins a rubber duck. Kobo: "Subaru economy."
Zeta opens the panel. It says FUN DETECTED. "Unprofessional sensor."
Kaela hits RESET. The whole booth rotates ninety degrees. "Reset adjacent."

steps.prompt: Games close.

options.resultDialogue: Zeta counts minus twelve ducks. Kobo is wearing thirteen.
Kaela locks the shed. Kobo is already inside. "Planning."
The ring toss keeps playing itself. Zeta: "It can close itself too."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The carnival games close with excellent attendance and mathematically impossible duck inventory.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Aki, Reine, and Fauna manage festival portraits.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Aki has props. Reine has posture standards. Fauna has convinced vines to form a backdrop.

steps.prompt: A guest requests a dramatic portrait.

options.resultDialogue: Aki says "more dramatic." A wind machine activates. Her own hat leaves the booth.
Reine adjusts one shoulder. The camera adds a royal frame automatically. "Correct."
Fauna asks the flowers to bloom. They photobomb perfectly. "Natural talent."

steps.prompt: The booth offers BEAUTY ENHANCEMENT.

options.resultDialogue: The filter adds sparkles. Aki: "Only sparkles?" The machine adds more. "Better."
Nothing changes. Reine nods. "Accurate."
The booth becomes a greenhouse. Fauna: "That escalated botanically."

steps.prompt: Last photo?

options.resultDialogue: The booth squeezes all three into one frame. Reine: "Undignified." Aki: "Cute."
The filter labels you TIRED. Fauna: "Accurate."
The camera takes one final photo by itself. Reine takes the evidence.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The photo booth produces several beautiful portraits and one deeply insulting Manager profile.

evening.title: Day 14 - Closing Ceremony
evening.openingDialogue: The island has apparently prepared a finale. Management would like to know when it found the budget.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Suisei, Noel, and Cecilia run the festival haunted house.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Noel has a lantern. Cecilia has sensors. Suisei has been told very clearly not to become part of the attraction.

steps.prompt: The first ghost prop fails.

options.resultDialogue: Noel taps the ghost. Its head flies into the next room. Cecilia: "More frightening now."
The ghost says BOO with perfect timing. Suisei: "Too predictable."
Suisei stands silently in a dark hallway. Three guests surrender before reaching her.

steps.prompt: A guest asks whether Suisei is an actor.

options.resultDialogue: Suisei smiles. The guest leaves faster. Noel: "Great acting." Cecilia: "She did nothing."
The guest leaves even faster. Cecilia records the result. "Control group successful."
Noel: "She is an idol." The guest: "That is scarier somehow." Suisei: "Thanks."

steps.prompt: Final scare?

options.resultDialogue: The lights go out. Suisei says "Hi." The haunted house closes early.
Noel wears a tiny ghost sheet. Everyone says cute. She looks devastated.
Cecilia appears from a maintenance hatch. "Your tax filing is late." Suisei laughs first.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The haunted house wins Festival Scariest Attraction. Suisei disputes whether she participated.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kanade, Niko, and AZKi host festival karaoke from a tower that gets taller with applause.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kanade has the mic. Niko has a height marker. AZKi has asked everyone not to encourage the tower.

steps.prompt: First song begins.

options.resultDialogue: The tower rises one meter. Niko marks it. "We have discovered vertical music."
The tower rises exactly ten centimeters. AZKi: "Measured applause."
The crowd laughs. The tower rises sideways. "New axis!"

steps.prompt: They are now above the lighting rig.

options.resultDialogue: Kanade asks everyone to be quiet. They cheer because she asked. The tower rises again.
Nobody knows what that means. Somehow the tower lowers. Niko: "Music physics."
Niko: "Mid." The tower lowers in shame. "Comedy engineering."

steps.prompt: Finale?

options.resultDialogue: The tower returns to normal only after everyone sings together. Kanade: "Teamwork is structurally sound."
AZKi whispers goodnight. The tower powers down. Niko whispers "coward" at it.
The tower displays NO. Kanade: "Even buildings get tired."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Karaoke ends at ground level after music briefly becomes a construction material.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Mel, Roboco, and Elizabeth supervise the closing fireworks.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth has the launch order. Roboco has the console. Mel is holding a sparkler shaped like garlic.

steps.prompt: The console asks for the mood.

options.resultDialogue: The first firework writes GOOD EVENING. Elizabeth nods. Mel: "Very polite explosion."
The sky displays ROBoco 120 FPS. Roboco: "Accurate." Elizabeth: "Advertising."
A bat-shaped firework appears. Mel waves. It waves back. "Cute."

steps.prompt: One rocket refuses to launch.

options.resultDialogue: "You will launch." It launches. Elizabeth stares at the empty tube. "Good."
Roboco presses restart. The rocket displays UPDATING 1 OF 47. "No."
Mel says "You can do it." The rocket launches a tiny heart. Everyone applauds.

steps.prompt: Final volley?

options.resultDialogue: The sky fills with color. The festival banner changes to SEE YOU NEXT YEAR. Nobody remembers programming that.
Roboco cancels. One tiny firework still pops and writes SORRY.
Mel presses the button. The garlic sparkler launches too. "I lost my flashlight."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The unscheduled festival ends with a scheduled-looking finale. Nobody volunteers to investigate tonight.

days.storyBeat: Several rooms, signs, and entrances are in slightly different places this morning. Management declares this a facilities issue and immediately regrets the wording.

morning.title: Day 15 - Wrong Door, Right Room
morning.openingDialogue: The resort opens on time. The rooms have not shown the same professionalism.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gura, Aqua, and Chihaya discover the pool entrance is now beside the hotel elevators.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Gura is wearing goggles. Aqua is holding towels. Chihaya is staring at a POOL - 3F sign.

steps.prompt: Do we trust the sign?

options.resultDialogue: The doors open to the normal pool. Aqua: "We moved twelve meters sideways." Chihaya: "Elevator drift."
The stairs lead to the pool deck after one flight. Gura: "Third floor is short today."
Gura points at water. "Pool." Chihaya: "Case closed by shark."

steps.prompt: A guest asks where the old pool entrance went.

options.resultDialogue: The map shows both entrances. Aqua: "We have duplicated pool."
Chihaya: "Route improvement." The sign adds 300 HP ACCESS. "Okay, rude."
Gura swims to the old gate from inside. "Still there." Aqua: "Then where are we?"

steps.prompt: Open for guests?

options.resultDialogue: The elevator announces POOL FLOOR. Chihaya: "We have invented vertical beach."
The elevator opens anyway. Gura: "Democracy defeated."
Aqua closes one sign. Another sign appears. "It is reproducing."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The pool opens on whichever floor the resort currently believes in.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Anya, Ao, and Watame try to serve breakfast after the dining hall moves.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Anya has plates. Ao has directions. Watame has followed the smell of bread into a conference room.

steps.prompt: The dining room is now Conference B.

options.resultDialogue: Anya sets tables around the projector. It displays TODAY'S SPECIAL. Ao: "Adaptable office."
Watame follows bread smell. It leads back to Conference B. "Bread has spoken."
Ao confidently opens a door. Storage closet. She closes it. "Warm-up."

steps.prompt: The buffet labels have moved too.

options.resultDialogue: SOUP contains cereal. Anya: "Breakfast soup."
Watame identifies bread, bread, and "future bread." Ao: "That is dough."
Ao writes NORMAL. Every tray becomes toast. "Too much authority."

steps.prompt: Breakfast ends.

options.resultDialogue: The sign changes from Conference B to Dining Hall. Nothing else moves. Anya: "Cheap trick."
Watame presents quarterly bread results. Ao applauds.
The exit sign points at the ceiling. Nobody accepts the suggestion.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Breakfast succeeds in a room that changes departments twice before coffee.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Shion, Chloe, and Hajime inspect an elevator that refuses boring destinations.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Shion presses Lobby. The elevator displays BORING. Chloe presses Pool. BORING. Hajime presses ROOF. ACCEPTED.

steps.prompt: Choose a destination.

options.resultDialogue: The elevator sighs electronically. Shion: "It has taste." Chloe: "It has attitude."
The doors close instantly. Hajime: "BADASS ACCESS!"
The elevator displays FINALLY. Everyone regrets empowering it.

steps.prompt: The elevator stops between floors and asks VIBE?

options.resultDialogue: Ao is not here, but the elevator plays saxophone. Chloe: "Close enough."
The elevator accelerates. Hajime: "YES!" Shion: "NO!"
The elevator displays COWARD and resumes gently. Shion: "I hate this box."

steps.prompt: Where do the doors open?

options.resultDialogue: They open at the lobby. Chloe: "It wanted attention."
They open at the roof. Hajime raises both fists. "CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT!"
They open into a broom closet. Shion: "Surprise achieved."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The elevator remains operational and emotionally exhausting.

noon.title: Day 15 - Route Z
noon.openingDialogue: Noon is the day's only discovery window. The old ROUTE Z token finally has somewhere to go.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Amelia, Iroha, and Bijou test the ROUTE Z token at an old tram gate.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Amelia has the token. Iroha has emergency rope. Bijou has named the dark tunnel Bonus Stage.

steps.prompt: Insert the ROUTE Z token?

options.resultDialogue: The wall folds open around a tiny tram. Amelia: "Public transport jumpscare."
Iroha taps the token. The gate bows open. "Polite railway, de gozaru."
Bijou inserts the shiny side first. The tram lights spell NICE. "Mutual respect."
Amelia presses the blank panel. A spare ROUTE Z token drops from the slot. "The mystery has customer support."

steps.prompt: The tram has no driver and one button: CENTRAL.

options.resultDialogue: The tram moves under the resort. Bijou: "Minecart!" Amelia: "Do not stand up."
Iroha finds three brakes. All say EMERGENCY. "Optimistic design."
Amelia finds one map with several blank stations. "Someone censored public transport."

steps.prompt: The tram stops at a sealed door: CALIBRATION 3.

options.resultDialogue: It refuses to open. Amelia: "Good. A mystery with boundaries."
The door knocks back once. Iroha steps away. "Nope, de gozaru."
Bijou: "Open?" The display says LATER. "Fair."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: ROUTE Z leads beneath the resort to a sealed door marked CALIBRATION 3. It is not ready to open.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Shiori, Koyori, and Lui use the ROUTE Z token on an old control panel.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Shiori found a transit panel. Koyori found three unlabeled switches. Lui found the emergency stop before either of them.

steps.prompt: The panel requests ROUTE AUTHORIZATION.

options.resultDialogue: The panel lights Z. Shiori: "A letter with commitment."
Koyori scans the slot. A spare token ejects. "It rewarded curiosity." Lui: "Do not encourage it."
Lui taps her badge. The panel displays NICE TRY. She takes that personally.

steps.prompt: A service tram arrives with no driver.

options.resultDialogue: Shiori: "Excellent haunted commute." Lui: "Do not market that."
Koyori puts a sensor inside. The tram takes the sensor away. "Research has departed."
The timetable says CENTRAL - NOW. "At least it is punctual."

steps.prompt: The line ends at CALIBRATION 3.

options.resultDialogue: Shiori photographs the sealed door. Her photo labels it NOT YET. "Helpful caption."
Koyori gets zero readings. "The door is professionally closed."
Lui presses RETURN. The tram obeys immediately. "Finally, one system with manners."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The restored route reaches a sealed CALIBRATION 3 station and turns around without explanation.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Riona, Su, and Vivi discover the ROUTE Z token works on a stage freight lift.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Riona is carrying equipment. Su has the token. Vivi has renamed the freight lift TOUR BUS.

steps.prompt: Try the ROUTE Z token.

options.resultDialogue: The freight doors open onto a tram platform. Su: "That is not backstage."
Riona taps the slot. A spare token drops first. "It wants exact change."
Vivi says "All aboard!" The lift opens anyway. "Voice-activated confidence."

steps.prompt: The tram display says CENTRAL STAGE.

options.resultDialogue: The tram speeds under the resort. Vivi records everything. Riona: "No posting tunnel coordinates."
Full signal underground. Su: "This tunnel has better service than my room."
Forty-two seconds. Riona: "Fast." Vivi: "Content-efficient."

steps.prompt: The final platform says CALIBRATION 3 - CLOSED.

options.resultDialogue: Riona nods. The sign adds THANK YOU. "Finally, boundaries."
Su gets one result: LATER. "Very advanced vocabulary."
The sign flashes NO. Vivi laughs. "It has comedic timing."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The backstage freight route secretly connects to an old central tram line ending at CALIBRATION 3.

evening.title: Day 15 - Please Stay Put
evening.openingDialogue: The tram mystery can wait. First, every guest needs to find dinner and their own bed.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Lamy, Nene, and Ollie host a banquet after the ballroom relocates.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Lamy has the seating chart. Nene has assigned spouses. Ollie opened the ballroom door and found the gym.

steps.prompt: Where is the banquet now?

options.resultDialogue: Lamy sets tablecloths over treadmills. Ollie: "Dinner moves!"
Nene follows music into the laundry room. "Husband socks!" Lamy turns around.
The sign points behind them. The ballroom door is there now. Ollie: "Sneaky room."

steps.prompt: Table twelve is missing.

options.resultDialogue: Nene yells "HUSBAND TWELVE!" A table rolls through the door. Lamy stops asking questions.
Ollie runs with a table overhead. "MOBILE FURNITURE!"
Lamy removes Table 12. The room gains one empty space. "Administrative violence."

steps.prompt: Banquet ends.

options.resultDialogue: Lamy raises a glass. The chandeliers move to the next room before the toast ends.
Nene counts twelve tables and thirteen husbands. "BONUS!"
Ollie locks it. The door moves six feet left. "Escape artist room!"

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The banquet succeeds despite the venue changing location three times.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Moona, Iofi, and Ina update a resort map while buildings refuse to stay put.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Moona has the old map. Iofi has paint. Ina has drawn tiny faces on every moving building.

steps.prompt: The cafe moved one block east.

options.resultDialogue: Iofi paints it east. The actual cafe slides one more meter. "Stop following the art!"
Moona marks both. A second cafe sign appears. "We have created ambiguity."
Ina draws MOVE BACK. The cafe returns. "Graphic design-wah."

steps.prompt: The lighthouse appears two centimeters off on the map.

options.resultDialogue: Moona moves the mark. Nothing happens. Everyone exhales.
Iofi circles it. The circle glows once. "I hate responsive design."

options.text: Ina draws a hat on it
options.resultDialogue: The actual lighthouse does not gain a hat. Ina: "Reality has standards-wah."

steps.prompt: Publish the new map?

options.resultDialogue: The map adds SUBJECT TO CHANGE in tiny letters. Moona: "Honest."
Iofi labels it VERSION MAYBE. "Professional."
Ina signs WAH. The legend adds WAH as a district. "Oops-wah."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The resort map is updated with one important disclaimer: subject to change.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Towa, Choco, and Nerissa guide late guests through the rearranged hotel.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Towa has a flashlight. Choco has first-aid supplies. Nerissa has discovered the hallway echoes in harmony.

steps.prompt: A guest needs Room 510.

options.resultDialogue: Towa follows emergency signs. Every sign says GOOD JOB. "Stop praising me."
Choco checks their pulse first. "Lost, not dying." The hallway sign adds DIAGNOSIS ACCEPTED.
The echo answers from the left. "Musical GPS."

steps.prompt: The corridor loops back to the lobby.

options.resultDialogue: Towa: "Enough." The next door opens directly to Room 510. She stops. "...Good."
Everyone sits. The hallway stops moving. "Rest is medicine."
Nerissa sings lower. The corridor straightens. "Architecture has pitch."

steps.prompt: Guest delivered.

options.resultDialogue: The hallway lights dim in sequence. Towa: "At least someone listens."
Choco writes HALLWAY MOVED. The form prints GET WELL SOON. "Rude."
Nerissa hums. The elevator dings in harmony. "It learned."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Night shift ends with all guests in the correct rooms and several corridors in questionable ones.

days.storyBeat: The resort has stopped pretending rooms belong where the maps say. Staff spend the day escorting guests, furniture, and one entire stage to destinations that keep changing.

morning.title: Day 16 - Wrong Floor
morning.openingDialogue: The hotel elevators have gained a new button labeled MAYBE. Facilities would like it removed. Miko would like it gold-plated.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Roboco, Miko, and Kaela inspect an elevator with questionable confidence.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Roboco is scanning the panel. Miko is guarding the MAYBE button. Kaela has brought a pickaxe.

steps.prompt: Who presses MAYBE?

options.resultDialogue: The doors open to Floor ELITE. Miko: "Finally." Roboco: "That floor does not exist."
Roboco: "Unknown destination." Miko presses it anyway. "Known now."
Kaela presses MAYBE. The button cracks. "Weak button." The elevator starts anyway.

steps.prompt: The elevator opens into a supply closet.

options.resultDialogue: Miko hangs a sign: ELITE STORAGE. Roboco: "You cannot annex a closet." "Too late."
Kaela lifts the shelving unit. The elevator closes behind her. "Wrong closet."
Roboco reboots it. The panel now says MAYBE 2. Miko applauds.

steps.prompt: A guest presses BEACH.

options.resultDialogue: The doors open onto sand. Roboco: "Impossible." Miko: "Convenient."
You block the doors. The elevator announces BEACH WITHOUT YOU and leaves.
Kaela steps out, returns with a coconut. "Beach confirmed."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Facilities removed the MAYBE button. It came back after lunch.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kiara, Reine, and Risu deliver breakfast to rooms that refuse to stay numbered.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kiara has twelve trays. Reine has the guest list. Risu has invented a rerouting fee.

steps.prompt: Room 302 is now beside Room 118.

options.resultDialogue: Kiara walks ten meters and arrives at 302 twice. "We have duplicate breakfast targets."
Reine ignores the signs and finds the guest immediately. Risu: "Royal GPS. Premium service."
Risu charges the tray 50 shells for changing floors. Kiara: "The tray has no money!"

steps.prompt: A door marked 405 opens into the kitchen.

options.resultDialogue: Kiara hands the chef his own breakfast. He accepts it without comment.
Reine: "This room is incorrectly located." The sign changes to KITCHEN. "Acceptable."
Risu adds EXPRESS KITCHEN ACCESS. Reine removes the sign. Risu adds another.

steps.prompt: One tray still has no destination.

options.resultDialogue: Kiara sits down. "Finally, a route I understand."
Risu: "Where do you live?" The elevator dings. Reine: "Apparently it answered."
The kitchen is now Room 405. Kiara: "I quit architecture."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Breakfast reached every guest except one tray, which appears to have checked into the hotel.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Sora, Mel, and Haachama discover the spa has moved into the bakery.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Sora is holding towels. Mel is holding aroma oil. Haachama is kneading something that should not be kneaded.

steps.prompt: Guests want massages. The ovens want bread.

options.resultDialogue: Sora: "Please relax." An oven dings. Haachama: "YOUR FACE MASK IS READY!"
Mel lights lavender oil. The bread smells incredible and tastes like soap.
Haachama rolls cucumber slices into dough. Sora quietly removes them.

steps.prompt: A guest asks for an edible face mask.

options.resultDialogue: Haachama: "Coward." Sora: "Correct answer."
Mel offers honey. The guest eats it. "This is just honey." Mel smiles. "Yes."
Haachama presents a plate. The guest signs a waiver without being asked.

steps.prompt: The spa sign suddenly reads BAKERY.

options.resultDialogue: Sora folds the towels. "Bread therapy it is."
Mel flips it to SPA. The ovens turn off. Haachama: "The building has chosen."
The sign reads BAKERY SPA. Three guests immediately line up.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The bakery spa received five-star reviews and one confused health inspection.

noon.title: Day 16 - Mobile Amenities
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, guests have stopped asking why rooms move. They are now asking whether moving rooms cost extra.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Pekora, Polka, and Gigi turn a wandering corridor wall into an attraction.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A hallway wall has moved six meters. Pekora has built a toll gate. Polka is selling tickets. Gigi is tracking it.

steps.prompt: The wall starts moving again.

options.resultDialogue: Gigi sprints after it. "STOP RESISTING ARREST!" The wall continues being a wall.
Pekora: "Premium wall chase-peko!" The wall immediately speeds up.
Polka announces THE GREAT MIGRATING WALL. A guest asks when it performs. "Now!"

steps.prompt: The wall blocks Pekora's toll booth.

options.resultDialogue: Pekora drags it around the wall. The wall moves again. "IT'S COMPETING-PEKO!"
Gigi presses her ear to the wall. "It wants immunity." Polka: "From what?" "ME."
Polka installs wheels. The wall stops moving. "It hates convenience."

steps.prompt: Guests demand an encore.

options.resultDialogue: The wall slides away. Gigi: "RUDE."
Pekora pushes a cardboard wall. It falls on her. "Calculated-peko."
Polka bows. The real wall moves behind her. "ENCORE CONFIRMED!"

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The Moving Wall sold out three shows despite refusing to follow the schedule.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Marine, Noel, and Subaru retrieve a hotel room that has somehow reached the pier.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A bed, wardrobe, and lamp are sitting on Pier Two. Marine has already named the room.

steps.prompt: Marine declares the room a vessel.

options.resultDialogue: Marine: "Senchou finally has a cabin!" Subaru: "IT HAS CARPET."
Marine covers the lamp's ears. "Don't insult the crew."
Noel lifts the bed. The carpet comes too. Subaru: "The room is attached!"

steps.prompt: The wardrobe opens onto a hotel hallway.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru enters and returns from the lobby. "I hate convenient nonsense!"
Marine hangs a PIRATE ENTRANCE sign. The wardrobe closes itself.
Noel carries the wardrobe into the hotel. The hallway inside comes with it.

steps.prompt: Where does the room belong?

options.resultDialogue: The bed vanishes from the pier. Subaru: "Good." Marine: "My ship!"
Marine salutes. Noel installs curtains. Subaru files a complaint against geography.
The lamp flickers twice. Noel: "I think that's hotel." Marine: "Coward."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The room returned to the hotel. Marine continues referring to Pier Two as international waters.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Elizabeth, Cecilia, and Zeta hold a hearing because two official maps disagree.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth has two maps. Cecilia says both are accurate. Zeta has quietly added a third.

steps.prompt: Which map is official?

options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth stamps A. Map B immediately gains an OFFICIAL sticker.
Cecilia: "Excellent. Map A is now more accurate." Elizabeth: "Explain." "No."
Zeta's map has a snack route. Elizabeth: "This is crayon." Zeta: "Classified crayon."

steps.prompt: A corridor exists on only one map.

options.resultDialogue: Cecilia walks ten meters and returns behind you. "Efficient corridor."
Elizabeth hangs CLOSED. The sign appears on the other map instead.
Zeta enters dramatically and exits through the snack bar. "Mission successful. Also chips."

steps.prompt: Final ruling?

options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth: "Legally impossible." Cecilia: "Geographically current."
Zeta unfolds her crayon map. "Promotion."
A new map prints itself. Elizabeth: "I object." The printer continues.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Map Court adjourned after geography declined to testify.

evening.title: Day 16 - Keep Moving
evening.openingDialogue: At sunset, the resort begins putting itself back together. It does not ask anyone where anything belongs.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Suisei, AZKi, and Kanade chase an outdoor stage that keeps relocating.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The stage is rolling across the plaza. Kanade is still singing on it. Suisei is gaining.

steps.prompt: How do we stop the stage?

options.resultDialogue: Suisei grabs the rail. The stage stops. Kanade: "Can you do that to traffic?"
AZKi matches the music tempo. The stage slows politely. "It likes BPM."
Kanade hits a high note. The stage accelerates. "ENCORE SPEED!"

steps.prompt: The stage parks outside the restaurant.

options.resultDialogue: Suisei: "Fine." Dinner becomes a concert before anyone can object.
AZKi presses BACKSTAGE. The stage reverses through three flowerbeds.
Kanade: "Restaurant arc!" A waiter hands her a menu mid-song.

steps.prompt: The stage finally stops.

options.resultDialogue: The audience boos. The stage moves again. Suisei: "It disagrees."
AZKi sings one chorus. The stage parks perfectly. "Bribed with music."
Kanade: "THANK YOU, MOBILE VENUE!" The stage honks.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The stage returned to storage after completing an unscheduled three-venue tour.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Fauna, IRyS, and Kobo discover the garden has moved into the hotel lobby.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A tree is growing through reception. Fauna looks delighted. The receptionist does not.

steps.prompt: The lobby is now humid enough to rain.

options.resultDialogue: Fauna whispers to the tree. It grows a hammock. "It compromised."
Kobo: "Rain management!" It rains harder. IRyS opens an umbrella indoors.
IRyS sings softly. The flowers bloom toward her. Fauna: "Show-off."

steps.prompt: A guest checks in beneath a waterfall.

options.resultDialogue: Kobo hands them one. The waterfall moves over the next guest.
Fauna moves the desk. A vine moves it back. "Nature prefers this spot."
IRyS: "Rainforest check-in experience?" The guest asks for an upgrade.

steps.prompt: The garden starts retreating outside.

options.resultDialogue: Fauna waves. The tree takes the hammock with it. "Rude."
Kobo grabs a fern. The fern drags her outside.
IRyS bows. A flower drops a room key. Nobody claims it.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The lobby dried out. Reception has banned indoor weather until further notice.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Aki, Ririka, and Niko solve a room booked as three different businesses.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Room 610 is simultaneously reserved as a café, dance studio, and souvenir shop.

steps.prompt: Which booking wins?

options.resultDialogue: Aki sets one table. The room sign changes to DANCE CAFÉ. Ririka: "Upsell."
Niko starts rehearsing. Shelves appear along the wall. "Backup merch."
Ririka opens the register. A coffee machine appears. "Cross-selling."

steps.prompt: Three groups arrive at once.

options.resultDialogue: Ririka sells fifteen-minute slots. Aki: "You monetized the clock." "Obviously."
Niko dances while Aki serves drinks. Ririka sells both cups and choreography.
The room displays VACANCY and immediately books itself as a dentist.

steps.prompt: Room 610 finally becomes a normal guest room.

options.resultDialogue: Ririka locks the door. A SOLD OUT sign appears inside.
Aki opens the door. It's the café again. "Coffee?"
Niko: "Best management decision today." The room applauds once.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Room 610 ended the day as a hotel room, pending further negotiations with itself.

days.storyBeat: ROUTE Z and CALIBRATION 3 remain sealed. Meanwhile, ordinary resort spaces continue drifting into the wrong places, so staff spend the day treating geography like a scheduling problem.

morning.title: Day 17 - Relocation Day
morning.openingDialogue: Nothing mysterious is scheduled today. This does not stop the building.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Aqua, Shion, and Sana sort items that seem oddly early to be lost.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Aqua is holding an umbrella tagged RETURNED TOMORROW. Shion calls it prophecy. Sana asks if tomorrow signed the form.

steps.prompt: A guest says the umbrella is theirs, but they are currently holding the same umbrella.

options.resultDialogue: Aqua hands it over. Now the guest has two. Shion: "See? Magic." Aqua: "That's not helping."
Shion whispers at the tag. It changes to RETURNED YESTERDAY. "Fixed." Aqua: "WORSE."
Sana holds both umbrellas up. "Maybe they're twins!" Aqua quietly starts a third form.

steps.prompt: The bin produces a room key labeled 712. The hotel has six floors.

options.resultDialogue: It opens the supply closet. Shion: "Secret seventh floor." Aqua: "It's bleach."
Sana pockets it. The tag changes to LOST BY SANA. "Oh! Accurate."
Aqua writes UNKNOWN KEY. The form prints GOOD LUCK. She stops writing.

steps.prompt: One final item remains: Aqua's towel.

options.resultDialogue: Aqua: "I didn't lose this." She checks her bag. Her towel is gone. Silence.
Shion folds her arms. "Obviously I foresaw it." The towel tag changes to LIAR.
Sana wears it as a cape. "Lost property adopted!" Aqua files nothing.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Lost & Found closes after returning several objects to people who had not lost them yet.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Amelia, Ao, and Raden inspect a new half-floor between Floors 2 and 3.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Amelia has a tape measure. Raden has museum labels. Ao has already found the best selfie wall.

steps.prompt: The elevator now offers 2, 2.5, and 3.

options.resultDialogue: The doors open halfway up a staircase. Amelia: "Technically accurate." Ao: "Technically stupid."
Ao steps out dramatically and hits her head on the low ceiling. Raden: "Avant-garde entrance."
Raden reads the plaque. "Built: apparently today." Amelia circles apparently three times.

steps.prompt: Raden wants to preserve the half-floor as cultural heritage.

options.resultDialogue: Raden hangs a label: TRANSITIONAL ARCHITECTURE. Ao: "It's drywall." "History begins somewhere."
Ao adds one chair. The sign changes to EXCLUSIVE LOUNGE. Amelia: "Who is it exclusive to?" "Me."
Amelia measures the hall twice. It is longer the second time. "Rude."

steps.prompt: Facilities asks whether Floor 2.5 is staying.

options.resultDialogue: The elevator adds 2.25. Amelia immediately closes the panel.
The sign changes to TEMPORARY PERMANENT. Raden takes a photo.
Ao: "Keep the lighting." The entire floor disappears except the lighting.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Floor 2.5 remains on the map under the legally cautious label 'probably temporary.'

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Fubuki, Mio, and La+ handle guest complaints while the building edits its own signs.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Mio has the complaint forms. Fubuki has stickers. La+ has declared herself Supreme Customer Service.

steps.prompt: A guest says the hallway is too quiet.

options.resultDialogue: Elevator jazz starts everywhere. Fubuki snaps along. Mio: "Not everywhere."
La+ points down the hall. "MAKE NOISE!" Every doorbell rings. She lowers her hand. "Success."
Mio hands over earphones. The hallway sign changes to QUIET ENOUGH. "I'll take it."

steps.prompt: Another guest says the signs are confusing.

options.resultDialogue: Fubuki replaces every arrow with THIS WAY. Mio: "Which way?" "Correct."
La+: "OBEY." The signs rotate toward her. "SEE?" Nobody knows where breakfast is.
Mio writes LOBBY, BEACH, ROOMS. One sign adds MAYBE. Mio removes it without comment.

steps.prompt: The complaint printer asks for feedback on itself.

options.resultDialogue: It prints THANK YOU and stops. Mio: "Positive reinforcement works on office equipment."
It prints APPEAL FILED. La+ slams the desk. "INSOLENCE!"
Fubuki draws a fox. The printer produces fifty copies. "Marketing solved."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Customer Service survives. The printer has requested a performance review.

noon.title: Day 17 - Wrong Place, Right Shift
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, several amenities have moved. Guests mostly want to know whether their reservations moved too.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Chihaya, Gura, and Coco chase a beach zone that has shifted down the coast.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The umbrellas are moving south. Chihaya has the cart running. Gura insists the ocean is following her. Coco has traffic cones.

steps.prompt: How do you catch a moving beach?

options.resultDialogue: Chihaya floors the cart. Gura: "Beach chase!" Coco: "THIS IS WHY WE HAVE SEATBELTS."
Gura steps into the water. "Stop." The tide pauses. Coco slowly looks at you. "Don't encourage that."
Coco plants cones ahead of the umbrellas. The umbrellas go around them. "Smart beach. Annoying beach."

steps.prompt: The snack cart is moving with the beach.

options.resultDialogue: Chihaya taps bumpers. The snack cart accelerates. "It took that personally."
Gura jumps aboard and returns holding ice cream. "Mission complete." Coco: "That was theft."
Coco points at the curb. The cart parks perfectly. Chihaya: "Can you command mine too?" "No."

steps.prompt: The beach finally stops beside the lighthouse.

options.resultDialogue: Guests cheer. Chihaya receives a parking ticket from a sign that did not exist.
Gura: "Counterpoint: beach here now." Nobody has a better argument.
Coco sighs. "New rule: beaches require permits." A permit printer appears.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The beach reopens several hundred meters from where Management remembers leaving it.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kanata, Luna, and Baelz discover the children's pool on the hotel roof.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kanata is carrying six floaties. Luna demands shade. Bae wants to know whether rooftop diving is technically flying.

steps.prompt: How did the pool get up here?

options.resultDialogue: Kanata: "I didn't carry it." Everyone looks at her. "I WOULD REMEMBER."
Bae: "Chaos." Luna: "Not an answer." "It answers many things."
Luna points at the water. "Pool came to princess." Kanata nods like this solved it.

steps.prompt: A floatie rolls toward the roof edge.

options.resultDialogue: Kanata grabs it with one finger. The roof tile cracks. "Floatie safe."
Bae catches the floatie and keeps rolling. Luna: "Chaos has left the pool."
The wind changes and the floatie rolls back. Luna: "Nna." Bae: "WHAT."

steps.prompt: Facilities wants the pool downstairs.

options.resultDialogue: Kanata lifts one side. Everyone screams. She puts it down. "Too splashy."
The drain leads upward. Bae: "I respect the commitment."
Luna claims the best chair. "Correct decision."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The rooftop pool remains open under the temporary classification 'somehow compliant.'

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Calli, Anya, and Riona hunt a restaurant reservation with no physical table.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The booking app says TABLE 404. Calli says that sounds ominous. Anya says it sounds like lunch.

steps.prompt: Where is Table 404?

options.resultDialogue: The arrow points into a wall. Riona: "I can beat a wall." Calli: "Please don't start a rivalry."
Anya points to an empty corner. A table appears. "There." Calli: "Did you know?" "No."
Calli: "Table 404, your time is up." A table rolls out of storage. Silence. "...I hate that."

steps.prompt: The table keeps changing reservation names.

options.resultDialogue: Riona refreshes faster than the screen. The table displays YOU WIN. "YES!" Anya: "Against furniture."
Anya sits down. The screen gives up and says ANYA. "Correct."
Calli taps the clock. The screen switches to PLEASE DON'T. "Good."

steps.prompt: The guests finally arrive.

options.resultDialogue: The table behaves perfectly. Riona whispers, "Coward."
It rolls back to the wall. Calli: "Fine. Die mysterious."
Anya: "Lunch first. Mystery later." Everyone agrees immediately.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Table 404 serves lunch successfully and refuses to explain where it was.

evening.title: Day 17 - Please Stay Put
evening.openingDialogue: The resort settles down after sunset. Several rooms decline.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Fuwawa, Mococo, and Chloe chase a laundry room that keeps changing floors.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Fuwawa has towels. Mococo has detergent. Chloe has lost the laundry room for the third time.

steps.prompt: The sign says LAUNDRY -> LEFT. Left is a balcony.

options.resultDialogue: Mococo opens the balcony door. A washing machine is outside. "BAU?!"
Fuwawa sniffs the towels and points upstairs. Chloe: "That is disturbingly useful."
Chloe: "I definitely know." They reach the kitchen. "Adjacent skill set."

steps.prompt: A dryer opens and releases fifty resort socks.

options.resultDialogue: Fuwawa catches twelve. Mococo catches thirteen. Chloe catches one and celebrates.
The socks march down the hall in static pairs. Mococo: "THEY HAVE A LEADER!"
Chloe closes the dryer. Another dryer opens behind her. "Personal attack."

steps.prompt: The laundry room finally appears beside reception.

options.resultDialogue: Fuwawa: "BAU BAU!" The washer beeps twice back. Nobody comments.
Mococo locks it. The entire door slides three meters right. "NO!"
Chloe writes DO NOT MOVE. The room stays still. "Respect."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Laundry finishes with most socks accounted for and one room successfully intimidated.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kronii, Mumei, and Iroha escort guests using a map that updates every minute.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kronii says the map is late. Mumei says the map is pretty. Iroha says both comments are unhelpful.

steps.prompt: The route changes before anyone moves.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii: "It changed early." She looks personally betrayed by time.
Mumei: "I forgot it." Iroha: "We printed it ten seconds ago."
Iroha walks straight through three detours. The map redraws around her.

steps.prompt: The map labels the fountain HOTEL.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii writes FOUNTAIN. The map adds yesterday's Route Z line beside it. "It kept the annoying part."
Kronii writes FOUNTAIN. It changes to WET HOTEL. "Hostile editing."
Mumei: "Maybe fish stay there." Iroha refuses to write that down.
Iroha checks the fountain. No hotel. "Good." A bellhop walks out behind her.

steps.prompt: Guests ask which map to trust.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii hands them a perfect map. It expires in thirty seconds.
Mumei points confidently. "That way." It is the ocean.
Iroha sighs. "I shall simply walk everyone there, de gozaru."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Every guest reaches their room. The maps do not receive credit.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Rushia, Aloe, and Hajime investigate an employee break room that keeps opening in different halls.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Rushia found Door 13 near the kitchen. Aloe found it near the pool. Hajime found it behind another door.

steps.prompt: Door 13 opens into a perfectly normal break room.

options.resultDialogue: Rushia steps in. The door shuts behind her. A muffled "OPEN IT" shakes the sign.
Aloe peeks in. "Free couch." Hajime: "Mission compromised by nap."
Hajime kicks the door open. It opens normally. "Intimidation successful."

steps.prompt: Inside, the vending machine has only one button: SURPRISE.

options.resultDialogue: A canned coffee drops. Rushia: "That's not surprising." The machine screams. She screams louder.
Aloe gets a microphone. "Finally, competent machinery."
The machine dispenses water anyway. Hajime: "Respectful opponent."

steps.prompt: When they leave, Door 13 is now across the hall.

options.resultDialogue: Rushia storms after it. The door stops moving. "GOOD."
Aloe lies on the couch. "If room moves, nap travels."
Hajime tapes a giant 13 on it. The door changes to 14. "Coward."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Break Room 13 remains available to staff, provided staff can find it.

days.storyBeat: Guest requests are being fulfilled with suspicious efficiency. Management treats it as a customer-service miracle because the alternative would require a meeting.

morning.title: Day 18 - Suggestions Welcome
morning.openingDialogue: A new suggestion system goes live. Nobody remembers installing it, which is apparently not enough reason to cancel breakfast.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Pekora, Flare, and Marine review guest suggestions. Pekora has submitted several in fake handwriting.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Flare opens the box. Marine poses beside it. Pekora is wearing glasses with no lenses.

steps.prompt: First suggestion: MORE SHORTCUTS PLEASE.

options.resultDialogue: The box stamps PREVIOUSLY APPROVED. A familiar-looking shortcut door appears. Flare slowly turns toward Pekora. "You taught it this."
A door appears beside Pekora. "CUSTOMER DEMAND-PEKO!" Flare reads the handwriting. "You wrote this."
The paper stamps itself DENIED. Marine: "Even the box has standards."
Pekora adjusts her fake glasses. "Anonymous concerned citizen-peko." Flare removes the glasses.

steps.prompt: Second suggestion: MORE PIRATES.

options.resultDialogue: Marine writes APPROVED. The box prints EXISTING MARITIME PRECEDENT. Marine gasps. "Senchou has case law!" Flare: "No."
Marine writes APPROVED. A pirate flag rises outside. "Senchou's people have spoken!"
Marine gasps. "Senchou has been censored by democracy!"
Flare writes DEFINE MORE. The box catches fire for one second and stops.

steps.prompt: Final suggestion: LESS EXPLOSIONS.

options.resultDialogue: The box stamps CONFLICTS WITH PRIOR PRECEDENT. Pekora looks delighted. Flare looks at you. "What prior precedent?"
Pekora tears up. "The customer is always wrong-peko."
Pekora writes COUNTEROFFER: CONTROLLED EXPLOSIONS. Flare takes the pen.
Marine: "Senchou proposes decorative explosions." Flare: "No." Negotiations end.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The suggestion box closes after implementing several ideas nobody remembers approving.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Sora, Roboco, and Haato run a breakfast counter with a suspiciously attentive order screen.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Sora is taking orders. Roboco is scanning the kiosk. Haato has written CHEF'S SURPRISE in permanent marker.

steps.prompt: A guest asks for 'extra crispy.'

options.resultDialogue: Every toaster maxes out. Sora: "Maybe slightly less crispy."
Roboco sets CRISPINESS 7. The kiosk changes it to 70. "Aggressive user preference."
Haato: "Fire is crispiness." Sora removes the lighter.

steps.prompt: Another guest asks for 'something unforgettable.'

options.resultDialogue: Sora serves pancakes. The kiosk prints UNFORGETTABLE. Haato: "Cowardly system."
Roboco prints the guest's name on toast. "Personalization complete." The guest cries.
Haato lifts a covered plate. The guest immediately says, "Actually pancakes are fine."

steps.prompt: The kiosk asks STAFF REQUEST?

options.resultDialogue: The kitchen goes silent. Roboco: "Request fulfilled." Haato drops a pan. Peace ends.
A conveyor belt appears. It immediately steals her spatula.
The kiosk displays REQUEST TOO BROAD. Sora: "Good kiosk."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Breakfast ends successfully. The kiosk has been unplugged but continues displaying GOOD MORNING.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kiara, Reine, and Risu handle a guest who requests a better ocean view.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The guest wants more ocean. Kiara is enthusiastic. Reine is cautious. Risu has already printed an upgrade menu.

steps.prompt: How much ocean is enough ocean?

options.resultDialogue: The window now faces the beach. Kiara: "Problem solved!" Reine: "This room faced inland."
Risu offers PREMIUM OCEAN: 300 shells. The window gets wider. "See? Value."
Reine says, "A tasteful amount." The waves become perfectly centered in the window. Silence.

steps.prompt: The guest asks for 'closer to the water.'

options.resultDialogue: The bed slides twenty centimeters toward the window. Kiara: "It negotiated."
Risu: "Beach adjacency fee." The room key prints +50m CLOSER. Reine takes it away.
Kiara: "You are practically swimming!" A splash hits the window. "...Metaphorically!"

steps.prompt: The guest gives five stars.

options.resultDialogue: Risu adds FIVE-STAR REALITY SERVICE to the brochure.
The ocean sound stops instantly. Reine: "Curtains have authority now."
Kiara opens the curtains again. The room is back inland. "Encore tomorrow!"

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The guest receives an excellent ocean view and a deeply questionable invoice.

noon.title: Day 18 - Customer Is Always Right
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, harmless requests are becoming very literal. Staff continues calling this excellent service.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Elizabeth, Gigi, and Cecilia process a complaint that the resort is 'too sunny.'
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth has the form. Cecilia has weather data. Gigi is glaring at the sun.

steps.prompt: The guest requests 'less sun.'

options.resultDialogue: A cloud moves over the desk. Elizabeth: "Efficient." Cecilia: "Concerning."
Gigi points upward. "YOU'VE BEEN WARNED!" A cloud arrives. "IT FEARS JUSTICE."
The form prints APPEAL TO WEATHER. Elizabeth looks offended on principle.

steps.prompt: Now the guest says it is too cloudy.

options.resultDialogue: The cloud moves two meters left. Cecilia: "Technically resolved."
Gigi whispers to the cloud. It leaves. Elizabeth: "What did you say?" "Classified."
Elizabeth: "We shall compromise." Half the table is sunny. The guest accepts.

steps.prompt: Justice must close the weather ticket.

options.resultDialogue: Cecilia stamps RESOLVED. Thunder rumbles once. "Do not reopen it."
Elizabeth writes ESCALATE. The form asks TO WHOM? She quietly crosses it out.
Gigi signs SUN. Elizabeth: "That is not your name." "It's the suspect."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The weather complaint is closed. The sun remains under unofficial observation.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kaela, Kobo, and Zeta tackle a maintenance queue that keeps creating its own jobs.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela has tools. Zeta has the list. Kobo has already submitted a request for 'more water.'

steps.prompt: First ticket: squeaky door.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela oils the hinge. The next three doors squeak in sympathy. "More work. Nice."
Zeta listens. "Door is communicating." Kaela: "Door needs oil."
Kobo: "STOP!" The door stops squeaking. "See?!" Kaela: "Temporary."

steps.prompt: Second ticket: 'more water.'

options.resultDialogue: Zeta clicks CANCEL. A pipe bursts anyway. Kobo: "Late delivery!"
Kaela tightens one valve. The fountain triples in height. "Wrong valve."
Kobo points at her cup. "For drinking." Everyone stares at the flooded hall.

steps.prompt: The queue prints one final ticket: FIX QUEUE.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela hits the side. It prints DONE. "Good machine."
Zeta stamps CLOSED. A new ticket prints REOPENED. "Enemy action."
Kobo shreds the ticket. The printer displays RUDE.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Maintenance clears the queue after convincing the queue to stop requesting maintenance.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Ririka, Kanade, and Niko collect harmless attraction ideas. This lasts briefly.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ririka has a whiteboard. Kanade has a microphone. Niko has written 'trust me' under every idea.

steps.prompt: A guest suggests 'a slide from the hotel to the beach.'

options.resultDialogue: A plastic slide unfolds from the balcony. Ririka: "Cost: apparently zero."
Kanade: "BEACH EXPRESS!" The slide gets speakers. Niko: "Improved."
Niko adds one loop. Ririka erases the loop. It appears anyway.

steps.prompt: A child suggests 'a mascot that is also a taxi.'

options.resultDialogue: The mascot statue honks. Kanade: "Too late."
Ririka writes 500 SHELLS/RIDE. The statue grows wheels. "Market validation."
Niko sits on the mascot. It rolls one meter and tips over. "Prototype!"

steps.prompt: Management asks for one safe idea.

options.resultDialogue: Three benches appear. Niko: "Boring." One bench spins. "Better."
A giant umbrella opens over Kanade. "I HAVE BEEN CHOSEN!"
Ririka writes NOTHING. An empty booth appears. "We can rent that."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The idea booth closes after producing several attractions and one monetized absence.

evening.title: Day 18 - One More Request
evening.openingDialogue: The evening crowd discovers the resort is unusually accommodating. This is terrible news for Management.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Fauna, IRyS, and Suisei handle evening requests in the garden.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A guest asks for 'more stars.' Suisei looks up. IRyS looks nervous. Fauna asks everyone not to touch astronomy.

steps.prompt: How do you give a garden more stars?

options.resultDialogue: Fauna hangs lights. Real stars brighten too. Suisei: "Competition accepted."
Suisei sings one note. Every light points at her. IRyS: "Close enough."
IRyS: "Maybe metaphorical stars?" A review board displays five stars. "I'll take it."

steps.prompt: Another guest asks for 'more nature.'

options.resultDialogue: One vine grows around the bench. "Reasonable." A second vine brings tea. "Less reasonable."
The flowers lean away from her. "Good instincts."
IRyS adds potted plants. One pot follows her. "I don't own you."

steps.prompt: The garden asks for STAFF FEEDBACK.

options.resultDialogue: Flowers bloom. Fauna: "See? Compliments work."
Suisei: "Harsh." The garden adds one star-shaped flower.
IRyS selects NO COMMENT. The screen displays SHY.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The garden closes with excellent reviews and one potted plant still following IRyS.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Polka, Nene, and Lamy supervise children's requests for the evening play area.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Polka has crayons. Nene has stickers. Lamy has already rejected 'real dragon' twice.

steps.prompt: A child draws a giant seal.

options.resultDialogue: A giant inflatable seal appears outside. Nene drops the crayons. "SON."
Polka adds a top hat. The inflatable gains a top hat. "ART HAS CONSEQUENCES!"
Lamy erases half. The inflatable becomes a very confused half-seal. "Put it back."

steps.prompt: Another child asks for snow.

options.resultDialogue: Lamy makes a tiny snow patch. Polka slides through it immediately.
The request card changes to AUGUST SNOW. Nene: "It has a counterargument."
Polka fires white confetti. Lamy: "That is not snow." "Audience disagrees."

steps.prompt: The kids ask to keep everything forever.

options.resultDialogue: Nene hugs the inflatable seal. "Manager separated a family."
Polka announces FINAL SEAL SHOW. The seal falls on her. Applause.
Lamy: "One seal. No dragons." The children accept the treaty.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The play area closes with one giant seal legally classified as temporary.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: AZKi, Aki, and Mel deal with a guest request for 'music that follows me.'
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A small speaker is following one guest around the lounge. AZKi says it is on beat. Aki says it is creepy. Mel waves at it.

steps.prompt: How do you stop a loyal speaker?

options.resultDialogue: The speaker circles faster. "It likes the remix."
The speaker follows perfectly. "I have acquired backup music."
Mel: "Please wait here." The speaker stops. Everyone stares. "What?"

steps.prompt: The guest now wants 'music everywhere.'

options.resultDialogue: AZKi sets volume 2. Every lamp hums softly. "Technically everywhere."
Aki starts a live song. The speaker sits beside the stage like a fan.
Mel: "Maybe not everywhere." The bathroom speakers switch off. "Good enough."

steps.prompt: Closing song?

options.resultDialogue: AZKi sings. The speaker powers itself down afterward. "Polite audience."
Aki spins. The speaker spins too and falls over. "Committed."
Mel whispers goodnight. The speaker displays GOODNIGHT.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The lounge closes quietly after the sound system finally takes a hint.

days.storyBeat: Route Z resumes service and Calibration 3 opens. The new PRECEDENT ARCHIVE contains records that sometimes look uncomfortably familiar, but nobody yet knows what 'precedent' means.

morning.title: Day 19 - Route Z Reopens
morning.openingDialogue: The old transit line begins behaving like it has a timetable. Nobody can find the timetable.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Aqua, Shion, and Sana open a tiny café beside the still-sealed Route Z platform.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Aqua has coffee. Shion has renamed three drinks. Sana is checking whether the ceiling counts as space.

steps.prompt: The menu board writes its own special: PLATFORM LATTE.

options.resultDialogue: Aqua serves one. The cup says NEXT STOP. "Coffee should not have destinations."
Shion writes DARK EXPRESS. The lights dim. "Brand consistency."
Sana adds EXTRA LARGE. The cup doubles in size. "Perfect!"

steps.prompt: The sealed platform door dings like an elevator.

options.resultDialogue: Aqua stares at the door. It dings again. "It wants attention."
Shion: "We're closed." The door displays RUDE. "Ruder."
The display changes to GOOD MORNING. Sana: "Friend!"

steps.prompt: First rush ends.

options.resultDialogue: Aqua locks the till. The platform door unlocks one click. Nobody touches it.
Shion announces free refills. Aqua looks more frightened than she did at the door.
Sana serves one enormous coffee. The straw requires two hands.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The café closes before the sealed platform can order anything.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Amelia, Ao, and Raden turn the old tram entrance into a temporary history exhibit.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Amelia has evidence cards. Raden has dates. Ao is standing beside the oldest poster like she designed it.

steps.prompt: What is the centerpiece?

options.resultDialogue: Raden labels it PRE-RENOVATION. Amelia adds PROBABLY. Raden removes PROBABLY.
Ao poses beside ROUTE Z. The sign adds OFFICIAL GUIDE. "I accept."
Amelia connects every clue with red string. Raden: "You have invented modern art."

steps.prompt: A tram bell rings behind the sealed wall.

options.resultDialogue: Amelia writes BELL. It rings twice. She adds SARCASTIC.
Raden: "Historically, bells announce arrivals." Ao: "What arrived?" Silence.
Ao: "We're busy." The bell stops. She freezes. "...Obviously."

steps.prompt: Guests ask whether Route Z opens today.

options.resultDialogue: The exhibit sign changes to NOT YET. Amelia photographs it.
The sign changes to SOON. Raden: "Never say maybe to architecture."
Ao: "When it feels like it." The door clicks. "I was joking."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The museum closes with Route Z still officially sealed and increasingly opinionated.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Fubuki, Mio, and La+ reopen the old Route Z ticket booth for crowd control.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Fubuki is selling souvenir tickets. Mio is stopping her from calling them cursed. La+ wants executive access.

steps.prompt: The printer produces a ticket to PLATFORM 0.

options.resultDialogue: Fubuki stamps LIMITED. Mio: "Do not create scarcity for nonsense."
La+ raises it. "BEHOLD, EXECUTIVE PASS!" The gate flashes CHILD.
Mio tears it in half. The printer makes two. "Of course."

steps.prompt: The gate opens for every ticket except La+'s.

options.resultDialogue: The gate opens. Fubuki bows to La+. "Commoner privilege."
The gate displays MOM. Mio closes her eyes. "I hate accurate machines."
La+: "OPEN!" The gate prints PLEASE TAP CARD. "IT MOCKS ME."

steps.prompt: The booth display changes to SERVICE RESUMING.

options.resultDialogue: Mio shutters it. Fubuki sells CLOSED signs as souvenirs.
Fubuki draws a queue line. The floor extends it by itself. "Helpful!"
The gate finally opens. La+ walks through and returns from the same side. "TACTICAL LOOP."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The ticket office closes just as Route Z announces that service is resuming.

noon.title: Day 19 - Calibration Three
noon.openingDialogue: Noon is today's only discovery window. Three routes reach the same newly opened chamber and complete Calibration 3.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Chihaya, Gura, Coco take a different route toward the sealed Calibration 3 station.
