coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The old tram finally arrives. Chihaya wants the controls. Gura wants the horn. Coco wants both of them away from the controls.

steps.prompt: Who drives the tram?

options.resultDialogue: Chihaya grips the controls. "Finally, rail horsepower." Coco: "That phrase is illegal."
Gura presses the horn. The tram moves. "A." Coco takes the controls away.
Coco sits down. "Nobody touches anything." Gura touches the bell immediately.

steps.prompt: The tram stops at the sealed CALIBRATION 3 door. It is open.

options.resultDialogue: Chihaya: "Suspiciously easy." Gura: "Skill issue resolved."
Coco reads the panel twice. "Old system. New headache."
The chamber lights turn on. Gura: "We ordered mystery."

steps.prompt: The chamber wakes. CALIBRATION 3 / 4 completes, then a menu appears: PRECEDENT ARCHIVE.

options.resultDialogue: The screen reads AVIAN LIABILITY — ACTIVE. Gura: "The birds have paperwork." Coco: "Of course they do."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive preserves an avian precedent from this resort's own history.

options.resultDialogue: The screen reads UNOFFICIAL ROUTE — ACCEPTED. Chihaya: "It approved a shortcut?" Coco looks at you. "Apparently somebody did."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive has remembered one of the resort's questionable route decisions.

options.resultDialogue: The screen reads FLOCK COMMANDER — PERSONNEL STATUS: VALID. Gura: "Subaru has a job title?"
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive contains a personnel precedent that should probably not be legally binding.

options.resultDialogue: The screen reads HUSBAND WORKFORCE — STAFFING MODEL: ACCEPTED. Coco: "I am not touching that one."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive has somehow preserved an earlier staffing decision.

options.resultDialogue: The screen opens PRECEDENT 87. The title is blank. Gura: "Mystery paperwork. Worst genre."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The first available precedent is blank, which is somehow less reassuring.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The third calibration completes. Route Z now exposes a PRECEDENT ARCHIVE, which sounds important and explains absolutely nothing.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kanata, Luna, Baelz take a different route toward the sealed Calibration 3 station.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The passenger tram is full, so Kanata, Luna, and Bae find a freight lift marked ROUTE Z STAFF.

steps.prompt: The freight lift has a 500kg limit.

options.resultDialogue: The warning light flashes before she enters. Kanata: "Rude."
Luna enters. The lift announces ROYAL CARGO. "Nna?!"
Bae presses all floors. The lift sighs audibly. "It gets me."

steps.prompt: The lift opens behind the CALIBRATION 3 chamber.

options.resultDialogue: Kanata pulls gently. The gate becomes two gates. "I improved access."
The panel displays WELCOME PRINCESS. Bae: "Favoritism!"
Bae disappears under the rail. "CLEAR! Also dusty!"

steps.prompt: The chamber wakes. CALIBRATION 3 / 4 completes, then a menu appears: PRECEDENT ARCHIVE.

options.resultDialogue: AVIAN LIABILITY — ACTIVE appears. Bae: "Bird law!" Luna: "Nna?" Kanata closes the file.
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive preserves an avian precedent from this resort's own history.

options.resultDialogue: UNOFFICIAL ROUTE — ACCEPTED appears. Bae: "The island legalized a shortcut." Kanata: "Please do not sound impressed."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive has remembered one of the resort's questionable route decisions.

options.resultDialogue: FLOCK COMMANDER — PERSONNEL STATUS: VALID appears. Bae immediately starts laughing. Kanata: "Do not tell Subaru."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive contains a personnel precedent that should probably not be legally binding.

options.resultDialogue: HUSBAND WORKFORCE — STAFFING MODEL: ACCEPTED appears. Luna: "Too many husbands." Nobody disagrees.
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive has somehow preserved an earlier staffing decision.

options.resultDialogue: PRECEDENT 87 opens with no title. Kanata: "So the mystery is filing paperwork now."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The first available precedent is blank, which is somehow less reassuring.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The third calibration completes. Route Z now exposes a PRECEDENT ARCHIVE, which sounds important and explains absolutely nothing.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Calli, Anya, Riona take a different route toward the sealed Calibration 3 station.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Calli, Anya, and Riona find an emergency stairwell that descends beside the old Route Z line.

steps.prompt: The stairwell sign says 12 STEPS. There are thirteen.

options.resultDialogue: Calli counts thirteen. The sign changes to 13. "Don't make me feel observed."
Anya: "Thirteen." Riona: "You didn't count." "I believed in the stairs."
Riona reaches bottom first. The sign displays NEW RECORD. "YES."

steps.prompt: The stairwell ends inside the CALIBRATION 3 room.

options.resultDialogue: Calli: "Nothing dead." Anya: "Strong review."
Anya taps it once. It wakes. "Threatened successfully."
Riona hits the button. The screen says PLEASE WAIT. "It fears competition."

steps.prompt: The chamber wakes. CALIBRATION 3 / 4 completes, then a menu appears: PRECEDENT ARCHIVE.

options.resultDialogue: AVIAN LIABILITY — ACTIVE appears. Calli: "I am not reaping a seagull over paperwork." Anya nods.
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive preserves an avian precedent from this resort's own history.

options.resultDialogue: UNOFFICIAL ROUTE — ACCEPTED appears. Riona: "Who won approval?" Anya: "Apparently the route."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive has remembered one of the resort's questionable route decisions.

options.resultDialogue: FLOCK COMMANDER — PERSONNEL STATUS: VALID appears. Riona: "That is incredible." Calli: "Do not encourage it."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive contains a personnel precedent that should probably not be legally binding.

options.resultDialogue: HUSBAND WORKFORCE — STAFFING MODEL: ACCEPTED appears. Anya: "Efficient." Calli: "Please never say that again."
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The archive has somehow preserved an earlier staffing decision.

options.resultDialogue: PRECEDENT 87 opens blank. Riona: "I beat stairs for this?"
options.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 completes. The first available precedent is blank, which is somehow less reassuring.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The third calibration completes. Route Z now exposes a PRECEDENT ARCHIVE, which sounds important and explains absolutely nothing.

evening.title: Day 19 - 3/4 Done
evening.openingDialogue: Calibration 3 is complete. Naturally, the first response is merchandise and paperwork.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Fuwawa, Mococo, and Chloe create souvenirs before anyone understands what Calibration 3 did.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Mococo has printed CALIBRATION 3 COMPLETE shirts. Chloe asks what it means. Fuwawa says that's not important.

steps.prompt: What goes on the shirt?

options.resultDialogue: Fuwawa holds it up. Chloe: "Done with what?" Mococo: "MERCH!"
Chloe: "Nobody knows that word." Mococo: "Premium mystery."
Fuwawa draws a cute tram. The printer adds EYES. "BAU..."

steps.prompt: The printer starts making shirts by itself.

options.resultDialogue: Chloe unplugs it. One final shirt prints: NICE TRY.
Mococo stacks shirts. "OUTRUN THE MACHINE!" The machine prints faster.
Fuwawa pets the printer. It stops. Chloe: "Why did that work?"

steps.prompt: Closing stock count.

options.resultDialogue: Chloe counts 48 shirts. The receipt says 49. "No."
Mococo gives a shirt to the tram conductor. The tram has no conductor.
Fuwawa and Mococo wear matching 3/4 DONE shirts. "BAU BAU!"

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Calibration merch sells extremely well to guests who also do not know what it means.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kronii, Mumei, and Iroha copy the new PRECEDENT ARCHIVE menu without opening anything else.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kronii has the forms. Iroha has the copies. Mumei has forgotten why everyone is underground.

steps.prompt: The archive contains 87 numbered entries with blank titles.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii sorts them. Entry 88 appears. "That is not how sorting works."
Mumei: "Maybe 87 is lucky." Iroha: "That was not the question."
Iroha copies PRECEDENT 1 through 87. The printer adds 88 in advance.

steps.prompt: One blank form is labeled MANAGEMENT PRECEDENT.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii: "Finally, restraint." The form stamps PENDING.
Mumei draws an owl. The form stamps FILED. Iroha removes the pen.
Iroha makes three copies. All three receive different serial numbers. "Of course."

steps.prompt: Do you keep the blank form?

options.resultDialogue: Kronii files it under UNKNOWN. The cabinet relabels itself LATER.
Mumei puts it back. "Future us problem." Kronii: "I hate that phrase."
Iroha locks it. The cabinet displays THANK YOU.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The archive is documented without becoming any clearer.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Rushia, Aloe, and Hajime supervise the newly opened Calibration 3 access door after hours.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The door keeps opening whenever someone says 'open.' Rushia has stopped saying the word.

steps.prompt: Aloe says 'open mic.' The door opens.

options.resultDialogue: Hajime shuts it. Aloe: "So it has keyword detection." Rushia: "Don't test it."
Aloe: "Open sandwich." The door opens. Rushia: "STOP HELPING."
Hajime says "close." The door closes. "Easy." Everyone hates this.

steps.prompt: Rushia accidentally says 'open question.'

options.resultDialogue: The door opens slowly. Rushia stares at it until it closes itself.
Aloe laughs once. Rushia turns. Aloe immediately becomes professional.
Hajime writes DOOR LISTENS BADLY. The door opens. "Point proven."

steps.prompt: Night security needs one rule.

options.resultDialogue: Aloe writes O-WORD on the sign. Rushia: "Acceptable."
Hajime stands beside the door. It stays shut. "Respect."
Rushia locks it. The lock displays GOODNIGHT. "Finally."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Calibration 3 access is secured for the night with one banned vocabulary word.

days.storyBeat: Staff cautiously test a pattern: ordinary requests fail, while some Manager statements work suspiciously well. The PRECEDENT ARCHIVE keeps recording the day without explaining why.

morning.title: Day 20 - Careful What You Say
morning.openingDialogue: Nobody is testing supernatural theories. Several people are, however, standing near walls and choosing words extremely carefully.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Pekora, Flare, and Marine test whether saying a useful thing near the hallway actually helps.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A wall is blocking the service route. Pekora calls this an opportunity. Flare calls it a wall.

steps.prompt: Pekora says, 'I wish there was a door here-peko.'

options.resultDialogue: A door appears. Pekora: "I AM ARCHITECT-PEKO!" Flare: "Do not say another noun."
You interrupt. A door handle appears with no door. Marine: "Modern art."
Marine: "Senchou requires a grand entrance!" Curtains appear. No door. "Acceptable."

steps.prompt: Pekora wants the new door to lead to treasure.

options.resultDialogue: The door opens to a broom closet. Flare: "The building agrees with me."
Pekora: "TREASURE-PEKO!" The closet contains one coin. "PROFIT."
Marine: "Senchou's treasure room!" The closet contains Marine merchandise. She starts crying.

steps.prompt: Flare asks everyone to stop experimenting.

options.resultDialogue: The door disappears. Pekora: "CENSORSHIP-PEKO!"
One normal door returns. Flare slowly looks at you.
Nothing happens. Marine whispers, "Manager has discovered silence."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Maintenance restores the hallway and adds 'do not brainstorm near walls' to the safety guide.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Sora, Roboco, and Haato test a meeting room that seems unusually responsive to requests.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The chairs are crooked. Sora asks them to line up. They do.

steps.prompt: Everyone stares at the chairs.

options.resultDialogue: Roboco scans them. "Coincidence alignment: perfect." Sora: "That's not reassuring."
Sora: "Please face the table." The chairs rotate. Haato applauds.
Haato: "DANCE!" One chair falls over. "Stage fright."

steps.prompt: Roboco requests better lighting.

options.resultDialogue: The lights brighten. Roboco: "Voice interface detected?" The wall displays MAYBE.
A spotlight hits Haato. "FINALLY." Sora turns it down.
Nothing happens. Roboco: "Selective listener." Sora: "Rude room."

steps.prompt: Sora says, 'Let's keep today normal.'

options.resultDialogue: Nothing happens for five seconds. Haato: "Boring." The table grows wheels.
Sora opens the door. The chairs wave by rotating slightly. "Goodbye?"
Roboco writes ROOM POLITE. The tablet auto-corrects to MANAGER PRESENT.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The meeting room passes testing after displaying manners and one suspicious auto-correction.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kiara, Reine, and Risu test whether the lounge's new chairs are responding to spoken requests.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Risu says 'premium seating.' Three gold chairs appear. Reine looks at the price tags before anyone sits.

steps.prompt: Who gets a gold chair?

options.resultDialogue: Risu sits. The chair displays PREMIUM USER. "It knows quality."
Reine sits. The chair grows a footrest. Kiara: "Royal DLC."
Kiara sits. The chair warms up. "Phoenix-compatible!" Reine: "Or heated."

steps.prompt: Risu says 'more premium.'

options.resultDialogue: The chair adds one cup holder anyway. Risu: "Residual premium."
The chairs gain velvet ropes. Kiara is now outside the ropes. "HEY."
Reine: "Comfort without vulgarity." The gold disappears. Risu gasps.

steps.prompt: Management asks whether the chairs are safe.

options.resultDialogue: The chairs print APPROVED. Reine: "We did not stamp that."
One chair adds a seatbelt. Kiara: "That made it worse."
Risu: "Safe enough to monetize." The invoice printer starts.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The lounge keeps three premium chairs and one pricing model nobody authorized.

noon.title: Day 20 - Controlled Coincidences
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, the staff has accumulated enough coincidences to justify a test and not enough courage to call it anything else.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Elizabeth, Gigi, and Cecilia run the island's first officially unofficial test of spoken requests.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth calls it a facilities test. Gigi calls it reality wrestling. Cecilia calls both names unhelpful.

steps.prompt: Gigi tells the door, 'OPEN.' Nothing happens.

options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth: "Please open." Nothing. Gigi: "Door is anti-authority."
Cecilia sends a command tone. Nothing. "Excellent. I remain sane."
The door opens. Everyone turns toward you. Gigi: "AGAIN."

steps.prompt: Cecilia sets up a second test with a blank sign.

options.resultDialogue: The sign prints EXIT. Elizabeth slowly lowers her clipboard.
Nothing happens. Gigi: "Coward sign."
The sign prints BIRD WATCH. Elizabeth closes her eyes. "The precedent survived."
Nothing. Cecilia: "I have never been happier to fail."
The sign prints FLOCK COMMAND. Gigi points at it. Elizabeth points at you. Cecilia saves the log without comment.

steps.prompt: Elizabeth asks for a conclusion.

options.resultDialogue: Cecilia: "Manager-specific permissions." Gigi points at you. "ADMIN HUMAN."
The report stamps UNLIKELY. Elizabeth: "The paperwork disagrees."
Gigi: "One more!" Elizabeth: "No." The lights turn off on 'no.' Silence.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Justice ends testing with no explanation and an increasingly uncomfortable amount of evidence.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Kaela, Kobo, and Zeta test a maintenance panel that ignored all three of them yesterday.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela has the panel open. Kobo is yelling commands. Zeta is documenting failure with suspicious enthusiasm.

steps.prompt: Kobo shouts 'LIGHTS ON!' Nothing happens.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela: "Lights." Nothing. "Good. Normal machine."
Zeta whispers, "Activate." Nothing. "Excellent stealth."

options.text: Manager says 'can we get a light?'
options.resultDialogue: Every maintenance light turns on. Kobo points at you. "REMOTE CONTROL!"

steps.prompt: Kaela disconnects the voice microphone.

options.resultDialogue: You say "light." The lights turn off. Kaela looks at the unplugged microphone. "Hmm."
Kobo screams. Nothing happens. "SYSTEM IS BIASED."
Zeta: "No audio path." Kaela: "Then why did it listen?" Nobody answers.

steps.prompt: Maintenance needs a report title.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela writes VOICE BUG. The panel displays NOTED.
Kobo writes MANAGER REMOTE. Zeta adds DO NOT LOSE.
Zeta writes UNKNOWN. The panel displays KNOWN. "Show-off."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The panel remains disconnected from audio and continues listening anyway.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Ririka, Kanade, and Niko test whether Manager wording affects a blank attraction room.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ririka has a questionnaire. Niko has terrible ideas. Kanade has been told not to shout nouns.

steps.prompt: The room is completely empty.

options.resultDialogue: Three chairs appear. A shortcut arrow appears beside them. Ririka: "It bundled an old feature." Niko: "Loyal customer bonus."
Three chairs appear. Ririka: "Asset acquisition cost: zero."
Niko: "CHAIRS!" Nothing. "The room has no comedic instinct."
Kanade screams "CHAIRS!" The echo is the only result. "Rude."

steps.prompt: Ririka wants a controlled revenue test.

options.resultDialogue: A sales counter appears with TEMP STAFF: HUSBAND on the screen. Ririka deletes it. "We are not reopening that department."
A sales counter appears. Ririka grabs it. "SCIENCE IS PROFITABLE."
A paper sign appears: BUDGET MODE. Niko: "It can judge us."
Kanade whispers "stage." Nothing. "Worth trying."

steps.prompt: Niko asks what happens if Manager says something stupid.

options.resultDialogue: Niko: "Strong risk management." Ririka writes that down.
One banana appears on the counter. Kanade screams. Ririka invoices you.
The room displays SESSION COMPLETE. Niko: "It learned corporate endings."

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The focus group confirms that Management should probably choose words more carefully.

evening.title: Day 20 - Precedent +1
evening.openingDialogue: The resort quiets down. Route Z does not.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Fauna, IRyS, and Suisei try to finish the evening without accidentally requesting anything.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Everyone has agreed to speak carefully. Suisei says this is easy. IRyS immediately says 'I wish—' and stops.

steps.prompt: A bench is blocking the path.

options.resultDialogue: Fauna moves the bench. Suisei: "Revolutionary technology. Hands."
You say, "Could this bench be elsewhere?" It slides aside. IRyS: "That counts?!"
Suisei: "Move." Nothing. She smiles. "Good choice."

steps.prompt: The stage lights are too bright.

options.resultDialogue: The lights normalize. Suisei: "Define normal later."
Vines shade the lights. IRyS: "Analog solution."
IRyS: "Could you dim?" Nothing. "I'm offended by the hierarchy."

steps.prompt: Everyone wants one quiet minute.

options.resultDialogue: Every speaker mutes. Suisei checks her mic. "Okay. That's enough evidence."
Fauna holds up one finger. Everyone silently waits. Nothing weird happens. Huge success.
IRyS whispers "quiet." A cricket stops chirping. "I got one!"

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The evening stays mostly normal after everyone learns to fear casual phrasing.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Polka, Nene, and Lamy attempt to grant the Manager five peaceful minutes without saying anything dangerous.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Polka has a stopwatch. Nene has snacks. Lamy has confiscated the suggestion cards.

steps.prompt: Polka asks whether 'peace' counts as a request.

options.resultDialogue: Polka zips her mouth. Nene whispers, "Peace husband." Lamy takes the marker.
Every microphone shuts off. Polka screams silently. Lamy smiles.
Nene: "QUIET!" Nothing happens. "Manager has stronger wife powers."

steps.prompt: The microphones remain muted.

options.resultDialogue: Polka performs an entire silent circus. Somehow louder than usual.
You say, "Sound back." Every microphone returns. Nene: "MAGIC BOSS."
Lamy: "Best management decision this month." Polka looks betrayed.

steps.prompt: The five minutes end.

options.resultDialogue: Polka's microphone returns at full volume. "WELCOME BACK TO NOISE!"
Nene sets another timer. The timer displays REQUEST DENIED. "WHO ASKED YOU?!"
Lamy raises her drink. "I vote permanent silence." Nobody records the vote.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The Manager receives exactly five peaceful minutes, a new resort record.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: AZKi, Aki, and Mel close the lounge while an old Route Z terminal quietly records the day's strange tests.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: AZKi is closing the soundboard. Aki is stacking glasses. Mel notices the old terminal has turned itself on.

steps.prompt: The screen shows PRECEDENT ARCHIVE.

options.resultDialogue: The index reads 94. AZKi: "Wasn't it 87 yesterday?" Aki stops stacking.
Mel presses power. The screen dims, then returns. "Persistent."
Aki puts a towel over it. The glow shines through. "Very subtle."

steps.prompt: The archive count has increased. Several entries are recognizable only if you lived through them.

options.resultDialogue: The entry says ACTIVE. Aki: "We're really keeping bird law?" AZKi: "Apparently it has retention."
The entry says ACCEPTED. Mel: "Accepted by who?" The cursor blinks at you.
The record still says VALID. Aki: "Do we tell Subaru?" Nobody volunteers.
The entry says STAFFING MODEL: ACCEPTED. AZKi quietly closes it. "Some records can remain historical."
The screen displays MANAGEMENT PRECEDENT +1. Mel: "That sounds like your problem."

steps.prompt: The terminal asks SAVE TODAY'S PRECEDENTS?

options.resultDialogue: The cursor selects YES by itself. AZKi: "That feels unfair."
The screen displays PENDING REVIEW. Mel: "It accepts rejection professionally."
Aki covers the terminal. It prints a receipt from underneath the towel: SAVED.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The lounge closes. Somewhere under Route Z, the PRECEDENT ARCHIVE has several more entries than yesterday.

days.storyBeat: After the strange Precedent Archive activity of Day 20, the resort wakes to a harsher version of the old Great Reboot: everything outside the hotel lounge is frozen in place. Since nobody can safely cross the doorway until reality resumes, Management revives the old bingo equipment and drafts Suisei and Lamy to keep the trapped guests entertained.

morning.title: Day 21 — The World Is Down
morning.openingDialogue: The hotel lounge is running. Everything beyond its doors is not. Management's emergency plan is written on a whiteboard: 1) nobody goes outside, 2) keep the tourists calm, 3) somehow this became Bingo.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Suisei and Lamy host five corrupted Bingo calls while everyone waits for the frozen world outside to restart.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue:

Management rolls out the old Day 4 bingo cage.

Suisei checks the microphone. Lamy checks the minibar.

Suisei: "One of those is event equipment."
Lamy: "Both are supporting morale."

The electronic bingo card boots with fifteen unreadable squares.

noon.title: Day 21 — Still Down
noon.openingDialogue: Six hours into the freeze, nobody has moved outside and nobody inside wants another safety briefing. The Bingo crowd, however, wants Round Two.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Suisei and Lamy host five corrupted Bingo calls while everyone waits for the frozen world outside to restart.

coreActivities.completionDialogue:
The fifteenth bingo ball clicks into the tray.

For one second, nothing happens.

Outside, the frozen seagull finishes its wingbeat.
The suspended wave crashes.
A tourist who had been frozen mid-step completes the step and immediately starts screaming.

The entire lounge erupts.

Lamy: "Oh. It's fixed."
Suisei looks down at the bingo cage.
Suisei: "Best of three?"
The lounge answers with one enormous "NO."

The world is moving again. Day 21 ends with the remaining glitches unexplained.

days.storyBeat: The freeze is over, but six hours of delayed resort activity all try to happen at once.

morning.title: Day 22 — Morning
morning.openingDialogue: The world is moving again. Unfortunately, everything it failed to do yesterday has apparently been queued.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Six hours of frozen breakfast orders resume in one second.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Aki has twenty-seven order slips. Matsuri has three trays. Haato has somehow inherited the toaster.

steps.prompt: Every frozen order ticket prints at once. What gets handled first?

options.resultDialogue: Aki builds a perfect queue. Matsuri salutes the clipboard. Haato quietly moves her own ticket to the top.
Matsuri grabs the nearest tray. It belongs to Table 41. There is no Table 41.
Haato announces BACKLOG SPECIAL. Aki removes three ingredients before the sentence ends.

steps.prompt: The kitchen bell rings sixty-three times in a row.

options.resultDialogue: Matsuri rings back. The kitchen and Matsuri enter a short but intense argument.
Aki unplugs it. A hand bell appears beside the printer. Nobody touches it.
Haato stamps CAUGHT UP. The printer finally stops. Aki does not ask why that worked.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Breakfast catches up to reality without catching the kitchen on fire.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Every elevator call made during the freeze executes at once.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The lobby elevator is opening on every floor for half a second. Subaru is yelling floor numbers. Aqua is apologizing to the doors. Shion says it is haunted.

steps.prompt: The panel shows 186 queued requests.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru starts tapping CANCEL. The elevator politely adds her taps to the queue.
Aqua finds a service menu. It asks ARE YOU SURE? She becomes less sure immediately.
Shion says 'Floor zero.' The panel adds 0. Subaru: 'WHY WOULD YOU INVENT ONE?!'

steps.prompt: The doors open onto the same lobby from three directions.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru marches everyone through the least suspicious door. It is, for once, correct.
Shion presses 0. The elevator plays hold music and refuses to move.
Aqua hits CLOSE. All three doors shut. One sighs.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The elevator completes its backlog and is placed on a mandatory emotional break.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Every controller input from the frozen hours suddenly plays back.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Thirty machines begin executing six hours of missed button presses. Korone calls it a combo. Mio calls it a fire hazard.

steps.prompt: A fighting game is comboing itself.

options.resultDialogue: Korone jumps in mid-combo and somehow makes the machine look underqualified.
Okayu watches the buffered combo end. 'The machine had something to say.'
Mio unplugs one cabinet. The cabinet next to it finishes the combo on its behalf.

steps.prompt: The prize counter starts ejecting tickets from games nobody won.

options.resultDialogue: Mio counts them. Korone immediately develops a legal theory about ownership.
Okayu stamps VOID. The tickets curl back into the machine like frightened noodles.
Korone screams JACKPOT. Guests cheer. Mio writes 'temporary policy' with visible pain.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The arcade clears its buffered inputs and several deeply delayed high scores.

noon.title: Day 22 — Noon
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, the resort has stopped celebrating the reboot and started surviving the backlog.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Every splash that should have happened during the freeze happens now.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The wave pool looks calm. Flare does not trust it. Pekora has goggles. Noel is holding three rescue tubes.

steps.prompt: The panel says PENDING WAVES: 47.

options.resultDialogue: Flare selects 1x. The panel changes itself to 10x. 'It disagrees.'
Pekora presses GO with both hands. Noel silently starts handing out helmets.
Noel stands at the shallow end. The first wave visibly reconsiders.

steps.prompt: The final delayed wave is labeled SPECIAL.

options.resultDialogue: Flare cancels it. The pool displays COWARD. Pekora applauds the pool.
A tiny ripple crosses the surface. Pekora: 'THAT was special-peko?!'
Noel steps in. The pool drains two centimeters away from her.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The pool finishes yesterday's business and returns to today's liability waiver.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: The baggage belt delivers every delayed suitcase simultaneously.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Suitcases are circling the lobby at unsafe speed. Watame reads tags. Towa directs traffic. Luna has claimed the smallest suitcase as a throne.

steps.prompt: A mountain of bags reaches the corner.

options.resultDialogue: Towa points once. Guests form a line without being told twice.
Watame sings each surname. Three guests cry because baggage claim became a concert.
Luna raises one finger. The belt slows only beside her. Towa: 'Of course it does.'

steps.prompt: One suitcase has been circling since morning.

options.resultDialogue: Towa hits STOP. The suitcase keeps circling on the floor by itself.
Watame checks it. It says LUGGAGE. 'Very informative.'
Luna points at Room 302. The suitcase rolls away. Nobody knows why.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Every delayed bag reaches somebody, including one bag that appears to know its own room.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Six hours of maintenance requests print in one continuous paper snake.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Lui has the first page. Koyori is measuring the paper. Iroha has lost sight of the printer under the pile.

steps.prompt: Which ticket gets priority?

options.resultDialogue: Lui pulls the red forms. The paper snake tightens around her ankle like it objects.
Koyori grabs the weird pile. 'Finally, the fun one.' Lui: 'Wrong sentence.'
Iroha slices the strip cleanly. Both halves continue printing.

steps.prompt: The last ticket reads FIX PRINTER.

options.resultDialogue: Lui stamps RESOLVED. The printer stops. Koyori looks almost disappointed.
Koyori: 'It is overworked.' Lui looks at the six-hour stack. 'Same.'
Iroha bows. It prints YOU'RE WELCOME.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Maintenance clears the backlog after the printer submits its own complaint.

evening.title: Day 22 — Evening
evening.openingDialogue: The final delayed systems catch up as Staff tries to decide whether this counts as normal.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Every booking confirmation delayed by the freeze reaches the desk at once.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ririka has three phones ringing. Raden has the ledger. Hajime has turned the guest line into lanes.

steps.prompt: Two hundred confirmations share the same timestamp.

options.resultDialogue: Raden begins reading milliseconds. Ririka: 'We will die here.'
Ririka invents GOLD, SILVER, and PLEASE WAIT. Hajime confiscates GOLD.
Hajime points. The line becomes disciplined enough to scare Ririka.

steps.prompt: A reservation appears for ROOM YESTERDAY.

options.resultDialogue: Ririka rejects it. The system replies TOO LATE.
Raden files it under THINGS I REFUSE TO EXPLAIN YET.
Hajime writes 0.5. The elevator dings somewhere far away.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The front desk survives the avalanche and bans timestamps from casual conversation.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: The cameras dump six hours of frozen photos into the souvenir kiosk.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Moona has moonlit photos taken at noon. Iofi is sorting glitch art. Risu has already made a PREMIUM folder.

steps.prompt: Which photos go on sale?

options.resultDialogue: Iofi picks the flattering shots. Risu adds a curation fee.
Moona chooses one where everybody has two shadows. Tourists immediately want prints.
Risu selects ALL. The printer starts smoking in a financially promising way.

steps.prompt: One photo shows the lounge while the world was frozen.

options.resultDialogue: Iofi puts it aside. 'Evidence, not merch.'
Risu writes SIX-HOUR SURVIVOR. Moona silently increases the price.
Moona hangs it behind the counter. The timestamp is six hours long.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The booth catches up and accidentally creates the first outage souvenir line.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Staff has to explain why the world stopped and resumed all at once.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Achan has the incident template. Nodoka is on page 11 of consequences. Neither has reached CAUSE.

steps.prompt: What goes in the cause field?

options.resultDialogue: Achan types UNKNOWN. The form auto-suggests AGAIN.
Nodoka types SYSTEM FREEZE. The form asks WHICH ONE? She closes the dropdown.
Achan selects PENDING. The form accepts it with suspicious speed.

steps.prompt: The report asks whether normal operations resumed.

options.resultDialogue: Nodoka checks YES. A luggage cart rockets past. She unchecks it.
Achan checks MOSTLY. The form finally stops asking questions.
Nodoka types DEFINE NORMAL. Achan: 'Don't challenge paperwork.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Corporate closes the outage report under 'resolved enough.'

days.storyBeat: Staff suspects Manager wording is part of the problem, so the resort experiments with speaking around Management Authority.

morning.title: Day 23 — Morning
morning.openingDialogue: A handwritten rule appears at breakfast: DO NOT LET MANAGER FINISH A DANGEROUS SENTENCE.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Guests need breakfast while staff avoids declarative sentences.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A sign says DO NOT LET MANAGER FINISH A DANGEROUS SENTENCE. Miko has drawn three exclamation marks under it.

steps.prompt: A guest asks where breakfast is.

options.resultDialogue: Sora points to the buffet. Miko points to herself.
Miko pantomimes eating so aggressively a guest calls first aid.
Roboco projects a route. The map adds MANAGER APPROVED without being asked.

steps.prompt: Miko starts: 'Manager, don't you think this table should be bigger—'

options.resultDialogue: Sora covers Miko's mouth. The table grows one centimeter anyway.
Miko waits. Nothing happens. 'Manager learned fear-nye.'
A table-sized napkin appears. Roboco: 'Semantically successful.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Breakfast is served through gestures and one dangerously large napkin.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: A lounge divider must be repaired without describing what it needs.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Botan has tools. Aloe has a whiteboard. Nene has written MAKE IT BETTER before anyone could stop her.

steps.prompt: How do you explain the repair?

options.resultDialogue: Aloe sketches a hinge. The divider grows a second hinge. Botan erases the drawing slowly.
Botan demonstrates the motion. Nene copies it until it becomes a dance.
Nene writes PRETTIER. Glitter appears. Botan: 'We lost control early.'

steps.prompt: The divider works but looks suspiciously improved.

options.resultDialogue: Botan tests it once. 'Functional weird is still functional.'
Aloe wipes it. More appears on the cloth.
Nene asks if it's approved. You nod. Nothing changes. Huge relief.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Maintenance completes a repair using almost no nouns.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: The concierge desk replaces spoken requests with emoji cards.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Su built the board. Vivi is testing expressions. Chihaya has used the car emoji six times.

steps.prompt: A guest needs directions to the pool.

options.resultDialogue: Su points to the route. The sign replies 🏊. Everyone accepts this as progress.
Chihaya selects car plus wave. Su: 'That's not directions. That's a threat.'
Vivi invents a dance route. Two guests follow her and somehow arrive correctly.

steps.prompt: The board displays 🧑‍💼 + 💬 + ⚠️.

options.resultDialogue: Su turns the board around so you cannot see it.
Vivi mimes a meeting. Chihaya falls asleep theatrically.
Chihaya hits clear. The board replaces it with 🤐.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The desk survives one shift using symbols and aggressive eyebrow work.

noon.title: Day 23 — Noon
noon.openingDialogue: By noon, synonyms, charades, and bureaucratic phrasing have become resort safety equipment.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: The buffet discovers that 'more' is dangerous wording.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A guest wants another helping. Reine has banned one specific four-letter word.

steps.prompt: How do staff offer seconds?

options.resultDialogue: Reine delivers it flawlessly. Ollie whispers 'synonyms save lives.'
Anya lifts one finger. The spoon gives exactly one scoop. 'Good spoon.'
Ollie screams it. The buffet sign flashes but nothing grows.

steps.prompt: A tourist starts: 'Could we have more—'

options.resultDialogue: Reine rings the emergency bell. The tourist finishes 'napkins.' Everyone exhales.
Anya says 'time.' The dining clock adds five minutes. 'Not ideal.'
Ollie shouts OBJECTION. The tourist forgets the request.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Lunch continues under the slogan 'another, never more.'

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Maintenance requests tools without complete sentences.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela has the toolbox. Kobo has the marker. Zeta has drawn a suspiciously accurate wrench.

steps.prompt: The sink needs a new valve.

options.resultDialogue: Zeta draws it. Kobo adds a face. Kaela uses the drawing anyway.
Kaela rotates her hand. Kobo rotates her entire body.
Kobo blurts it out. A bucket appears. Kaela: 'Close enough to be dangerous.'

steps.prompt: The faucet asks for FEEDBACK.

options.resultDialogue: Kaela gives one thumb. The faucet stops dripping.
Zeta writes ADEQUATE. The faucet prints RUDE.
Kobo draws five stars. The faucet starts spraying like a fountain.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The sink is repaired and artistic feedback is banned.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: The tour guide avoids sentences that sound like Manager decisions.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ame has redacted seventeen verbs. Ina has cue cards. Kiara hates all of this.

steps.prompt: The group reaches the fourth pier.

options.resultDialogue: Amelia says it carefully. Nothing moves. She marks a victory.
Ina: 'Pier-shaped object, wah.' Kiara: 'Professionally useless.'
Kiara starts 'And over here is the—' Ame rings a bicycle bell at her.

steps.prompt: A guest asks why the layout keeps changing.

options.resultDialogue: Ame answers without looking at you. Ina whispers, 'Powerful lie-wah.'
Ina draws arrows that refuse to connect. 'Accurate.'
Kiara says it. A souvenir kiosk appears. Ame: 'WHO SAID THAT LIKE AN APPROVAL?'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The tour ends with zero dangerous complete sentences and one unexplained kiosk.

evening.title: Day 23 — Evening
evening.openingDialogue: Evening staff discover that silence may be the safest Management interface.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Instructions pass through several people before reaching the Manager.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kronii calls it inefficient. Bae calls it safe. Fauna calls it exhausting.

steps.prompt: Original request: move three chairs.

options.resultDialogue: It reaches you as 'consider seating.' Nothing happens. Kronii looks vindicated.
The message becomes 'CHAIRS MAYBE?' Fauna: 'We preserved uncertainty.'
It arrives as 'the chairs seem restless.' One chair rotates.

steps.prompt: Next request: water.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii hands over a bottle manually. 'Technology.'
The message becomes 'hydration vibes.' A cooler lights up but stays put.
It becomes 'plants are thirsty.' The lobby plants get watered.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The protocol proves bureaucracy can occasionally save reality.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Advent stops dangerous phrasing before it reaches the Manager.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Shiori has a red pen. Bijou has a whistle. Nerissa has a warning jingle.

steps.prompt: A tourist begins, 'This resort really needs a bigger—'

options.resultDialogue: Bijou whistles. The tourist finishes 'map.' Shiori circles MAP as low risk.
Nerissa turns the sentence into a duet and it never reaches the noun.
Shiori holds up 'perhaps consider.' The tourist gets confused enough to stop.

steps.prompt: A memo reads MANAGER SHOULD APPROVE ____.

options.resultDialogue: Bijou shreds it. Shiori saves the pieces for archival reasons.
Nerissa writes NOTHING. The paper stamps APPROVED. Everyone freezes.
Shiori files it untouched. The folder labels itself SAFER THIS WAY.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Advent prevents fourteen dangerous sentences and accidentally approves nothing.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Justice treats complete sentences as a public-safety hazard.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth issued speech guidelines. Cecilia has a phrase-risk meter. Gigi is ticketing nouns.

steps.prompt: Gigi fines a guest for saying 'door.'

options.resultDialogue: Elizabeth: 'A noun alone is not a declaration.' Gigi writes APPEAL PENDING.
Cecilia says 'door.' Nothing happens. Gigi: 'It knows you're not management.'
Gigi issues a receipt labeled VERBAL CRIME.

steps.prompt: The meter spikes when Manager says 'I think—'

options.resultDialogue: Cecilia's meter drops. Elizabeth: 'Excellent restraint.'
A lunch menu slides from the printer. Gigi points. 'EVIDENCE.'
The meter prints PRECEDENT AVOIDED. Nobody likes that wording.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Justice concludes the Manager should probably think quietly.

days.storyBeat: Achan and Nodoka arrive for a corporate inspection after twenty days of incident reports.

morning.title: Day 24 — Morning
morning.openingDialogue: Corporate has arrived. Everyone has approximately three minutes to make the resort look normal.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Achan and Nodoka arrive after twenty days of impossible incident reports.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Achan steps off the shuttle with one folder. Nodoka has seven. The Manager suddenly understands fear.

steps.prompt: What do you show first?

options.resultDialogue: A sign changes LOBBY to PROBABLY LOBBY. Achan: 'Good start.'
Nodoka opens to Day 21. 'The world froze for six hours?' Achan: 'Lobby first.'
Achan accepts a cup. It prints INSPECTOR. Nobody comments.

steps.prompt: Achan asks: 'Is the resort safe?'

options.resultDialogue: A ceiling sign falls behind you. Nodoka writes 'timing issue.'
Achan: 'That is not a safety category.' Nodoka quietly adds it.
Achan nods. 'Finally, an answer I believe.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The corporate inspection begins. The Manager is denied permission to leave.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 1 must serve one normal corporate breakfast.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Fubuki wrote NORMAL three times on the menu. Mel pours tea. Matsuri has been told not to improvise.

steps.prompt: Achan orders toast and coffee.

options.resultDialogue: Exactly toast and coffee arrives. Everyone waits for the punchline. There isn't one.
Mel serves elegantly. The coffee glows for one second and thinks better of it.
Matsuri sets down toast and whispers 'Wasshoi.' Fubuki: 'Close enough.'

steps.prompt: Nodoka asks if this level of normality is typical.

options.resultDialogue: Fubuki coughs hard enough to end the lie.
Mel: 'Very special.' Matsuri nods too quickly.
Fubuki asks it. Nodoka closes her notebook for one second.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Corporate receives one normal breakfast and several coordinated smiles.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 2 demonstrates safe guest operations.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Subaru has a lifeguard whistle. Choco has first aid. Ayame is trying not to laugh at the observers.

steps.prompt: A floatie drifts outside the line.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru performs a textbook rescue on an empty donut. Nodoka writes 'enthusiastic.'
Choco: 'Severe flotation.' Achan stops writing.
Ayame taps the water. The floatie returns. Subaru looks betrayed.

steps.prompt: Achan asks about emergency procedures.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru produces a binder thicker than her arm. 'We added sections.'
Choco reaches 'reality freeze.' Achan raises one finger. 'Later.'
Nodoka writes 'morale procedure?' and underlines the question mark.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The pool passes through competence, documentation, and strategic omission.

noon.title: Day 24 — Noon
noon.openingDialogue: The inspection moves into guest facilities, where normal becomes increasingly difficult to define.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gamers must operate the arcade without punching, eating, or adopting machines.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Mio posted the rules. Korone reads them upside down. Okayu is beside the snack machine.

steps.prompt: The claw machine jams.

options.resultDialogue: Mio performs a perfect reset. Korone whispers, 'boring but powerful.'
Everyone relaxes until Korone calls the key 'yubi-shaped.'
Okayu removes one plush and one rice cracker that should not be inside.

steps.prompt: Nodoka asks whether machines act independently.

options.resultDialogue: The racing cabinet honks by itself. Mio turns it off without looking.
Okayu: 'Only when lonely.' Achan: 'That word was not in the manual.'
Korone pats it. 'Good machine.' It dispenses one ticket. Nodoka writes faster.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The arcade remains officially entertainment equipment, pending personality testing.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Fantasy runs a model concierge desk while corporate watches.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Flare prepared scripts. Marine prepared poses. Rushia prepared to take complaints personally.

steps.prompt: A guest says their room view is blocked.

options.resultDialogue: Flare finds another room in seconds. Marine: 'Competence ruins screen time.'
Marine: 'Senchou can improve any view.' Flare: 'Room. Fixing the room.'
Rushia calmly calls maintenance. 'WHY ARE YOU SURPRISED?'

steps.prompt: Achan asks who approved procedures.

options.resultDialogue: Flare: 'Mostly me.' Achan visibly relaxes.
All three turn toward you. Achan writes one long line.
Marine: 'Branding.' Rushia: 'Not yelling.' Flare: 'Today.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The desk passes after Flare removes Marine's pirate surcharge.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 4 performs a corporate evacuation drill.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Towa has the map. Watame has headcounts. Coco has a megaphone and a warning not to say 'real emergency.'

steps.prompt: The alarm starts.

options.resultDialogue: Towa moves the line with terrifying efficiency. Achan checks the stopwatch twice.
Watame turns the headcount into a call-and-response song.
Coco: 'THIS IS A DRILL.' The alarm displays CONFIRMED.

steps.prompt: The exit sign points to a broom closet.

options.resultDialogue: Towa follows the printed route. The sign rotates back, embarrassed.
Watame keeps calm while Coco interrogates the sign.
Coco labels the closet. The sign changes to FAIR.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The drill passes. Corporate adds 'argumentative signage' to maintenance taxonomy.

evening.title: Day 24 — Evening
evening.openingDialogue: The resort attempts one polished evening while corporate quietly collects more questions.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: HoloX shows corporate the server room without saying 'reality' or 'precedent.'
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Lui leads. Koyori has banned words. Chloe is hiding three labels behind her back.

steps.prompt: Nodoka spots PRECEDENT CACHE.

options.resultDialogue: Lui answers instantly. Koyori writes 'good save.'
Koyori: 'Historical decision data.' Nodoka: 'Not comforting.'
Chloe stands in front. 'There is no cabinet.' Achan: 'There is a Chloe-shaped cabinet.'

steps.prompt: A loose panel reveals MANAGEMENT COMPLIANCE NODE.

options.resultDialogue: Nodoka takes one photo. Lui: 'That was not on yesterday's inventory.'
Chloe closes the panel. The text glows through metal.
Koyori writes it down. The archive prints RECEIVED.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Corporate leaves with one new phrase nobody wanted: Management Compliance Node.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: ReGLOSS presents twenty days of achievements without saying impossible geography.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Raden has slides. Ririka has revenue graphs. Ao volunteered to make it cooler.

steps.prompt: Slide 3: INFRASTRUCTURE GROWTH.

options.resultDialogue: Ririka skips to spending. 'Numbers don't grow extra piers.'
Raden calls it 'unscheduled architectural development.' Achan pinches her nose.
Ao says 'We expanded.' The slide adds BY ITSELF. 'I did not write that.'

steps.prompt: Q&A asks why rooms moved.

options.resultDialogue: Ririka smiles. Nodoka writes 'marketing answer.'
A printer turns on. Everyone shouts NO.
Ao says 'vibes.' Achan stares four seconds. 'Next question.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The presentation ends with excellent revenue and forbidden vocabulary.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: ID Gen 1 hosts closing dinner for corporate.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Iofi designed menu cards. Moona arranged light. Risu labeled dessert AUDIT-RESISTANT.

steps.prompt: Achan asks why dessert is audit-resistant.

options.resultDialogue: Risu: 'No refunds.' Achan: 'That answered nothing.'
Iofi crosses out the label. The cake sparkles.
Moona dims them. The sparkle becomes more obvious. 'Counterproductive.'

steps.prompt: Nodoka asks for final assessment.

options.resultDialogue: Achan: 'Operationally impressive. Existentially concerning.'
Risu slides dessert over. 'This does not affect the report.' Achan takes it.
Iofi sketches a smiling resort with a warning triangle. Nodoka: 'Oddly accurate.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Corporate schedules a follow-up nobody is excited about.

days.storyBeat: Management allows one carefully scoped improvement per department. The island follows instructions, not always the spirit.

morning.title: Day 25 — Morning
morning.openingDialogue: Everyone has learned one thing: specific requests are safer. Management tests that theory.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 0 gets one carefully scoped lobby improvement.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A whiteboard reads ONE REASONABLE REQUEST. Miko is already asking what reasonable means.

steps.prompt: Which request gets approved?

options.resultDialogue: Comfortable benches appear. Everyone stares at the first normal miracle.
The lobby becomes concert-perfect and whisper-dangerous.
A gold door appears beside reception. Sora: 'Small?'

steps.prompt: One adjustment only.

options.resultDialogue: Sora labels it DONE before anyone gets creative.
Miko adds ELITE. The door adds ELITE to the wall.
AZKi finds an OFF switch. Everyone applauds the concept.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Gen 0 proves the island can occasionally follow scope.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 5 gets one approved pool-deck improvement.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Botan wants shade. Lamy wants colder drinks. Nene wants a seal-shaped everything.

steps.prompt: Pick one.

options.resultDialogue: Umbrellas unfold perfectly. Nene draws faces on them.
The cooler drops two degrees. Lamy: 'Responsible impossible power.'
A seal fountain appears. Nene drops to her knees. 'MANAGER UNDERSTANDS FAMILY.'

steps.prompt: A second request is forbidden.

options.resultDialogue: Botan physically removes Nene from the whiteboard.
The seal gains sunglasses. Lamy: 'We learned nothing.'
Lamy writes CLOSED. The whiteboard erases itself.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The pool gains one improvement and unauthorized fountain sunglasses.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: FLOW GLOW gets one request for the resort stage.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Riona wants an entrance. Su wants better controls. Vivi wants reactive flooring.

steps.prompt: Approve one.

options.resultDialogue: A dramatic lift appears. Riona immediately requests theme music.
Su receives a panel with one button labeled TOO MUCH.
The floor pulses to Vivi's beat. A waiter accidentally joins the show.

steps.prompt: The stage asks SAVE PRESET?

options.resultDialogue: The screen labels it MANAGEMENT PRECEDENT 95.
Riona selects NO. It replies SAVED LOCALLY.
Vivi names it NORMAL. The screen adds quotation marks.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: FLOW GLOW gets an upgrade and the archive gets another number.

noon.title: Day 25 — Noon
noon.openingDialogue: The one-request experiment expands to service departments with creative definitions of reasonable.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: ID Gen 2 gets one dining-hall request.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Reine wants smoother service. Anya wants quiet chairs. Ollie wants a dessert siren.

steps.prompt: What gets approved?

options.resultDialogue: Serving carts route themselves perfectly. Reine: 'Elegant.' Ollie: 'Creepy elegant.'
Every chair stops squeaking. Anya: 'Worth the cosmic risk.'
A tiny bell rings when pudding arrives. Ollie: 'THIS IS RESTRAINT?!'

steps.prompt: One cart starts following Manager.

options.resultDialogue: The cart parks. Reine: 'Authority confirmed.'
The cart reverses. Ollie: 'Ancient weapon beats infrastructure.'
Ollie rides one lap. Reine ends requests.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Dining improves and one cart develops professional boundaries.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: ID Gen 3 gets one maintenance request.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela wants a cabinet. Zeta wants cable panels. Kobo wants every pipe labeled.

steps.prompt: Choose.

options.resultDialogue: A stocked cabinet appears. Kaela: 'Good.' Highest possible review.
Discrete panels appear. Zeta smiles. 'Suspiciously convenient.'
Every pipe gains a label. One says DO NOT ASK. Kobo asks.

steps.prompt: The system asks for an owner.

options.resultDialogue: The cabinet prints OWNER: KAELA. It seems proud.
The panels stop appearing when watched. 'Appropriate.'
Every pipe gains a blue sticker. Kaela: 'We chose chaos.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Maintenance gets one useful improvement and future investigation targets.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Myth gets one request for the guest tour route.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ame wants accurate maps. Ina wants benches. Gura wants a shark stop.

steps.prompt: Approve one.

options.resultDialogue: Fresh maps print today's layout. Ame writes the date in huge letters.
Benches appear. Ina: 'Ancient civilization invented sitting-wah.'
A tiny aquarium kiosk appears. Gura: 'A!'

steps.prompt: Should Route Z be shown?

options.resultDialogue: Ame marks it restricted. The map obeys.
Ina leaves a gap. The map writes YOU KNOW WHERE IT IS.
Gura draws a train with teeth. The printer reproduces it.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The tour improves without giving guests access to Route Z.

evening.title: Day 25 — Evening
evening.openingDialogue: The final departments make their requests while the Precedent Archive quietly records every approval.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Promise gets one request to make the schedule less chaotic.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kronii wants punctuality. IRyS wants recovery breaks. Sana wants longer everything.

steps.prompt: What gets approved?

options.resultDialogue: Every clock synchronizes. Kronii smiles. One clock panics.
Ten-minute breaks appear. IRyS: 'Impossible power for labor rights.'
Sana says 'a little.' Every event gains one minute.

steps.prompt: The schedule asks AUTO-ADJUST?

options.resultDialogue: The timetable becomes terrifyingly efficient.
IRyS selects manual. The screen sighs.
Sana picks font size. The schedule occupies a wall.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The resort receives one schedule improvement and a timetable visible from orbit.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Advent gets one approved request for the kids' area.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Fuwawa wants shade. Mococo wants obstacles. Bijou wants a leaderboard.

steps.prompt: Choose one.

options.resultDialogue: A canopy unfolds. The twins call it BAU BASE.
Foam obstacles appear. Mococo completes it before guests arrive.
A scoreboard appears with Bijou already first. 'System knows skill.'

steps.prompt: The board asks RESET DAILY?

options.resultDialogue: Bijou looks wounded. Fuwawa pats her shoulder.
Mococo: 'Biboo wins forever!' Bijou: 'Correct design.'
The board adds POPULARITY MODE. The twins start campaigning.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The play area gains one controlled feature and uncontrolled competition.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Justice gets one approved safety request.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Elizabeth wants clearer rules. Raora wants visual signs. Cecilia wants self-reporting doors.

steps.prompt: Approve one.

options.resultDialogue: Rule boards appear with exactly five lines. Elizabeth looks emotional.
Raora's pictograms appear. One depicts Gigi being removed from a fountain.
A door displays HINGE: SAD. Cecilia: 'I asked for failures, not feelings.'

steps.prompt: The system asks WHO AUTHORIZED THIS?

options.resultDialogue: It prints RECORDED. Cecilia looks at you instead of the screen.
Elizabeth says collectively. It prints SECONDARY AUTHORITY.
Raora draws a tiny Manager. The screen accepts it.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Justice gets one upgrade and the archive gains another authorization record.

days.storyBeat: Everyone tries to clean the Manager's record before corporate review.

morning.title: Day 26 — Morning
morning.openingDialogue: Management has one day to make twenty-five days of strange decisions look defensible.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 1 tries to reduce the Manager's precedent count with public apologies.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Fubuki has a microphone. Aki has calming drinks. Mel has a sign: WE REGRET SOME THINGS.

steps.prompt: What does the apology cover?

options.resultDialogue: Fubuki: 'We regret doors becoming more door than intended.'
Mel: 'We regret negotiating with clouds.' A guest applauds.
Fubuki reads 'sorry for vibes.' The archive counter increases by one.

steps.prompt: The terminal asks ACCEPT LIABILITY?

options.resultDialogue: It replies NOTED, COWARDLY.
The counter stays exactly the same.
Fubuki selects FRIENDLY. The terminal cannot process it.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The booth improves public mood and does nothing to the legal record.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 2 labels strange incidents before tomorrow's review.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Subaru has boxes. Choco has neutral labels. Shion keeps writing MAGIC.

steps.prompt: How do you label a self-moving chair?

options.resultDialogue: The chair moves closer to read the label.
Choco uses neutral wording. Shion adds 'probably cursed.'
Shion writes MAGIC. The archive stamps ACCEPTED PRECEDENT.

steps.prompt: A box contains forms titled MANAGER SAID SO.

options.resultDialogue: Subaru tapes it shut. The tape prints ARCHIVED.
Choco reads two pages. 'Not a medical problem.'
Shion writes it. The forms change back.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Evidence labeling ends with fewer loose papers and more concern.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gamers ask whether the Precedent Archive can simply be reset.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The archive has a greyed-out RESET button. Korone is already pressing it.

steps.prompt: How do you approach RESET?

options.resultDialogue: Mio reads RESET REQUIRES FINAL CALIBRATION and circles FINAL.
Korone unlocks it for one frame. It greys out harder.
Okayu finds seven backups named DO_NOT_DELETE.

steps.prompt: The archive offers EXPORT instead.

options.resultDialogue: Mio prints eighty-seven pages.
Korone prints Gigi pointing at a bird.
Okayu closes the menu. 'Safest save strategy.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Only Final Calibration can globally change the archive.

noon.title: Day 26 — Noon
noon.openingDialogue: The cleanup becomes more legal, less effective, and substantially funnier.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Pekora and Marine open a defense office. Flare prevents actual fraud.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: A sign reads MANAGER DEFENSE — NO REFUNDS. Flare crossed out the second half.

steps.prompt: Defense strategy?

options.resultDialogue: Pekora: 'Explosions are thermal maintenance-peko.' Flare: 'No.'
Marine: 'Experiential infrastructure.' Flare: 'Also no.'
Flare: 'We made decisions under pressure.' Both schemers boo.

steps.prompt: The archive requests evidence.

options.resultDialogue: Marine submits merch receipts. The archive asks WHY SO MANY.
Flare submits actual logs. The archive finally stays quiet.
Mostly arrows pointing to PROFIT. The archive saves it.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The defense office creates three new exhibits for tomorrow.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 4 prepares members for tomorrow's questions.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Towa has flash cards. Kanata is serious. Luna declared herself expert witness.

steps.prompt: Did Manager-approved changes alter the resort?

options.resultDialogue: Towa: 'Operational outcomes changed.' Kanata: 'Lawyer language.'
Kanata: 'Yes.' Towa drops the cards.
Luna: 'Manager made island listen, nna.' The room goes quiet.

steps.prompt: Was it dangerous?

options.resultDialogue: Towa says sometimes. Honest and terrible.
Kanata: 'Mostly?' Towa: 'Do not add uncertainty aloud.'
Luna: 'Manager survives.' Nobody can argue with the metric.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Witness coaching establishes that honesty may be the dangerous strategy.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: HoloX tries to merge duplicate precedents before review.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Lui has admin access. Koyori found fourteen near-identical entries. Iroha fears the delete key.

steps.prompt: What gets merged?

options.resultDialogue: Lui merges seven. The archive creates one entry titled DOOR ERA.
Koyori merges signage. Summary: SIGNS LEARNED ATTITUDE.
Iroha refuses. 'Deleting history feels dangerous, de gozaru.'

steps.prompt: A hidden menu reads MANAGEMENT REVIEW — TOMORROW.

options.resultDialogue: Only button: SUMMON.
The menu reopens behind the window.
The archive logs SCREENSHOT AS PRECEDENT. Lui stops speaking.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Archive maintenance confirms a formal review is scheduled.

evening.title: Day 26 — Evening
evening.openingDialogue: By evening, the archive stops cooperating and files paperwork of its own.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: ReGLOSS launches PR proving the Manager is responsible.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ririka has slogans. Raden has quotes. Ao models trustworthy management despite not being management.

steps.prompt: Pick slogan.

options.resultDialogue: Ririka loves honesty. Raden hates MOSTLY. Ao poses anyway.
Raden asks if explosions count. Ririka: 'Engagement.'
Ao holds your clipboard like fashion. The archive counter ticks up.

steps.prompt: A reporter asks if Manager controls the island.

options.resultDialogue: Ririka says no too quickly. A nearby sign turns to YES?
Raden: 'Excellent non-answer.'
Ao poses. The reporter forgets the question for eight seconds.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Public opinion improves. The archive's sense of humor does not.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Risu monetizes old precedents before they become evidence.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Risu printed HISTORIC MANAGEMENT DECISIONS cards. Moona prices foils. Iofi draws borders.

steps.prompt: Which is the chase rare?

options.resultDialogue: Risu prints WORLD DOWN — LIMITED. Moona calls it morally questionable.
Iofi draws a tiny extra pier. Guests ask for signed copies.
Risu reveals MANAGER BANANA. The card is somehow foil.
Without a banana precedent, Risu sells MYSTERY ERROR instead.

steps.prompt: Corporate asks them to stop selling evidence.

options.resultDialogue: Moona removes display. Risu moves sales under the table literally.
Iofi changes EVIDENCE to EDUCATIONAL. The request goes away.
Risu: 'Ten percent.' The printer outputs ETHICS REVIEW.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The marketplace closes with excellent sales and one ethics review.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Corporate receives an automated summons from Route Z.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Achan reads the inspection report. Nodoka reads a fresh page the printer made itself.

steps.prompt: The page says THE PEOPLE OF HOLOLIVE RESORT v. MANAGER.

options.resultDialogue: The back says NOT A JOKE.
Nodoka reads PRECEDENT ARCHIVE. 'Can a database sue someone?'
The printer adds EXCESSIVE AUTHORIZATION. Achan looks at you.

steps.prompt: The hearing is tomorrow at noon.

options.resultDialogue: Achan hands you the binder. 'Start with the impossible parts.'
The printer replies DENIED — CALENDAR FULL.
Achan: 'Good. We need answers anyway.' Route Z rings once.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Corporate accepts tomorrow's hearing. The Manager has been sued by infrastructure.

days.storyBeat: The Precedent Archive puts the Manager on trial. The hearing finally exposes UNIT-Z and what it has been regulating.

morning.title: Day 27 — Morning
morning.openingDialogue: The resort converts a conference room into a courtroom because infrastructure has filed a case.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 0 keeps the guest jury occupied before the Manager's hearing.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Sora is explaining procedure. Roboco checks the evidence display. Miko has made JURY snacks.

steps.prompt: A guest asks whether the Manager is guilty.

options.resultDialogue: Sora smiles. Miko whispers, 'boring justice.'
Miko declares ELITE INNOCENT. Roboco: 'Not a legal category.'
Roboco displays 51%. Sora immediately turns off the screen.

steps.prompt: The archive sends Exhibit 1: a door.

options.resultDialogue: Sora asks it to stay still. It does. Everybody looks at you.
Miko: 'WHO AUTHORIZED YOU?' The door opens. 'CONFESSION!'
Roboco: 'Normal door. Abnormal metadata.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The jury room ends with nobody less confused than before.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 5 organizes physical exhibits for the hearing.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Botan has evidence tags. Lamy has the incident list. Nene has named the evidence cart.

steps.prompt: Which exhibit goes first?

options.resultDialogue: Botan tags it. The sign changes its tag to WITNESS.
Lamy hangs the Day 21 lounge photo. Nene points at herself in the background whether she's there or not.
Nene: 'Character witness!' Botan: 'Furniture.'

steps.prompt: The archive requests 'representative absurdity.'

options.resultDialogue: The sign displays I OBJECT.
The chair rotates toward the courtroom. Lamy: 'Representative enough.'
The archive fills the blank slot with MANAGER.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The exhibit hall is ready, including one item that understands court procedure.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: FLOW GLOW manages the guest broadcast without turning court into sports commentary.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Riona has the camera. Chihaya built a replay screen. Vivi composed a sting for OBJECTION.

steps.prompt: How serious is the broadcast?

options.resultDialogue: Riona opens professionally. Vivi quietly deletes three sound effects.
Chihaya adds MANAGER 0 — ISLAND 0. Riona: 'No.'
Vivi plays the OBJECTION sting once. The audience loves it too much.

steps.prompt: The archive sends a live PRECEDENTS CITED counter.

options.resultDialogue: Riona covers it. The number keeps climbing behind her.
Chihaya narrates it like a lap counter. 'This is bad, right?'
Vivi mutes the desk. The sting plays anyway.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The broadcast remains technically news and spiritually a tournament.

noon.title: Day 27 — Noon
noon.openingDialogue: Witnesses and tests turn the Manager's strange authority from a theory into an uncomfortable fact.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: ID Gen 2 testifies about the resort's strange behavior.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Reine prepared notes. Anya says notes imply memory. Ollie has sworn on three different objects.

steps.prompt: Did Manager statements affect operations?

options.resultDialogue: Reine: 'There were correlations.' The archive prints UNDERSTATEMENT.
Anya: 'Yes.' The printer stays quiet. Somehow worse.
Ollie says 'I want a snack.' Nothing happens. 'DISCRIMINATION!'

steps.prompt: Should Manager keep this authority?

options.resultDialogue: Reine: 'Preferably with guardrails.' The archive prints INTERESTING.
Anya: 'Useful. Dangerous. Like many tools.'
Ollie: 'FREE SNACK POTENTIAL!' Reine removes her microphone.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The testimony establishes the Manager is useful, dangerous, and worse than a vending machine.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: ID Gen 3 tests whether the system reacts to anyone besides Manager.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kaela disconnected microphones. Zeta isolated wiring. Kobo is ready to yell.

steps.prompt: Kobo says 'lights on.'

options.resultDialogue: Nothing happens. Kobo: 'BIASED COURT!'
Kaela: 'Lights.' Nothing. 'Good.'
Every test lamp turns on. Zeta writes one word: 'Well.'

steps.prompt: Zeta removes power from the control panel.

options.resultDialogue: You ask for one lamp. A battery lamp switches on across the room.
Nothing. Kobo points at you like you designed unfairness.
Kaela closes the case. 'Enough proof.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Cross-examination produces the least funny result: the effect is Manager-specific.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Myth reconstructs the timeline from Day 5 to Day 21.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Ame has red string. Ina drew the resort. Calli stops the string becoming a spiderweb.

steps.prompt: Which incident goes in the center?

options.resultDialogue: Ame pins Day 5. Calli: 'First big outage.'
Ina pins the impossible pier. The map draws a question mark beside it.
Calli pins the six-hour freeze. Ame circles it twice.

steps.prompt: The strings converge on one label.

options.resultDialogue: MANAGEMENT APPROVAL. Ina: 'That's pretty direct-wah.'
Calli covers it. The sticky note says SAME THING.
Ame: 'I think the island has been taking orders.' Nobody laughs.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Myth finishes the reconstruction. The conspiracy board is less strange than the evidence.

evening.title: Day 27 — Evening
evening.openingDialogue: The overloaded archive summons everyone underground, where the system behind the mystery finally answers.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Promise handles the first verdict discussion while the archive overheats.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Kronii has the timeline. IRyS has the risk list. Mumei drew a bird beside PRECEDENT.

steps.prompt: What should happen to Manager authority?

options.resultDialogue: Kronii: 'Predictability has merit.' The archive fans speed up.
IRyS: 'Keep useful parts, stop disasters.' The archive displays PROCESSING.
Mumei: 'It's been funny.' Kronii: 'Not a legal standard.'

steps.prompt: The archive counter hits 100%.

options.resultDialogue: Kronii freezes the schedule, not the world. Small victory.
IRyS calls. Route Z lights turn on instead.
Mumei: 'Maybe it wants us downstairs.' A tram bell rings.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Route Z brings the deliberators into the UNIT-Z chamber. Its header identifies it as the system that records and stabilizes Management Authority: the island has been treating Manager approvals as local rules.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Advent follows the overloaded archive as it prints old decisions.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Shiori collects pages. Bijou reads percentages. Nerissa keeps guests upstairs.

steps.prompt: The screen flashes PRECEDENT CAPACITY 100%.

options.resultDialogue: Shiori opens them. A new subsystem name appears: UNIT-Z.
Bijou presses it. The warning becomes PLEASE STOP.
Nerissa reads MANAGEMENT COMPLIANCE LAYER. The room goes quiet.

steps.prompt: A maintenance door opens beneath the archive.

options.resultDialogue: Shiori: 'Finally.' Bijou: 'BOSS ROOM.' Nerissa: 'Please don't call it that.'
Bijou sends a camera. It returns a screen full of forms.
Nerissa calls them. The door prints THANK YOU.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Advent opens the UNIT-Z chamber. The diagnostics identify it as a compliance and stabilization system for Management Authority—not an enemy, just an exhausted regulator that has been recording the Manager's precedents all month.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Justice conducts the final hearing inside the UNIT-Z chamber.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Cecilia reads the header. Elizabeth still treats this as court. Gigi found a chair for the terminal. Raora sketches the screen.

steps.prompt: UNIT-Z prints: LOCAL MANAGEMENT DECLARATIONS MAY ESTABLISH OPERATIONAL PRECEDENT.

options.resultDialogue: Cecilia: 'When Manager approves something, the island may treat it as a rule.' Gigi: 'ADMIN HUMAN.'
Elizabeth: 'The defendant has apparently been legislating geography.'
Gigi: 'Manager says thing. Island says YES BOSS.' Cecilia: 'Crude. Accurate.'

steps.prompt: UNIT-Z prints: PURPOSE — LIMIT, RECORD, AND STABILIZE MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY.

options.resultDialogue: Cecilia nods. 'A regulator, not an attacker.' The terminal prints CORRECT.
Raora: 'Too many precedents?' UNIT-Z prints CORRECT AGAIN.
The screen prints MANDATORY MANAGEMENT SAFETY TRAINING — TOMORROW.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: The hearing ends with the mystery finally named: the island listens to Management, and UNIT-Z has spent the month trying to keep that from becoming everybody's problem.

days.storyBeat: UNIT-Z responds to the reveal with mandatory training for the Manager.

morning.title: Day 28 — Morning
morning.openingDialogue: UNIT-Z has prepared eight training modules, a final exam, and several very specific examples.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 1 teaches the Manager how not to authorize nonsense.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: UNIT-Z displays AVOID IMPERATIVE NOUN PHRASES. Matsuri asks what that means.

steps.prompt: Practice: 'This hallway needs...'

options.resultDialogue: UNIT-Z: ACCEPTABLE. Fubuki gives you a sticker.
UNIT-Z flashes red before you finish. Mel: 'Found the example.'
Matsuri says it for you. UNIT-Z: NOT MANAGEMENT ACTION.

steps.prompt: Second prompt: 'I approve...'

options.resultDialogue: Green light. Fubuki: 'We can teach Manager!'
The entire screen becomes red.
UNIT-Z: PLEASE BE SPECIFIC. Mel: 'Context dependent.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Module 1 passes after one normal repair approval.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 2 teaches the danger of vague wording.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: UNIT-Z asks DEFINE BETTER. Aqua looks stressed already.

steps.prompt: A guest asks for a better room.

options.resultDialogue: Choco: 'Symptoms first.' UNIT-Z approves clarification.
Shion whispers 'do it.' UNIT-Z flashes AMBIGUOUS AUTHORITY.
Aqua offers a nicer pillow. UNIT-Z: LOW-RISK INTERPRETATION.

steps.prompt: Is 'normal' safe wording?

options.resultDialogue: UNIT-Z displays CORRECT. Aqua looks more worried.
The room loses all decoration. Shion: 'It interpreted boring.'
Choco: 'Baseline operating state.' UNIT-Z relaxes.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Module 2 teaches that adjectives are a workplace hazard.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gamers run a simulator where approvals change a fake resort.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Mio has the controller. Korone wants speedrun rules. Okayu found pause.

steps.prompt: The simulator asks APPROVE BRIDGE?

options.resultDialogue: Mio opens the blueprint. UNIT-Z awards RESPONSIBLE DELAY.
Korone approves seventeen bridges. The simulator becomes mostly bridge.
Okayu pauses it. 'Strongest management technique.'

steps.prompt: A fake seagull complaint appears.

options.resultDialogue: Mio smiles. Somewhere, Gigi feels a disturbance.
The simulator fills with court summons. UNIT-Z: HISTORICAL PATTERN DETECTED.
Okayu selects snack. Complaint ends immediately.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Module 3 passes after Manager resists one large APPROVE button.

noon.title: Day 28 — Noon
noon.openingDialogue: The training becomes less theoretical once Pekora sees the explosives module.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: UNIT-Z created an entire lesson because of Pekora.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: The title reads EXPLOSIVES ARE NOT MAINTENANCE TOOLS. Pekora filed an objection.

steps.prompt: UNIT-Z shows a broken server rack.

options.resultDialogue: Flare repairs it. Pekora: 'Suspiciously slow-peko.'
Noel taps it. UNIT-Z: ACCEPTABLE BUT MONITOR STRUCTURE.
Pekora reaches for a prop stick. UNIT-Z locks the training table.

steps.prompt: Quiz: Is 'controlled explosion' maintenance?

options.resultDialogue: CORRECT appears large enough for Pekora to read from orbit.
Flare turns toward you. You change your answer emotionally.
Pekora: 'YES-PEKO.' UNIT-Z prints SOURCE REJECTED.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Module 4 passes. Pekora appeals to a higher court that does not exist.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: Gen 4 teaches when brute force is safer than Management Authority.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: UNIT-Z presents a stuck door: DO NOT DECLARE NEW DOOR.

steps.prompt: How do you open it?

options.resultDialogue: Towa tries twice. The second works. Everyone applauds normal physics.
Kanata lifts the door out of the frame. UNIT-Z: TECHNICALLY NOT AUTHORITY.
Watame covers your mouth before the noun finishes.

steps.prompt: A cart blocks the exit.

options.resultDialogue: Kanata moves it normally enough to make UNIT-Z happy.
Watame asks the cart to move. Nothing. 'Good cart.'
Towa hits the training buzzer. 'NO SHORTCUTS.'

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Module 5 confirms the safest reality tool is sometimes Kanata.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: HoloX teaches how small approvals become permanent entries.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Lui has a clean form. Koyori has the archive. Iroha has erasers that will not help.

steps.prompt: Which statement should become precedent?

options.resultDialogue: UNIT-Z stores it under USEFUL.
Koyori hovers over approve. Lui takes the mouse.
Iroha: 'Dangerous, de gozaru.' UNIT-Z agrees violently.

steps.prompt: The archive offers DELETE PRECEDENT.

options.resultDialogue: Koyori deletes only the simulator record. 'Responsible science hurts.'
UNIT-Z requires FINAL CALIBRATION. Lui: 'There's the end goal.'
Iroha closes the menu. UNIT-Z writes CONSERVATIVE.

coreActivities.completionDialogue: Module 6 reveals the only safe global reset: Final Calibration.

evening.title: Day 28 — Evening
evening.openingDialogue: Corporate administers the final test and learns when Calibration 4 becomes available.

coreActivities.previewDialogue: ReGLOSS teaches microphones make bad accidental legislation.
coreActivities.selectedDialogue: Raden has speech notes. Kanade has a mic with no batteries. Hajime guards the spares.

steps.prompt: Practice: 'The festival will have...'
